title.zh: 卷100 志七十五 乐七 乐章五铙歌大乐 铙歌清乐凯歌辞
title.en: Volume 100 Treatises 75: Music 7, Yue Zhang Wu Nao Ge Da Le, Nao Ge Qing Le Kai Ge Ci
title.raw: 卷100 志七十五 乐七 乐章五铙歌大乐 铙歌清乐凯歌辞

sentences.zh: 志七十五

translations.literal: Treatise seventy-five.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 75

sentences.zh: 樂七

translations.literal: Music seven.
translations.idiomatic: Music, Section 7

sentences.zh: 樂章五鐃歌大樂鐃歌清樂凱歌辭知

translations.literal: Musical sections five: iron-gong songs great music, iron-gong songs clear music, victory-song lyrics — note.
translations.idiomatic: Musical Sections 5: Great Music for Iron-Gong Songs; Iron-Gong Songs, Clear Music, and Victory-Song Lyrics (editorial note)

sentences.zh: 巡幸鐃歌大樂二十八章乾隆七年定。

translations.literal: Patrol-expedition iron-gong song great music, twenty-eight sections, fixed in Qianlong year seven.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-eight sections of the Great Music for Patrol Iron-Gong Songs were established in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign (1742).

sentences.zh: 大清朝第一大清朝，景運隆。

translations.literal: Great Qing dynasty number one, great Qing dynasty, splendid fortune flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: Great Qing—first of the great Qing—its glorious destiny ascends.

sentences.zh: 肇興俄朵，奄有大東。

translations.literal: At the beginning they rose at E'duo and broadly possessed the great east.
translations.idiomatic: Rising from E'duo at the founding, they came to hold sway over the great eastern lands.

sentences.zh: 鵲銜果，神靈首出；

translations.literal: A magpie bore fruit in its beak, and the divine spirit first emerged;
translations.idiomatic: A magpie bore fruit in its beak, and the divine lord first appeared;

sentences.zh: 壹戎衣，龍起雲從。

translations.literal: Once he donned the martial robe, the dragon arose and the clouds followed.
translations.idiomatic: Donning the martial robe but once, the dragon arose and the clouds rallied to him.

sentences.zh: 一解雷動奏膚功，舉松山，拔杏山，如卷秋蓬。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: thunder moved as skin-merit was proclaimed; Songshan was raised and Xingshan taken, like rolling autumn tussock.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Thunder rolled as deeds of valor were proclaimed; Songshan was taken and Xingshan seized, swept away like autumn tussock-grass in the wind.

sentences.zh: 天開長白雲，地蹙凌河凍。

translations.literal: Heaven opened the Changbai clouds; earth contracted the Ling River's ice.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven unveiled the clouds of Changbai; earth shrank the ice along the Ling River.

sentences.zh: 混車書，山河一統。

translations.literal: Carts and writing were mingled; mountains and rivers were unified as one.
translations.idiomatic: Carts and scripts were unified, and mountains and rivers brought under one rule.

sentences.zh: 聲靈四訖，萬國來修貢。

translations.literal: His voice and spirit reached the four quarters; ten thousand states came to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: His renown reached the four quarters, and myriad lands came to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 二解皇宅中，垂統瓜瓞唪唪。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: the emperor dwelt at the center; his succession descended like teeming melon vines.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: The Son of Heaven dwelt at the center; his line descended like teeming melon vines.

sentences.zh: 聖繼聖，功德兼隆。

translations.literal: Sage succeeded sage; merit and virtue alike grew lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Sage succeeded sage, and merit and virtue alike grew great.

sentences.zh: 昇平頌，怙冒如天恩澤濃。

translations.literal: Songs of rising peace; sheltering grace thick as heaven's bounty.
translations.idiomatic: Songs of rising peace rose up; sheltering grace lay thick as heaven's bounty.

sentences.zh: 三解人壽年豐，時雍風動，荷天之寵。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: the people lived long and harvests were abundant; the age was harmonious and gentle winds stirred; they bore heaven's favor.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: The people lived long and harvests were full; harmony reigned and gentle winds blew, bearing heaven's favor.

sentences.zh: 慶宸游，六龍早駕，一朵紅雲奉。

translations.literal: They celebrated the imperial tour; six dragon-steeds were harnessed early, and a single crimson cloud attended.
translations.idiomatic: They rejoiced in the imperial tour; six dragon-steeds were harnessed early, and a crimson cloud attended.

sentences.zh: 扈宸游，六師從幸，萬里歡聲共。

translations.literal: They escorted the imperial tour; six hosts followed in fortune, and joy resounded together for ten thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: They escorted the imperial tour; six hosts followed in fortune, and joy resounded for ten thousand li.

sentences.zh: 四解

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4

sentences.zh: 四時仗第二御句芒，春載陽，震位峙東方。

translations.literal: Four Seasons Procession, second: the emperor addressed Goumang; spring bore the yang; the Zhen position stood in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Four Seasons Procession, No. 2: The emperor addressed Goumang; spring bore the yang force, and the Zhen trigram position stood in the east.

sentences.zh: 順時令，駕蒼龍，驂吉良。

translations.literal: Following the season's command, he drove the azure dragon and paired it with auspicious bays.
translations.idiomatic: Following the season's command, he drove the azure dragon, paired with auspicious bays.

sentences.zh: 見垂虹，青蓱漸芳。

translations.literal: He saw the hanging rainbow; green duckweed grew fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: He saw rainbows arch overhead; green duckweed grew fragrant.

sentences.zh: 行慶施惠，恩波浩蕩。

translations.literal: He carried out celebration and bestowed grace; the waves of favor rolled vast.
translations.idiomatic: He spread celebration and bestowed grace; the waves of imperial favor rolled vast.

sentences.zh: 一解御祝融，晷正長，南極星輝朗。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: the emperor addressed Zhurong; the sundial's shadow stood at its longest; the South Pole star shone bright.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: The emperor addressed Zhurong; the sundial's shadow stood at its longest, and the South Pole star shone bright.

sentences.zh: 駕硃輅，萬騎騰驤。

translations.literal: He drove the vermilion carriage; ten thousand riders surged and pranced.
translations.idiomatic: He drove the vermilion carriage, and ten thousand riders surged and pranced.

sentences.zh: 贊俊傑，遂賢良。

translations.literal: He praised the outstanding and advanced the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: He praised the outstanding and advanced the worthy.

sentences.zh: 二解蓐收節，露華初降，金風乍涼，兌列西方。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: at Rushou's season, dew's splendor first fell, the golden wind suddenly cooled, and Dui stood arrayed in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: At Rushou's season dew first fell, the golden wind turned cool, and the Dui trigram position stood in the west.

sentences.zh: 載白旗，乘戎輅，移天仗。

translations.literal: He bore the white banner, rode the military carriage, and moved the heavenly escort.
translations.idiomatic: He bore the white banner, rode the military carriage, and moved the heavenly escort.

sentences.zh: 萬寶告成，一人有慶天垂貺。

translations.literal: The myriad treasures were announced complete; the One Man had cause to rejoice, and heaven bestowed its gift.
translations.idiomatic: The myriad treasures were announced complete; the One Man rejoiced, and heaven bestowed its gift.

sentences.zh: 三解顓帝司方，水泉始涸，天際彩虹藏。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: Zhuanxu governed the quarter; springs and streams first dried; rainbows at heaven's edge were hidden.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: Zhuanxu governed the quarter; springs and streams first dried, and rainbows at heaven's edge withdrew.

sentences.zh: 乘元輅，駕鐵驪，雲衢滉瀁。

translations.literal: He rode the primal carriage, drove iron-black steeds, and the cloud highways billowed wide.
translations.idiomatic: He rode the primal carriage, drove iron-black steeds, and the cloud highways billowed wide.

sentences.zh: 萬疊明霞奉太陽，四時節物邀歡賞。

translations.literal: Ten thousand folds of bright rosy clouds attended the sun; the seasonal things of the four seasons invited joy and viewing.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand folds of bright clouds attended the sun; the seasonal sights of the four quarters invited joy and viewing.

sentences.zh: 四解皇謨聖德欽無兩，舜日光天壤。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: the emperor's design and sage virtue were revered without peer; Shun's sun lit heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: The emperor's design and sage virtue were revered without peer; Shun's sun lit heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 花明采仗齊，雲暖龍旗颺。

translations.literal: Flowers gleamed and ceremonial regalia stood in ranks; warm clouds lifted and dragon banners fluttered.
translations.idiomatic: Flowers gleamed and ceremonial regalia stood in ranks; warm clouds lifted and dragon banners fluttered.

sentences.zh: 際昌時，咸翹企仙輿降。

translations.literal: At this flourishing age, all craned their necks in hope that the immortal carriage would descend.
translations.idiomatic: In this flourishing age, all craned their necks in hope that the immortal carriage would descend.

sentences.zh: 際昌時，咸翹企仙輿降。

translations.literal: At this flourishing age, all craned their necks in hope that the immortal carriage would descend.
translations.idiomatic: In this flourishing age, all craned their necks in hope that the immortal carriage would descend.

sentences.zh: 五解

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5

sentences.zh: 承天眷第三承天眷，際風雲，萬國車書奉一人。

translations.literal: Receiving Heaven's Favor, third: receiving heaven's favor, meeting wind and cloud, ten thousand states' carts and writing served the One Man.
translations.idiomatic: Receiving Heaven's Favor, No. 3: Favored by heaven and meeting wind and cloud, the myriad states' carts and scripts served the One Man.

sentences.zh: 衣冠快睹唐虞盛，九域抒丹悃。

translations.literal: Robes and caps rejoiced to behold the splendor of Tang and Yu; the nine regions poured forth crimson sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Court and people rejoiced to behold a splendor like Tang and Yu; the nine regions poured forth heartfelt loyalty.

sentences.zh: 殊荒重譯盡來庭，和氣召嘉禎。

translations.literal: Remote lands through repeated translation all came to court; harmonious qi summoned auspicious omens.
translations.idiomatic: Remote lands, through repeated translation, all came to court; harmonious qi summoned auspicious omens.

sentences.zh: 一解稽古訓，溯昌辰。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: he examined ancient instruction and traced flourishing times.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: He examined ancient instruction and traced flourishing times.

sentences.zh: 元首明哉勵股肱，一心敬怠丹書儆。

translations.literal: The chief was enlightened! He encouraged his arms and legs; with one heart he heeded the red-book warning against slackness.
translations.idiomatic: The chief was enlightened! He encouraged his ministers; with one heart he heeded the red-book warning against slackness.

sentences.zh: 宵旰不遑寧，日新又日憲湯銘，翼翼更欽欽。

translations.literal: From dusk to dawn he had no leisure for rest; day by day he renewed himself, taking Tang's inscription as his model, ever more reverent and diligent.
translations.idiomatic: From dusk to dawn he had no leisure for rest; day by day he renewed himself, taking Tang's inscription as his model, ever more reverent and diligent.

sentences.zh: 二解端不為，繁華麗，錦繡春。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: truly he did not act for splendor and glory, brocade and spring.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: Truly he did not act for splendor and glory, brocade and spring.

sentences.zh: 端不為，玉樹菁蔥太液澄。

translations.literal: Truly he did not act for jade trees lush and green, nor for the Taiye Pool's clear waters.
translations.idiomatic: Truly he did not act for jade trees lush and green, nor for the Taiye Pool's clear waters.

sentences.zh: 喜今日，調和玉燭烽煙靖。

translations.literal: He rejoiced that today the jade candle was harmonized and beacon fires were stilled.
translations.idiomatic: He rejoiced that today the jade candle was harmonized and beacon fires were stilled.

sentences.zh: 不敢忘，百年有備軍容整。

translations.literal: He dared not forget: for a hundred years readiness must be kept and military bearing kept trim.
translations.idiomatic: He dared not forget: for a hundred years readiness must be kept and military bearing kept trim.

sentences.zh: 那辭得，陳師鞠旅擁旄旌。

translations.literal: How could he decline to array the hosts, drill the troops, and bear banners and pennants?
translations.idiomatic: How could he decline to array the hosts, drill the troops, and bear banners and pennants?

sentences.zh: 皇衷切，憂盛更危明。

translations.literal: The imperial heart was earnest: in prosperity he was yet more mindful of peril.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial heart was earnest: in prosperity he was yet more mindful of peril.

sentences.zh: 三解泰階奕奕璣衡正，功業麟兮炳。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: the Grand Stairway gleamed and the armillary sphere stood true; his achievements blazed like the qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: The Grand Stairway gleamed and the armillary sphere stood true; his achievements blazed like the qilin.

sentences.zh: 千春清晏歌，億載登豐慶。

translations.literal: For a thousand springs, songs of clear peace; for a hundred million years, celebrations of abundant harvest.
translations.idiomatic: For a thousand springs, songs of clear peace; for a hundred million years, celebrations of abundant harvest.

sentences.zh: 喜金支，紛旖旎，蓬山境。

translations.literal: They rejoiced in golden branches, riotous splendor, the realm of Mount Penglai.
translations.idiomatic: They rejoiced in golden branches, riotous splendor, the realm of Mount Penglai.

sentences.zh: 喜金支，紛旖旎，蓬山境。

translations.literal: They rejoiced in golden branches, riotous splendor, the realm of Mount Penglai.
translations.idiomatic: They rejoiced in golden branches, riotous splendor, the realm of Mount Penglai.

sentences.zh: 四解

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4

sentences.zh: 貢琛球第四琛球輸貢，外籓歸化隸版圖，正朔咸尊奉。

translations.literal: Tribute of Gems and Spheres, fourth: gems and spheres were brought in tribute; outer domains returned to civilization and were entered on the maps; the calendar and regnal title were all honored and followed.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute of Gems and Spheres, No. 4: Gems and spheres were brought in tribute; outer domains returned to civilization and were entered on the maps; the calendar and regnal title were all honored and followed.

sentences.zh: 樂浪郡，在海東，安南國，粵嶠辟蠶叢。

translations.literal: Lelang Commandery lay beyond the eastern sea; Annam opened the Yue ranges and the land of Cancong.
translations.idiomatic: Lelang Commandery lay beyond the eastern sea; Annam opened the Yue ranges and the land of Cancong.

sentences.zh: 日本國，畏威震悚。

translations.literal: The state of Japan, awed by might, trembled in fear.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Japan, awed by might, trembled in fear.

sentences.zh: 琉球國，奉朝請與內臣同。

translations.literal: The state of Ryukyu attended court audiences like inner officials.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Ryukyu attended court audiences like inner officials.

sentences.zh: 一解萬邦虎拜咸修貢，干羽何須用。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: ten thousand states bowed like tigers and all presented tribute; what need was there for shields and feathers?
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Ten thousand states bowed like tigers and all presented tribute; what need was there for shields and feathers?

sentences.zh: 東風入律吹，干呂青雲涌。

translations.literal: The east wind entered the pitch-pipes and blew; the qian and lü tones made azure clouds surge.
translations.idiomatic: The east wind entered the pitch-pipes and blew; the qian and lü tones made azure clouds surge.

sentences.zh: 海安瀾，更上獻河清頌。

translations.literal: The seas were calm; they further presented hymns to the River's clarity.
translations.idiomatic: The seas were calm; they further presented hymns to the River's clarity.

sentences.zh: 海安瀾，更上獻河清頌。

translations.literal: The seas were calm; they further presented hymns to the River's clarity.
translations.idiomatic: The seas were calm; they further presented hymns to the River's clarity.

sentences.zh: 二解

translations.literal: Second stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2

sentences.zh: 錦繡乾坤第五錦繡乾坤佳麗，御世立綱陳紀，四朝輯瑞徵師濟。

translations.literal: Brocade Cosmos, fifth: the brocade cosmos was fair; governing the age he set forth norms and arrayed statutes; four reigns gathered auspicious signs and marked masters aiding one another.
translations.idiomatic: Brocade Cosmos, No. 5: The brocade cosmos was fair; governing the age he set forth norms and arrayed statutes; four reigns gathered auspicious signs and marked masters aiding one another.

sentences.zh: 盼皇畿，雲開雉扇移。

translations.literal: They gazed toward the imperial precinct; clouds parted and pheasant fans moved.
translations.idiomatic: They gazed toward the imperial precinct; clouds parted and pheasant fans moved.

sentences.zh: 黎民引領鑾輿至，安堵村村颺酒旗。

translations.literal: The common people craned their necks as the imperial carriage arrived; in settled villages wine banners fluttered at every gate.
translations.idiomatic: The common people craned their necks as the imperial carriage arrived; in settled villages wine banners fluttered at every gate.

sentences.zh: 恬熙，御爐中，靉靆瑞煙霏。

translations.literal: Peace and prosperity: in the imperial censer, thick auspicious smoke drifted.
translations.idiomatic: Peace and prosperity: in the imperial censer, thick auspicious smoke drifted.

sentences.zh: 恬熙，御爐中，靉靆瑞煙霏。

translations.literal: Peace and prosperity: in the imperial censer, thick auspicious smoke drifted.
translations.idiomatic: Peace and prosperity: in the imperial censer, thick auspicious smoke drifted.

sentences.zh: 一解鸞聲嘒嘒來雲際，九奏韶鈞沸。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: phoenix notes trilled from beyond the clouds; nine performances of Shao music and chime-stones seethed.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Phoenix notes trilled from beyond the clouds; nine performances of Shao music and chime-stones seethed.

sentences.zh: 觀光仰赤球，扈從盈硃芾。

translations.literal: They viewed the splendor and looked up to the crimson orb; attendants in vermilion knee-guards filled the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: They viewed the splendor and looked up to the crimson orb; attendants in vermilion knee-guards filled the ranks.

sentences.zh: 奉皇歡，晝三接，天顏喜。

translations.literal: They offered the emperor's joy; thrice by day they were received, and the heavenly countenance was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: They offered the emperor's joy; thrice by day they were received, and the heavenly countenance was pleased.

sentences.zh: 奉皇歡，晝三接，天顏喜。

translations.literal: They offered the emperor's joy; thrice by day they were received, and the heavenly countenance was pleased.
translations.idiomatic: They offered the emperor's joy; thrice by day they were received, and the heavenly countenance was pleased.

sentences.zh: 二解

translations.literal: Second stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2

sentences.zh: 中天盛世第六中天盛世鬯安寧，瑞麥嘉禾表歲成。

translations.literal: Flourishing Age at the Center, sixth: the flourishing age at the center was fragrant and tranquil; auspicious wheat and fine grain showed the year's completion.
translations.idiomatic: Flourishing Age at the Center, No. 6: The flourishing age at the center was fragrant and tranquil; auspicious wheat and fine grain showed the year's completion.

sentences.zh: 騶虞白象出郊坰，共祝吾皇聖，嵩岳欣傳萬歲聲。

translations.literal: Zouyu and white elephants appeared beyond the suburbs; all wished our emperor sage; Mount Song joyfully transmitted the ten-thousand-years cry.
translations.idiomatic: Zouyu and white elephants appeared beyond the suburbs; all wished our emperor sage; Mount Song joyfully transmitted the cry of ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 蔥蘢佳氣滿都城，萬里皇圖鞏帝京。

translations.literal: Lush auspicious qi filled the capital; the imperial design for ten thousand li secured the emperor's city.
translations.idiomatic: Lush auspicious qi filled the capital; the imperial design for ten thousand li secured the emperor's city.

sentences.zh: 衣冠文物際時亨，海隅寧謐無邊警。

translations.literal: Robes, caps, culture, and artifacts met a timely prosperity; the sea's corners were tranquil with no border alarms.
translations.idiomatic: Robes, caps, culture, and artifacts met a timely prosperity; the sea's corners were tranquil with no border alarms.

sentences.zh: 巷舞衢歌樂太平，喜今日，金甌一統萬年清。

translations.literal: Lanes danced and streets sang, rejoicing in great peace; they rejoiced that today the golden bowl was unified and ten thousand years were clear.
translations.idiomatic: Lanes danced and streets sang, rejoicing in great peace; they rejoiced that today the golden realm was unified and ten thousand years were clear.

sentences.zh: 遍閭閻，操縵歌風弦誦興。

translations.literal: Throughout the wards and lanes, they played silk songs and wind strings and recitation flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the wards and lanes, they played silk songs and wind strings and recitation flourished.

sentences.zh: 更郊原，野蠶成繭柘陰輕。

translations.literal: Further, in the suburban fields, wild silkworms formed cocoons and mulberry shade lay light.
translations.idiomatic: Further, in the suburban fields, wild silkworms formed cocoons and mulberry shade lay light.

sentences.zh: 一解時和歲稔調金鼎，鳳扆花相映。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: the season was harmonious and the year abundant; the golden tripod was tuned, and phoenix-screen flowers shone together.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: The season was harmonious and the year abundant; the golden tripod was tuned, and phoenix-screen flowers shone together.

sentences.zh: 青疇麥兩歧，黃隴禾同穎。

translations.literal: In green fields wheat bore double ears; on yellow uplands grain shared the same heads.
translations.idiomatic: In green fields wheat bore double ears; on yellow uplands grain shared the same heads.

sentences.zh: 屬車臨，喜萬歲，聲遙應。

translations.literal: When the attendant carriages drew near, they rejoiced in ten thousand years; voices answered from afar.
translations.idiomatic: When the attendant carriages drew near, they rejoiced in ten thousand years; voices answered from afar.

sentences.zh: 屬車臨，喜萬歲，聲遙應。

translations.literal: When the attendant carriages drew near, they rejoiced in ten thousand years; voices answered from afar.
translations.idiomatic: When the attendant carriages drew near, they rejoiced in ten thousand years; voices answered from afar.

sentences.zh: 二解

translations.literal: Second stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2

sentences.zh: 奉宸歡第七奉宸歡，天單厚。

translations.literal: Offering the Emperor's Joy, seventh: offering the emperor's joy; heaven's canopy was thick.
translations.idiomatic: Offering the Emperor's Joy, No. 7: Offering the emperor's joy; heaven's canopy was thick.

sentences.zh: 風光輦路浮，遐阡邇陌，都是黃雲覆。

translations.literal: Scenery floated along the imperial roadway; distant paths and near lanes were all covered in yellow clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Scenery floated along the imperial roadway; distant paths and near lanes were all covered in yellow clouds.

sentences.zh: 羽蓋春旗，斒<文粦>似綉。

translations.literal: Feathered canopies and spring banners, variegated like brocade.
translations.idiomatic: Feathered canopies and spring banners, variegated like brocade.

sentences.zh: 正田家作苦勸耕時，休馳驟，金鐙鞭敲，豹尾懸車後。

translations.literal: Just as farm folk toiled and he urged plowing, he ceased galloping; golden stirrups and whip-taps, leopard tails hung behind the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Just as farm folk toiled and he urged plowing, he ceased galloping; golden stirrups and whip-taps, leopard tails hung behind the carriage.

sentences.zh: 藏富於民，於民藏富。

translations.literal: He stored wealth among the people; among the people he stored wealth.
translations.idiomatic: He stored wealth among the people; among the people he stored wealth.

sentences.zh: 晴開五雲第八晴開五雲移翠輦，臣庶咸歡忭。

translations.literal: Clear Skies and Five Clouds, eighth: clear skies opened and five clouds moved the emerald carriage; officials and commoners all rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 惟祝君王真有道，廑恫，薄賦輕徭。

translations.literal: They only prayed the ruler truly had the Way, cared anxiously for the people, and kept taxes light and corvée light.
translations.idiomatic: They only prayed the ruler truly had the Way, cared anxiously for the people, and kept taxes light and corvée light.

sentences.zh: 敷教澤，愛親敬老。

translations.literal: He spread teaching and grace, loving kin and honoring the aged.
translations.idiomatic: He spread teaching and grace, loving kin and honoring the aged.

sentences.zh: 黎民歡樂，道餘糧棲畝，又長嘉苗道餘糧棲畝，又長嘉苗。

translations.literal: The common people rejoiced, saying surplus grain rested in the fields and fine seedlings grew again—surplus grain rested in the fields and fine seedlings grew again.
translations.idiomatic: The common people rejoiced, saying surplus grain rested in the fields and fine seedlings grew again—surplus grain rested in the fields and fine seedlings grew again.

sentences.zh: 五解

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5

sentences.zh: 嘉祥曲第十五溯嘉祥，華平硃草毓中唐。

translations.literal: Auspicious Omens Song, fifteenth: tracing auspicious omens, Huaping and vermilion grass flourished in mid-Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious Omens Song, No. 15: Tracing auspicious omens, Huaping and vermilion grass flourished in mid-Tang.

sentences.zh: 龍圖授，龜書畀，擾澤馬，駕騰黃。

translations.literal: The dragon chart was bestowed, the tortoise book granted; tame marsh horses were yoked to soaring yellow steeds.
translations.idiomatic: The dragon chart was bestowed, the tortoise book granted; tame marsh horses were yoked to soaring yellow steeds.

sentences.zh: 延喜玉，從天貺。

translations.literal: Yanxi jade came as a gift from heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Yanxi jade came as a gift from heaven.

sentences.zh: 屈軼草，階前長。

translations.literal: Quyi grass grew before the steps.
translations.idiomatic: Quyi grass grew before the steps.

sentences.zh: 一解睹榮光，白麟赤雁與芝房。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: they beheld glorious light, white qilin, red wild geese, and mushroom chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: They beheld glorious light, white qilin, red wild geese, and mushroom chambers.

sentences.zh: 遊河渚，赤文綠字；

translations.literal: They roamed the river islets; red script and green characters;
translations.idiomatic: They roamed the river islets; red script and green characters;

sentences.zh: 舒蘭葉，五色成章。

translations.literal: orchid leaves unfolded, five colors forming patterns.
translations.idiomatic: orchid leaves unfolded, five colors forming patterns.

sentences.zh: 仙蓂葉葉滋春圃，瑞羽鏘鏘鳴女床。

translations.literal: Immortal caltrop leaves leaf by leaf enriched the spring garden; auspicious feathers clanged and rang on the Maiden's Couch.
translations.idiomatic: Immortal caltrop leaves leaf by leaf enriched the spring garden; auspicious feathers clanged and rang on the Maiden's Couch.

sentences.zh: 亦有祥麟一角，和鳴鳳，在高岡。

translations.idiomatic: There was also an auspicious qilin with a single horn, and a harmoniously singing phoenix on the high ridge.

sentences.zh: 二解日重光，戴冠抱珥出扶桑。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: the sun redoubled in light, crowned and wearing ear ornaments, rose from Fusang.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: The sun redoubled in light, crowned and jeweled, rose from Fusang.

sentences.zh: 月重輝，星重潤，玉繩轉，南極熒煌。

translations.literal: The moon redoubled in splendor, the stars redoubled in luster, the jade cord turned, and the South Pole star blazed bright.
translations.idiomatic: The moon redoubled in splendor, the stars redoubled in luster, the jade cord turned, and the South Pole star blazed bright.

sentences.zh: 竹葦露，甘如釀，蒲萐風，如秋爽。

translations.literal: Dew on bamboo and reeds, sweet as ferment; wind through pu grass, fresh as autumn's cool.
translations.idiomatic: Dew on bamboo and reeds, sweet as ferment; wind through pu grass, fresh as autumn's cool.

sentences.zh: 三解舞鸞凰，非煙樓閣繡衣裳。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: luan and phoenix danced; misty pavilions wore embroidered robes.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: Luan and phoenix danced; misty pavilions wore embroidered robes.

sentences.zh: 寶鼎見，騶虞出，浮沆瀣泛天漿。

translations.literal: The precious tripod appeared, the zouyu emerged, and floating sweet dew overflowed as heavenly nectar.
translations.idiomatic: The precious tripod appeared, the zouyu emerged, and floating sweet dew overflowed as heavenly nectar.

sentences.zh: 稽往牒，探珊網。

translations.literal: They examined past records and searched coral nets.
translations.idiomatic: They examined past records and searched coral nets.

sentences.zh: 陳瑞物，難名狀。

translations.literal: They displayed auspicious objects, hard to name or describe.
translations.idiomatic: They displayed auspicious objects, hard to name or describe.

sentences.zh: 四解惟我皇，不矜異物與殊祥。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: only our emperor does not boast of strange things and special omens.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: Only our emperor does not boast of strange things and special omens.

sentences.zh: 辟四門，明四目，求俊乂，顯賢良。

translations.literal: He opened the four gates, cleared the four eyes, sought outstanding talent, and displayed the worthy and good.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the four gates, cleared the four eyes, sought outstanding talent, and displayed the worthy and good.

sentences.zh: 愛稼穡，垂旒纊。

translations.literal: He loved the crops, and let his tassels and cap-strings hang down.
translations.idiomatic: He loved the crops, and let his tassels and cap-strings hang down in humility.

sentences.zh: 措吾民，春台上。

translations.literal: He placed our people upon the spring terrace.
translations.idiomatic: He placed our people upon the spring terrace.

sentences.zh: 五解

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5

sentences.zh: 練吉日第十六練吉日兮撰佳辰，百僚具兮輿衛陳。

translations.literal: Selecting Auspicious Days, sixteenth: selecting auspicious days—choosing fine dates; all officials assembled—chariots and guards arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: Selecting Auspicious Days, No. 16: On an auspicious day they chose a fine date; all officials assembled and chariots and guards were arrayed.

sentences.zh: 屏翳弭節兮，玉宇無塵。

translations.literal: Pingyi reined in his team—the jade firmament was without dust.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyi reined in his team—the jade firmament was without dust.

sentences.zh: 煌煌兮斗車，奕奕兮天輪。

translations.literal: Dazzling—the Dipper chariot; brilliant—the heavenly wheel.
translations.idiomatic: Dazzling—the Dipper chariot; brilliant—the heavenly wheel.

sentences.zh: 一解命太常兮奉牲，用昭告兮百神，潔粢盛兮肅明禋。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: he charged the Minister of Rites to present the sacrificial victim; to make clear proclamation to the hundred spirits; clean grain offerings—solemn bright sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: He charged the Minister of Rites to present the sacrificial victim, to proclaim clearly to the hundred spirits, and to offer clean grain in solemn, bright sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 將展軨兮效駕行，下觀兮勤民。

translations.literal: About to extend the carriage shaft—effect the imperial procession; descend to observe—the people's diligence.
translations.idiomatic: About to extend the carriage shaft and set the imperial procession in motion, he would descend to observe the people's diligence.

sentences.zh: 二解甸師清畿兮，縟草如茵。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: the border commander cleared the capital region—layered grass like a mat.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: The border commander cleared the capital region—layered grass like a mat.

sentences.zh: 野廬歸路兮，香霧承輪。

translations.literal: Field lodges lined the return road—fragrant mist received the wheels.
translations.idiomatic: Field lodges lined the return road—fragrant mist received the wheels.

sentences.zh: 封人設枑兮，左槭右平。

translations.literal: Border guards set barriers—left cleared, right level.
translations.idiomatic: Border guards set barriers—left cleared, right level.

sentences.zh: 掌舍具儀兮，爰象太宸。

translations.literal: Pavilion hosts prepared the rites—thus mirroring the Great Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Pavilion hosts prepared the rites—thus mirroring the Great Palace.

sentences.zh: 玉輦兮鏘鏘，屬車兮隱轔。

translations.literal: The jade palanquin—clang clang; attendant chariots—rumbling hidden.
translations.idiomatic: The jade palanquin—clanging; attendant chariots—rumbling hidden.

sentences.zh: 三解扇微颸兮清幰，扈細靄兮硃輪。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: fans and gentle breezes—fresh carriage curtains; attendants and fine haze—vermilion wheels.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: Fans and gentle breezes—fresh carriage curtains; attendants and fine haze—vermilion wheels.

sentences.zh: 備天官兮周衛，盛輿服兮時巡。

translations.literal: Heaven officials fully equipped as guards—grand carriages and robes—the seasonal imperial tour.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven officials fully equipped as guards—grand carriages and robes—the seasonal imperial tour.

sentences.zh: 虎賁兮肅肅，徒旅兮駪駪。

translations.literal: Tiger guards—solemn solemn; foot soldiers—numerous and orderly.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger guards—solemn; foot soldiers—numerous and orderly.

sentences.zh: 四解前驅兮按部，後隊兮如鱗。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: the vanguard pressed forward; the rear columns like scales.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: The vanguard pressed forward; the rear columns like scales.

sentences.zh: 徵萬玉兮警途，詔弭策兮入神。

translations.literal: They summoned ten thousand jade bells to clear the way; decreed to rein in whips—entering the sacred precinct.
translations.idiomatic: They summoned ten thousand jade bells to clear the way; decreed to rein in whips—entering the sacred precinct.

sentences.zh: 五解軼浮景兮騰青霄，駟蒼螭兮驂絕塵。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: speeding like floating light—soaring into the azure sky; four dark dragons as team—outriders beyond all dust.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: Speeding like floating light—soaring into the azure sky; four dark dragons as team—outriders beyond all dust.

translations.literal: Climbing high ridges—rolling and lofty; ascending peak hills—wheels turning.
translations.idiomatic: Climbing high ridges—rolling and lofty; ascending peak hills—wheels turning.

sentences.zh: 六解仰皇輿兮肅震，岳獻圖兮川貢珍。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: looking up to the imperial carriage—solemn awe; mountains presented charts, rivers offered treasures.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: Looking up to the imperial carriage—solemn awe; mountains presented charts, rivers offered treasures.

sentences.zh: 若湛露之晞朝陽兮，儼列宿之拱北辰。

translations.literal: Like heavy dew drying in the morning sun; as if the arrayed stars bowed to the North Star.
translations.idiomatic: Like heavy dew drying in the morning sun; as if the arrayed stars bowed to the North Star.

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: sheltered under the imperial canopy—supporting Gouchen; silk and fine brocades gathered—banners and flags moving in procession.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: Sheltered under the imperial canopy—supporting Gouchen; silk and fine brocades gathered—banners and flags moving in procession.

sentences.zh: 配帝居之元圃兮，象太乙之威神。

translations.literal: Matching the Emperor's dwelling in the primal garden; mirroring Taiyi's awesome divinity.
translations.idiomatic: Matching the Emperor's dwelling in the primal garden; mirroring Taiyi's awesome divinity.

sentences.zh: 八解旖旎兮霓旌，八方兮列陳。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: graceful—rainbow banners; the eight directions—arrayed in ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: Graceful—rainbow banners; the eight directions—arrayed in ranks.

sentences.zh: 表硃兮離位，植皁兮元冥。

translations.literal: Red displayed at the Li position; black planted at the Dark Primordial.
translations.idiomatic: Red displayed at the Li position; black planted at the Dark Primordial.

translations.literal: White silk banners flying at Dui; green standing upright at Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: White silk banners flying at Dui; green standing upright at Zhen.

sentences.zh: 九解流星旄而電屬兮，盼坱圠以無垠。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: meteor banners and lightning chains; vast and boundless infinity.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Meteor banners and lightning chains; vast and boundless infinity.

translations.literal: Nine flags varied and pennants raised; five chariots winding gracefully connecting axles.
translations.idiomatic: Nine flags varied and pennants raised; five chariots winding gracefully connecting axles.

sentences.zh: 盛天下之壯觀兮，將豐鎬之是遵。

translations.literal: The grand sight of all under heaven; following the model of Feng and Hao.
translations.idiomatic: The grand sight of all under heaven; following the model of Feng and Hao.

sentences.zh: 頌高山之荒作兮，仰一人之饗親。

translations.literal: Praising the high mountain's founding work; looking up to the One Man's joy in receiving kin.
translations.idiomatic: Praising the high mountain's founding work; looking up to the One Man's joy in receiving kin.

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10

translations.literal: Visiting Pearl Mound, seventeenth: visiting Pearl Mound—dim mist among pines and zelkovas.
translations.idiomatic: Visiting Pearl Mound, No. 17: Visiting Pearl Mound—dim mist among pines and zelkovas.

sentences.zh: 展几筵，敬仰先猷。

translations.idiomatic: They spread the table and mats, reverently honoring the forefathers' design.

translations.literal: The state's accumulated virtue is only sincerity and depth—steadfast as Duke Liu.
translations.idiomatic: The state's accumulated virtue is only sincerity and depth—steadfast as Duke Liu.

sentences.zh: 一解緬音容，霜露春秋。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: recalling his countenance and voice—frost and dew through spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Recalling his countenance and voice—frost and dew through spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 設綴衣，大貝天球。

translations.idiomatic: They placed the ceremonial robe, the great cowrie, and the heavenly orb.

translations.literal: Almost hearing and dimly seeing as if face to face; tracing back former blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Almost hearing and dimly seeing as if face to face; tracing back former blessings.

sentences.zh: 二解奉犧尊，旨酒思柔。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: presenting the sacrificial vessel—fine wine bringing gentle thoughts.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: Presenting the sacrificial vessel—fine wine bringing gentle thoughts.

sentences.zh: 覲羹牆，蘋藻初羞，萬方玉食尊親久。

translations.literal: Beholding virtue as if on a wall; duckweed and water-grass as first offerings; jade food from ten thousand regions—honoring kin long.
translations.idiomatic: Beholding virtue as if on a wall; duckweed and water-grass as first offerings; jade food from ten thousand regions—honoring kin long.

sentences.zh: 無須效，漢代衣冠月出遊。

translations.literal: No need to imitate—the Han dynasty officials touring by moonlight.
translations.idiomatic: No need to imitate—the Han dynasty officials touring by moonlight.

sentences.zh: 三解寢園展祀尊堂構，文謨武烈光前後。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: the mausoleum garden held rites honoring the hall's founding; civil design and martial glory shining before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: The mausoleum garden held rites honoring the hall's founding; civil design and martial glory shining before and after.

translations.literal: Lush auspicious vapors floated; ethereal auspicious clouds embroidered.
translations.idiomatic: Lush auspicious vapors floated; ethereal auspicious clouds embroidered.

sentences.zh: 億萬載，升恆景福從天祐。

translations.literal: For ten thousand myriad years—rising eternally, splendid fortune from heaven's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand myriad years—rising eternally, splendid fortune from heaven's blessing.

sentences.zh: 四解高山天作扶輿秀，遼海環其右。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: high mountain heaven-made—the blessed land's beauty; Liaodong sea encircles its right.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: High mountain heaven-made—the blessed land's beauty; Liaodong sea encircles its right.

sentences.zh: 鍾祥瑞氣蟠，翊運靈光茂。

translations.literal: Auspicious vapor coiled; aiding destiny, spiritual light flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious vapor coiled; aiding destiny, spiritual light flourishing.

sentences.zh: 萬斯年，永奠定，天同壽。

translations.literal: For ten thousand years—forever established, heaven shares long life.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years—forever established, heaven shares long life.

sentences.zh: 萬斯年，永奠定，天同壽。

translations.literal: For ten thousand years—forever established, heaven shares long life.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand years—forever established, heaven shares long life.

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5

sentences.zh: 御黼座第十八御黼座，肅朝儀，沛宮法駕陳元會。

translations.literal: At the Imperial Brocade Throne, eighteenth: at the brocade throne—solemn court ritual; Pei Palace-style imperial procession arrayed for the New Year audience.
translations.idiomatic: At the Imperial Brocade Throne, No. 18: At the brocade throne—solemn court ritual; Pei Palace-style imperial procession arrayed for the New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 雲深處，天門詄盪，太極崔巍。

translations.literal: Deep within the clouds; the Heavenly Gate resounding; the Grand Ultimate towering.
translations.idiomatic: Deep within the clouds; the Heavenly Gate resounding; the Grand Ultimate towering.

sentences.zh: 一解九賓設，彤闈啟，扶桑初擁曈曨日。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: nine guest ranks set, vermilion gates open; Fusang first embraced the dawning sun.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Nine guest ranks set, vermilion gates open; Fusang first embraced the dawning sun.

sentences.zh: 傳臚句，群僚濟濟，百辟師師。

translations.literal: The herald announced the phrases; officials assembled in abundance; nobles orderly and reverent.
translations.idiomatic: The herald announced the phrases; officials assembled in abundance; nobles orderly and reverent.

sentences.zh: 盡呼嵩，冠帶委蛇。

translations.literal: All called out "Mount Song"; caps and sashes flowing gracefully.
translations.idiomatic: All called out "Mount Song"; caps and sashes flowing gracefully.

sentences.zh: 二解獻琛球，圖王會，呼韓稽顙瞻雲日。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: they presented tribute spheres; charted the royal assembly; the Khagan prostrated to behold cloud and sun.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: They presented tribute spheres; charted the royal assembly; the Khagan prostrated to behold cloud and sun.

sentences.zh: 無中外，雕題鑿齒，烏弋黃支。

translations.literal: Without inner or outer distinction—tattooed foreheads, filed teeth, Wuyi and Huangzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Without inner or outer distinction—tattooed foreheads, filed teeth, Wuyi and Huangzhi.

sentences.zh: 慶躬逢，盛世威儀。

translations.literal: They rejoiced to encounter in person—the august age's majestic presence.
translations.idiomatic: They rejoiced to encounter in person—the august age's majestic presence.

sentences.zh: 三解中天華闕浮佳氣，締造經營萬載基。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: at mid-heaven the splendid gate floated auspicious vapor; founding and building a foundation for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: At mid-heaven the splendid gate floated auspicious vapor; founding and building a foundation for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 世德念豳岐，天澤陳冠履。

translations.literal: Hereditary virtue recalled Bin and Qi; heaven's grace displayed in caps and shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Hereditary virtue recalled Bin and Qi; heaven's grace displayed in caps and shoes.

sentences.zh: 看到處，祥颸晻靄，羽蓋葳蕤。

translations.literal: Everywhere one looked—auspicious breezes and dim mist; feathered canopies lush and full.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere one looked—auspicious breezes and dim mist; feathered canopies lush and full.

sentences.zh: 看到處，祥颸晻靄，羽蓋葳蕤。

translations.literal: Everywhere one looked—auspicious breezes and dim mist; feathered canopies lush and full.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere one looked—auspicious breezes and dim mist; feathered canopies lush and full.

sentences.zh: 四解

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4

sentences.zh: 長白山第十九長白山，遠峙開原，冠高峰，峻極於天。

translations.literal: Mount Changbai, nineteenth: Mount Changbai—far standing at Kaiyuan; crowning the peaks, utmost steepness reaching heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Changbai, No. 19: Mount Changbai—far standing at Kaiyuan; crowning the peaks, utmost steepness reaching heaven.

sentences.zh: 巉岩兮插漢，千里兮巑岏。

translations.literal: Jagged cliffs piercing the Milky Way; a thousand li of rolling peaks.
translations.idiomatic: Jagged cliffs piercing the Milky Way; a thousand li of rolling peaks.

sentences.zh: 一解考山經，曾傳不咸，稽地誌，亦號商堅。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: consulting the Classic of Mountains—once transmitted as Buxian; checking geographical records—also called Shangjian.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Consulting the Classic of Mountains—once transmitted as Buxian; checking geographical records—also called Shangjian.

sentences.zh: 唐名兮太白，有潭兮在顛。

translations.literal: Its Tang name—Taibai; a pool on the summit.
translations.idiomatic: Its Tang name—Taibai; a pool on the summit.

sentences.zh: 二解闥門潭，萬頃回湍，鼓天風，灧文瀾。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: Taimen Pool—ten thousand qing of eddying currents; beating heaven's wind, shimmering patterned waves.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: Taimen Pool—ten thousand qing of eddying currents; beating heaven's wind, shimmering patterned waves.

sentences.zh: 源深兮流廣，三江兮出焉。

translations.literal: Source deep, flow broad; three rivers issue from there.
translations.idiomatic: Source deep, flow broad; three rivers issue from there.

sentences.zh: 三解鴨綠江，流自山南。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: the Yalu River—flows from south of the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: The Yalu River—flows from south of the mountain.

sentences.zh: 混同江，北海之源。

translations.literal: The Hunhe River—source of the northern sea.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunhe River—source of the northern sea.

sentences.zh: 愛滹兮東注，萬折兮千盤。

translations.literal: The Ai and Hutuo rivers flowing east; ten thousand bends and thousand coils.
translations.idiomatic: The Ai and Hutuo rivers flowing east; ten thousand bends and thousand coils.

sentences.zh: 四解醫無閭，縹緲雲端。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: Mount Yiwulu—ethereal in the cloud tops.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: Mount Yiwulu—ethereal in the cloud tops.

sentences.zh: 桃花洞，下有飛泉。

translations.literal: Peach Blossom Cave—below it a flying spring.
translations.idiomatic: Peach Blossom Cave—below it a flying spring.

sentences.zh: 嚴冬兮不冰，常燠兮無寒。

translations.literal: In harsh winter—no ice; always warm—no cold.
translations.idiomatic: In harsh winter—no ice; always warm—no cold.

sentences.zh: 五解木葉山，石磴盤桓。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: Muye Mountain—stone steps winding.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: Muye Mountain—stone steps winding.

sentences.zh: 華表山，鶴影蹁躚。

translations.literal: Huabiao Mountain—crane shadows dancing.
translations.idiomatic: Huabiao Mountain—crane shadows dancing.

sentences.zh: 乳峰兮懸溜，井冽兮寒泉。

translations.literal: Nipple peaks—hanging cascades; well water clear—cold spring.
translations.idiomatic: Nipple peaks—hanging cascades; well water clear—cold spring.

sentences.zh: 六解石門谿，屹立岩前。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: Shimen Stream—standing firm before the cliffs.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: Shimen Stream—standing firm before the cliffs.

sentences.zh: 儼雙扉，雲壑連綿。

translations.literal: Like twin doors; cloud ravines stretching on.
translations.idiomatic: Like twin doors; cloud ravines stretching on.

sentences.zh: 回合兮諸峰，窈窕兮群巒。

translations.literal: Winding around the peaks; graceful the many ridges.
translations.idiomatic: Winding around the peaks; graceful the many ridges.

sentences.zh: 七解松花江，波影澄鮮。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: the Songhua River—wave shadows clear and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: The Songhua River—wave shadows clear and bright.

sentences.zh: 北流兮，並海西旋。

translations.literal: Flowing north; joining the sea and turning west.
translations.idiomatic: Flowing north; joining the sea and turning west.

sentences.zh: 混同兮合流，自古兮長川。

translations.literal: The Hunhe joins the confluence; from ancient times a long river.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunhe joins the confluence; from ancient times a long river.

sentences.zh: 八解遼河兮，泙湃狂瀾。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: the Liao River—surging wild billows.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: The Liao River—surging wild billows.

sentences.zh: 遼澤兮，泥淖蹣跚。

translations.literal: The Liao marshes—muddy bogs causing slow steps.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao marshes—muddy bogs causing slow steps.

sentences.zh: 布土兮為橋，既成兮孔安。

translations.literal: Earth spread to make a bridge; once complete—very secure.
translations.idiomatic: Earth spread to make a bridge; once complete—very secure.

sentences.zh: 九解飛瀑岩，瀑布常懸。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: Flying Cascade Rock—the waterfall always suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Flying Cascade Rock—the waterfall always suspended.

sentences.zh: 翠雲屏，雲影連蜷。

translations.literal: Emerald Cloud Screen—cloud shadows curling linked.
translations.idiomatic: Emerald Cloud Screen—cloud shadows curling linked.

sentences.zh: 聖水兮傾盆，萬松兮晝寒。

translations.literal: Sacred water pours like a basin; ten thousand pines—daytime cold.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred water pours like a basin; ten thousand pines—daytime cold.

sentences.zh: 十解平壤城，箕子名籓。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break: Pyongyang city—Jizi's famed feudatory domain.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10: Pyongyang city—Jizi's famed feudatory domain.

sentences.zh: 大寧城，漢曰新安。

translations.literal: Daning city—in the Han dynasty called Xinan.
translations.idiomatic: Daning city—in the Han dynasty called Xinan.

sentences.zh: 演范兮陳疇，帶礪兮河山。

translations.literal: Expounding the model and setting out the fields; girded with oaths upon the mountains and rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Expounding the model and setting out the fields; girded with oaths upon the mountains and rivers.

sentences.zh: 十一解鍾扶輿，虎踞龍蟠。

translations.literal: Eleventh stanza-break: Zhong Fuyu—crouching like a tiger, coiled like a dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 11: Zhong Fuyu—crouching like a tiger, coiled like a dragon.

sentences.zh: 植靈基，天作高山。

translations.literal: Planting a numinous foundation; heaven made the lofty mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Planting a numinous foundation; heaven made the lofty mountains.

sentences.zh: 拱衛兮陪京，永奠兮萬年。

translations.literal: Arching in guard beside the capital; forever established for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Arching in guard beside the capital; forever established for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 十二解

translations.literal: Twelfth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 12

sentences.zh: 布爾湖第二十布爾湖，明如鏡。

translations.literal: Buer Lake, twentieth: Buer Lake, clear as a mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Buer Lake, No. 20: Buer Lake, clear as a mirror.

sentences.zh: 庫里山，秀列雲屏。

translations.literal: Kuli Mountain—gracefully arrayed like a cloud screen.
translations.idiomatic: Kuli Mountain—gracefully arrayed like a cloud screen.

sentences.zh: 風來千頃碧，雨過數峰青。

translations.literal: When the wind comes, a thousand qing turn jade-green; when the rain passes, several peaks grow verdant.
translations.idiomatic: When the wind comes, a thousand qing turn jade-green; when the rain passes, several peaks grow verdant.

sentences.zh: 萃扶輿淑氣，是天地鍾靈。

translations.literal: It gathers the benevolent qi of Fuyu; here heaven and earth poured forth their numinous essence.
translations.idiomatic: It gathers the benevolent qi of Fuyu; here heaven and earth poured forth their numinous essence.

sentences.zh: 一解有天女兮，降生池畔。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: there was a heavenly maiden—born beside the pool.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: There was a heavenly maiden—born beside the pool.

sentences.zh: 吞硃果兮，玉質晶瑩，珍符吻合爰生聖。

translations.literal: She swallowed a cinnabar fruit; jade-like substance crystal-clear; precious tokens matched, and thereupon the sage was born.
translations.idiomatic: She swallowed a cinnabar fruit; jade-like substance crystal-clear; precious tokens matched, and thereupon the sage was born.

sentences.zh: 二解神靈始生即能言，睿知聰明。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: the divine being from birth could speak—wise in understanding, clear in intelligence.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: The divine being from birth could speak—wise in understanding, clear in intelligence.

sentences.zh: 不待學，徇齊敦敏，至德莫能名。

translations.literal: Without awaiting instruction; swift and uniform, earnest and agile; supreme virtue beyond naming.
translations.idiomatic: Without awaiting instruction; swift and uniform, earnest and agile; supreme virtue beyond naming.

sentences.zh: 三解日角珠庭，稽古帝，握褒履己；

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: sun-horn brow and pearl-like forehead; consulting the ancient emperors; holding Bao and treading Ji;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: Sun-horn brow and pearl-like forehead; consulting the ancient emperors; holding Bao and treading Ji;

sentences.zh: 更龍顏，戴干荷勝，岐嶷總天生。

translations.literal: Moreover a dragon countenance; bearing the pole and shouldering victory; precocious wisdom—all born of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover a dragon countenance; bearing the pole and shouldering victory; precocious wisdom—all born of heaven.

sentences.zh: 四解當是時，厥有三姓角雌雄。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: at that time, there were three clans contending male and female.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: At that time, three clans contended for dominance.

sentences.zh: 亂靡有定，蠻觸互相爭。

translations.literal: Chaos without fixity; barbarian snail-ant armies fought one another.
translations.idiomatic: Chaos held no fixity; rival factions fought like snail-ant armies.

sentences.zh: 五解汲清泉，言至河濱，見真人，如日如雲，稽首共來迎。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: drawing clear spring water—when he reached the riverbank he saw the true man, bright as sun and cloud; bowing in homage, all came to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: Drawing clear spring water—when he reached the riverbank he saw the true man, radiant as sun and cloud; bowing in homage, all came to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 六解睹堯眉，眾姓咸驚。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: seeing Yao's brow, all clans were astonished.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: Seeing Yao's brow, all clans were astonished.

sentences.zh: 是非常，天不虛生，葵藿早輸誠。

translations.literal: This was no ordinary sign; heaven does not spawn in vain; sunflower and bean-plant early offered their loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: This was no ordinary sign; heaven does not bear fruit in vain; all hearts already offered their loyalty.

sentences.zh: 七解念吾曹，原非好爭。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: consider us—we are not by nature lovers of strife.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: Consider us—we are not by nature lovers of strife.

sentences.zh: 今有主，得荷生成，從此戢戎兵。

translations.literal: Now there is a lord; we may bear his nurturing grace; from this we lay down weapons of war.
translations.idiomatic: Now we have a lord; we may bear his nurturing grace; from this we lay down weapons of war.

sentences.zh: 八解定三姓，尊為貝勒，似岐州，虞芮質成，荒度始經營。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: settling the three clans, honoring him as beile; like Qizhou—Yu and Rui settled their dispute; vast planning began.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: The three clans were settled and he was honored as beile; as at Qizhou, where Yu and Rui settled their dispute—grand enterprise began.

sentences.zh: 九解溯從來誕聖，厥多瑞徵。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: tracing back from the sage's birth, how many auspicious signs appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Tracing back the sage's birth, how many auspicious signs appeared.

sentences.zh: 華胥履跡，青雲繞身，樞星照野，虹流太清。

translations.literal: Huaxu's footstep, azure clouds winding round him; the Pole Star illuminating the fields; rainbows streaming through the Great Clarity.
translations.idiomatic: Huaxu's footstep, azure clouds winding round him; the Pole Star illuminating the fields; rainbows streaming through the Great Clarity.

sentences.zh: 瑤光貫月，玄鳥承罌，載稽典籍辭難罄。

translations.literal: Yaoguang piercing the moon; the dark bird bearing the vessel; consulting the classics—words cannot exhaust them all.
translations.idiomatic: Yaoguang piercing the moon; the dark bird bearing the vessel; consulting the classics—words cannot exhaust them all.

sentences.zh: 肆皇清，至人首出，乾坤篤生。

translations.literal: Then the Great Qing—the supreme man first appeared; heaven and earth earnestly gave him birth.
translations.idiomatic: Then the Great Qing—the supreme man first appeared; heaven and earth earnestly gave him birth.

sentences.zh: 自羲昊軒農，瑞籙祥經莫與京。

translations.literal: Since Fuxi, Haohao, Xuanyuan, and Shennong—no auspicious records or blessed scriptures can compare.
translations.idiomatic: Since Fuxi, Haohao, Xuanyuan, and Shennong—no auspicious records or blessed scriptures can compare.

sentences.zh: 十解

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10

sentences.zh: 建遼陽第二十一建遼陽，爰築崇墉。

translations.literal: Building Liaoyang, twenty-first: Building Liaoyang—here raising lofty walls.
translations.idiomatic: Building Liaoyang, No. 21: Building Liaoyang—here raising lofty walls.

sentences.zh: 矗金城兮萬雉，控列辟兮朝宗。

translations.literal: Towering golden walls, ten thousand battlements; commanding the feudal lords to pay court.
translations.idiomatic: Towering golden walls, ten thousand battlements; commanding the feudal lords to pay court.

sentences.zh: 遠邇兮歸懷，庶邦兮是同。

translations.literal: Near and far return in loyalty; all lands alike as one.
translations.idiomatic: Near and far return in loyalty; all lands alike as one.

sentences.zh: 一解懾天威，爭執鞭弭；

translations.literal: First stanza-break: awed by heaven's majesty, they ceased grasping the whip;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Awed by heaven's majesty, they ceased grasping the whip;

sentences.zh: 歌孔邇，原受帡幪。

translations.literal: They sang in near accord, desiring heaven's sheltering canopy.
translations.idiomatic: They sang in near accord, desiring heaven's sheltering canopy.

sentences.zh: 興朝正朔咸尊奉，遂荒大東。

translations.literal: The rising dynasty's calendar all revered and followed; thus they opened up the great east.
translations.idiomatic: The rising dynasty's calendar all revered and followed; thus they opened up the great east.

sentences.zh: 二解有哈達，首鼠兩端，數渝盟，自外陶鎔。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: there was Hada—vacillating like a mouse's head, repeatedly breaking alliances, swayed from without.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: There was Hada—vacillating at both ends, repeatedly breaking alliances, swayed from without.

sentences.zh: 天兵一舉咸驚悚，似草從風。

translations.literal: At one move of the celestial army all were startled—like grass bending with the wind.
translations.idiomatic: At one move of the celestial army all were startled—like grass bending with the wind.

sentences.zh: 三解有輝發，反覆不常，外生成，夜郎自雄。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: there was Huifa—inconstant in reversal, nurtured from without, vaunting himself like the Lord of Yelang.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: There was Huifa—inconstant in reversal, nurtured from without, vaunting himself like the Lord of Yelang.

sentences.zh: 六師迅發如雷動，棄甲投弓。

translations.literal: The six armies swiftly deployed like rolling thunder; they cast off armor and surrendered their bows.
translations.idiomatic: The six armies swiftly deployed like rolling thunder; they cast off armor and surrendered their bows.

sentences.zh: 四解有烏拉，包藏禍心，逞螳臂，欲試車沖。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: there was Ula—harboring evil intent, flexing a mantis's arm, wishing to test the chariot's charge.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: There was Ula—harboring evil intent, flexing a mantis's arm, wishing to test the chariot's charge.

sentences.zh: 戈鋋一指雕弧控，似掃蚍蠓。

translations.literal: One point of spear and halberd, one bow drawn—sweeping them away like gnats.
translations.idiomatic: One point of spear and halberd, one bow drawn—sweeping them away like gnats.

sentences.zh: 五解有葉赫，憑陵負嵎，似游鱗，翔洋釜中。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: there was Yehe—overbearing and backed by a corner, like swimming scales soaring in a cauldron.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: There was Yehe—overbearing and backed by a corner, like fish swimming freely in a cauldron.

sentences.zh: 狡焉潛結朝鮮眾，朝夕羽書通。

translations.literal: Craftily he secretly allied with the Koreans; morning and evening dispatch riders exchanged messages.
translations.idiomatic: Craftily he secretly allied with the Koreans; morning and evening dispatch riders exchanged messages.

sentences.zh: 六解有朝鮮，僻處海濱，與葉赫，狼狽交通。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: there was Korea—remote on the seacoast, with Yehe in collusion.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: There was Korea—remote on the seacoast, in collusion with Yehe.

sentences.zh: 蛩蛩甘草相承奉，結壘似屯蜂。

translations.literal: Like the qiong-qiong and gancao beasts mutually supporting one another; they built fortifications clustered like swarming bees.
translations.idiomatic: Like the qiong-qiong and gancao beasts mutually supporting one another; they built fortifications clustered like swarming bees.

sentences.zh: 七解閔明季，陽九方丁，如懸磬，杼柚其空。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: pity the late Ming—the yang's ninth cycle just beginning; like a suspended bell, looms and shuttles all empty.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: Pity the late Ming—the age of dire calamity had just begun; state coffers hung empty as a suspended bell.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮葉赫相愚弄，勢蹙不知窮。

translations.literal: Korea and Yehe fooled each other; their situation pressed tight yet they knew no bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Korea and Yehe deluded one another; pressed tight yet they knew no limit.

sentences.zh: 八解四路兵，犄角來侵，無紀律，誰適為雄。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: four-route armies came invading from horn angles; without discipline—who was fit to be the hero?
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: Four-route armies came invading from every angle; without discipline—who could prevail?

sentences.zh: 一時烏合無拳勇，號令馬牛風。

translations.literal: For a time a motley crowd without true courage; commands like wind passing oxen and horses.
translations.idiomatic: For a time a motley rabble without true courage; their commands passed like wind over cattle.

sentences.zh: 九解五十萬，封豕長蛇，肆貪狼，非不恟恟。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: five hundred thousand—boar and long snake, rampant as greedy wolves; not without clamor.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Five hundred thousand strong—like boar and serpent, rampant as greedy wolves—not without clamorous fury.

sentences.zh: 止緣逐利非心奉，臨事各西東。

translations.literal: Only because they chased profit, not loyally devoted—when crisis came each fled east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Only because they chased profit, not true devotion—when crisis came each fled his own way.

sentences.zh: 十解恣侵陵，師出無名，我天朝，用詰兵戎。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break: they wantonly invaded and bullied; the army went forth without just cause—our celestial court interrogated their war.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10: They wantonly invaded; their armies marched without just cause—our celestial court met their aggression with righteous force.

sentences.zh: 堂堂八陣天威聳，落葉掃秋風十一解壹戎衣，為救黎元，曾不費，蒿矢桃弓。

translations.literal: Majestic in the eight formations, heaven's might rose towering; sweeping leaves before the autumn wind. Eleventh stanza-break: donning the martial robe but once, to rescue the black-haired people—never costing more than reed arrows and peachwood bows.
translations.idiomatic: Majestic in the eight formations, heaven's might rose like autumn wind scattering leaves. Stanza 11: Donning the martial robe but once to rescue the people—costing no more than reed arrows and peachwood bows.

sentences.zh: 遼陽建後金湯鞏，王業首岐豐十二解

translations.literal: After Liaoyang was built, metal ramparts and moats stood firm; royal enterprise began like Qi and Feng. Twelfth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: After Liaoyang was built, ramparts stood firm as metal and moats; royal enterprise began at Qi and Feng. Stanza 12

sentences.zh: 瀋陽城第二十二瀋陽城，王氣所鍾。

translations.literal: Shenyang city, twenty-second: Shenyang city—where royal qi is gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Shenyang City, No. 22: Shenyang city—where royal qi converges.

sentences.zh: 氤氳五彩，縹渺如龍。

translations.literal: Rainbow mist of five colors, dim and drifting like a dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Rainbow mist of five colors, dim and drifting like a dragon.

sentences.zh: 信佳哉，鬱鬱蔥蔥。

translations.literal: Truly splendid—lush and verdant.
translations.idiomatic: Truly splendid—lush and verdant.

sentences.zh: 一解析木津，箕尾之東。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: Jiamu Ford—east of the Tail of the Sieve.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Jiamu Ford—east of the Tail of the Sieve.

sentences.zh: 上連天弁，右抱神宮。

translations.literal: Above it joins Tianbian; on the right it embraces Shengong.
translations.idiomatic: Above it joins Tianbian; on the right it embraces Shengong.

sentences.zh: 濟津梁，霄漢垂虹。

translations.literal: Crossing by ford and bridge; a rainbow hanging from the skies.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing by ford and bridge; a rainbow hangs from the skies.

sentences.zh: 二解近北極，象逼穹窿。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: near the northern pole; an image pressing the vault of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: Near the northern pole—the celestial image pressing the vault of heaven.

sentences.zh: 玄菟置郡，都護安東。

translations.literal: Xuantu commandery established; Protector-General pacified the east.
translations.idiomatic: Xuantu commandery established; Protector-General pacified the east.

sentences.zh: 越金元，頻建畿封。

translations.literal: Beyond Jin and Yuan, repeatedly establishing capital domains and fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Jin and Yuan, capitals and fiefs were repeatedly established here.

sentences.zh: 三解我皇朝，氣運方隆。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: our imperial dynasty—its cosmic fortune just rising.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: Our imperial dynasty—its cosmic fortune ascendant.

sentences.zh: 此惟與宅，用恢厥功。

translations.literal: This alone is our dwelling-place; thereby to expand its achievements.
translations.idiomatic: This alone is our dwelling-place; thereby to extend its achievements.

sentences.zh: 相陰陽，宅土之中。

translations.literal: Examining yin and yang, dwelling in the center of the land.
translations.idiomatic: Reading yin and yang, settled at the land's heart.

sentences.zh: 四解維廣寧，屹屹崇墉。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: as for Guangning—towering lofty walls.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: As for Guangning—towering lofty walls.

sentences.zh: 石梯連磴，香水春溶。

translations.literal: Stone steps linking terrace after terrace; fragrant waters melting in spring.
translations.idiomatic: Stone steps linking terrace after terrace; fragrant waters melting in spring.

sentences.zh: 十八盤，萬樹青松。

translations.literal: Eighteen turns of the path; ten thousand trees of green pine.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen turns of the path; ten thousand trees of green pine.

sentences.zh: 五解若旅順，臨海居沖。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: as with Lüshun—facing the sea at a strategic crossing.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: As with Lüshun—facing the sea at a strategic crossing.

sentences.zh: 番彝麕集，估舶雲從。

translations.literal: Barbarians and tribes gathered like deer; merchant ships followed like clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign peoples gathered like deer; merchant ships followed like clouds.

sentences.zh: 轉南漕，天庾斯充。

translations.literal: Turning the southern grain transport; the celestial granary is filled.
translations.idiomatic: Turning southern grain transport; the celestial granary is filled.

sentences.zh: 六解取廣寧，脣齒圻封。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: taking Guangning—lip-and-teeth border domains.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: Taking Guangning—border domains like lip and teeth.

sentences.zh: 惟茲旅順，亦是率從。

translations.literal: This Lüshun too likewise followed in obedience.
translations.idiomatic: This Lüshun too likewise followed in obedience.

sentences.zh: 啟鴻圖，駿烈豐功。

translations.literal: Opening the grand design; splendid achievements and abundant merit.
translations.idiomatic: Opening the grand design—splendid achievements and abundant merit.

sentences.zh: 七解左朝鮮，右際雲中。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: Korea to the left, Yunzhong on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: Korea to the left, Yunzhong on the right.

sentences.zh: 卜維洛食，龜筮斯從。

translations.literal: Divining for Luoyang's sustenance; turtle and milfoil both assented.
translations.idiomatic: Divination confirmed this as the place to dwell; turtle and milfoil both assented.

sentences.zh: 葉天人，是為大同。

translations.literal: Harmonizing heaven and human—this is great unity.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonizing heaven and humanity—this is great unity.

sentences.zh: 八解帶渾河，滄海朝宗。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: girded by the Hun River; the blue sea paying tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: Girded by the Hun River; the blue sea pays tribute.

sentences.zh: 白山控峙，石柱雲封。

translations.literal: Mount Bai controlling the vista; stone pillars sealed in clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Bai stands sentinel; stone pillars shrouded in clouds.

sentences.zh: 是神皋，俗厚民豐。

translations.literal: This is a numinous homeland—customs deep, people abundant.
translations.idiomatic: This is a numinous homeland—deep in custom, rich in people.

sentences.zh: 九解繞西南，遼水漴々。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: winding southwest—the Liao waters rushing on.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Winding southwest—the Liao waters rushing on.

sentences.zh: 襟環東北，黑水混同。

translations.literal: Embracing the northeast—Black Water and Hun River joined.
translations.idiomatic: Embracing the northeast—the Amur and Hunhe joined.

sentences.zh: 壯聲靈，鎬京辟廱。

translations.literal: Magnifying its numinous renown; like Haojing's Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Magnifying its numinous renown—like Haojing's Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 十解擴輿圖，北暨烏龍，牧羝舊部，使犬遺戎。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break: expanding the cartographic realm north to Wulong; herding-goat old clans and dog-using remnant tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10: Expanding the realm north to Wulong; herding clans and dog-using tribes of old.

sentences.zh: 震天威，罔不祗恭。

translations.literal: Shaking heaven's majesty—none failed to revere and submit.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's majesty trembled forth—all bowed in reverent submission.

sentences.zh: 十一解念中原，民力困窮。

translations.literal: Eleventh stanza-break: mindful of the central plains—the people's strength exhausted and impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 11: Mindful of the central plains—the people's strength exhausted.

sentences.zh: 殫輸將，比屋皆空，干戈充斥民無控。

translations.literal: Transport and levies utterly drained; every house empty; weapons of war everywhere—people without control.
translations.idiomatic: Transport and levies utterly drained; every house stood empty; weapons of war everywhere—the people beyond saving.

sentences.zh: 拯其塗炭，出水火中。

translations.literal: Delivering them from burning coals; drawing them out of water and fire.
translations.idiomatic: Delivering them from mortal suffering—drawing them out of water and fire.

sentences.zh: 會清明，四海來同。

translations.literal: When clarity and brightness return, the four seas come as one.
translations.idiomatic: When clarity returns, the four seas unite as one.

sentences.zh: 十二解

translations.literal: Twelfth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 12

sentences.zh: 鐵嶺山第二十三鐵嶺山，峰似削，燔白石，不消鑠，遼陽之東鼓橐籥。

translations.literal: Mount Tieling, twenty-third: Mount Tieling—peaks like cut blades; white stone burned but not consumed by melting; east of Liaoyang, beating the bellows-blower.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Tieling, No. 23: Mount Tieling—peaks sheer as cut blades; white stone burned yet never consumed; east of Liaoyang, the forge bellows blow.

sentences.zh: 一解綉嶺山，萬花谷，閒松塢，連雲壑。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: Embroidered Ridge Mountain, Ten Thousand Flowers Valley, Leisure Pine Hollow, Cloud-Linked Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Embroidered Ridge Mountain, Ten Thousand Flowers Valley, Leisure Pine Hollow, Cloud-Linked Ravine.

sentences.zh: 海城之南氣磅薄，上有三泉甘可酌。

translations.literal: South of Haicheng the qi surges vast; above are three springs, sweet and fit to draw from.
translations.idiomatic: South of Haicheng the vital force surges vast; above are three springs sweet enough to drink.

sentences.zh: 二解平頂山，雲漠漠。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: Flat-Top Mountain—clouds dim and vast.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: Flat-Top Mountain—clouds vast and dim.

sentences.zh: 車曾駐，盆可浴，上有積水冬不涸。

translations.literal: Chariots once halted there; a basin for bathing; pooled water above that never dries in winter.
translations.idiomatic: Chariots once halted there; a basin serves for bathing; pooled water above never dries in winter.

sentences.zh: 三解木查嶺，如劍鍔。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: Mocha Ridge—like a sword's edge.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: Mocha Ridge—like a sword's edge.

sentences.zh: 峻而坦，寬以博。

translations.literal: Steep yet level; broad and expansive.
translations.idiomatic: Steep yet level; broad and expansive.

sentences.zh: 查水發源岩際落。

translations.literal: Cha Water rises at the cliff's edge and falls.
translations.idiomatic: Cha Water rises at the cliff's edge and cascades down.

sentences.zh: 四解降龍山，神所託。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: Dragon-Descending Mountain, where the spirits entrust themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: Dragon-Descending Mountain, where spirits take refuge.

sentences.zh: 勢蜒蜿，如拏攫，風雨欲來光景鑠。

translations.literal: Its form serpentines and coils; like grasping and seizing; when storm and rain are about to come, the light and scene blaze dazzlingly.
translations.idiomatic: It coils and winds like grasping talons; when storm and rain draw near, light blazes dazzlingly.

sentences.zh: 五解水泉山，滋乳酪。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: Water-Spring Mountain—nourishes milk and cheese.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: Water-Spring Mountain, where milk and cheese abound.

sentences.zh: 清且美，用烹瀹，萬斛珍珠瀉簾箔。

translations.literal: Clear and fine; used for boiling and stewing; ten thousand hu of pearls pour down through curtain-silk.
translations.idiomatic: Clear and fine for boiling and stewing; myriads of pearls pour through the curtain-silk.

sentences.zh: 六解南雙山，巨靈拓。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: South Double Mountain—the giant spirit opened it.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: South Double Mountain, opened by the giant spirit.

sentences.zh: 左陽峰，右陰壑，青天秀削芙蓉萼。

translations.literal: Left, a yang peak; right, a yin ravine—blue heaven, gracefully cut like hibiscus calyx buds.
translations.idiomatic: On the left a yang peak, on the right a yin ravine—against blue sky, gracefully cut like hibiscus buds.

sentences.zh: 七解是諸山，互聯絡，忽低昂而岝崿。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: these mountains interlink with one another; suddenly low and high, jagged and steep.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: These mountains link together, now dipping low and rising high, jagged and steep.

sentences.zh: 羊腸宛轉緣蜂閣，鳥道窮兮構略彴。

translations.literal: Sheep-gut paths wind and turn, skirting bee-tower pavilions; when bird-paths end, a rough footbridge is built.
translations.idiomatic: Sheep-gut paths wind past cliff pavilions; where bird-paths end, a rough footbridge is built.

sentences.zh: 八解聚蔥(

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: peaks gathered like scallions (
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: peaks gathered like scallions (

translations.literal: grass radical),
translations.idiomatic: grass radical)

sentences.zh: 儼齦齶。

translations.literal: majestic like jaws and teeth.
translations.idiomatic: —majestic as jaws and teeth.

sentences.zh: 嵌峒，鬯寥廓。

translations.literal: Set into caves and grottoes; vast and open.
translations.idiomatic: Set in caves and grottoes, vast and open.

sentences.zh: 蔽虧日月愁猱玃，可喜可驚兼可愕。

translations.literal: Obscuring and eclipsing sun and moon; gibbons and macaques in sorrow; delightful yet startling and astonishing.
translations.idiomatic: They obscure sun and moon; gibbons and macaques grieve; delightful, startling, and astonishing all at once.

sentences.zh: 九解地呈符，天開鑰。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: earth displays its tokens; heaven opens the key.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Earth displays its tokens; heaven opens the key.

sentences.zh: 孕靈秀，阜飛攫。

translations.literal: Nurturing numinous beauty; mounds where birds swoop and seize.
translations.idiomatic: Nurturing numinous beauty; heights where birds swoop and seize.

sentences.zh: 巨木如林纖草弱，茂對乘時萬物育。

translations.literal: Great trees like a forest, fine grasses frail; flourishing in response, riding the season, all things are nourished.
translations.idiomatic: Great trees stand like a forest, fine grasses frail; flourishing in season, all things are nourished.

sentences.zh: 茂對乘時萬物育。

translations.literal: Flourishing in response, riding the season, all things are nourished.
translations.idiomatic: Flourishing in season, all things are nourished.

sentences.zh: 十解

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10

sentences.zh: 孕嘉產第二十四孕嘉產，厥族滋蕃。

translations.literal: Fine Products Nurtured, twenty-fourth: Fine Products Nurtured—their kinds flourish and multiply.
translations.idiomatic: Fine Products Nurtured, No. 24: Fine Products Nurtured—their kinds flourish and multiply.

sentences.zh: 悉數之，更仆為煩，山經爾雅空排纂。

translations.literal: To enumerate them all would wear out servants with tedium; the Classic of Mountains and Seas and the Erya vainly arranged compilations.
translations.idiomatic: To count them all would weary attendants with tedium; the Classic of Mountains and Seas and the Erya compiled lists in vain.

sentences.zh: 略疏梗概，用告司原。

translations.literal: Briefly set forth the outline, to inform those who oversee the source.
translations.idiomatic: Briefly set forth the outline, to inform those who oversee the source.

sentences.zh: 一解有於菟，蒼質玄斑。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: there are yutu (tigers)—gray in substance, black stripes.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: There are tigers—gray-bodied with dark stripes.

sentences.zh: 吼腥風，林葉摧殘，霧中玄豹尤虓悍。

translations.literal: Roaring, a fetid wind; forest leaves destroyed; in the mist the dark leopard is especially fierce and bold.
translations.idiomatic: Roaring fetid wind destroys forest leaves; in the mist the dark leopard is especially fierce.

sentences.zh: 異名同族，艾葉金錢。

translations.literal: Different names, same kind—mugwort-leaf and gold-coin (patterns).
translations.idiomatic: Different names, same species—the mugwort-leaf and gold-coin types.

sentences.zh: 二解熊似豕，穴處空山。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: bears resemble pigs; they den in empty mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: Bears resemble pigs; they den in empty mountains.

sentences.zh: 善搏人，春出冬蟠，羆文黃白仍修幹。

translations.literal: Good at grappling people; emerging in spring, coiling in winter; pi bears marked yellow and white, with still slender trunks.
