translations.idiomatic: They grapple people readily; emerging in spring, coiling in winter; pi bears marked yellow and white, with slender trunks.

sentences.zh: 力能拔木，不畏戈鋋。

translations.literal: Strength enough to uproot trees; unafraid of spears and blades.
translations.idiomatic: Strong enough to uproot trees; unafraid of spears and blades.

sentences.zh: 三解有野馬，形質輕獧。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: there are wild horses—form and substance light and nimble.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: There are wild horses—light and nimble in form.

sentences.zh: 走深山，不服鞍韉，日行五百如奔電。

translations.literal: Running in deep mountains; refusing saddle and bridle; five hundred li a day like racing lightning.
translations.idiomatic: They run in deep mountains, refusing saddle and bridle; five hundred li a day like racing lightning.

sentences.zh: 野騾似馬，亦產遐邊。

translations.literal: Wild mules resemble horses; they too are produced in far borders.
translations.idiomatic: Wild mules resemble horses; they too are found in distant borderlands.

sentences.zh: 四解扶輿鹿性喜林泉，麞無膽力心常戰。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: Fuyu deer love forests and springs by nature; musk deer lack gall and courage—their hearts are ever in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: Fuyu deer love forests and springs; musk deer lack gall—their hearts are ever fearful.

sentences.zh: 惟麂惟狍，類族殷繁。

translations.literal: Only muntjacs and roe deer—their kinds are plentiful.
translations.idiomatic: Muntjacs and roe deer—their kinds are plentiful.

sentences.zh: 五解狼白頰，前高後寬。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: wolves have white cheeks; tall in front, broad behind.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: Wolves have white cheeks; tall in front, broad behind.

sentences.zh: 或蒼或黑皆膘健。

translations.literal: Whether gray or black, all are plump and strong.
translations.idiomatic: Whether gray or black, all are plump and strong.

sentences.zh: 豺尤猛厲，祭獸秋原。

translations.literal: Jackals are especially fierce; autumn sacrifice beasts on the plain.
translations.idiomatic: Jackals are especially fierce; autumn sacrifice beasts roam the plain.

sentences.zh: 六解一峰駝肉自為鞍，頸修氾曲眈芻豢。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: single-hump camels—flesh forms its own saddle; long neck, gently curved, content to chew fodder.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: Single-hump camels—flesh forms its own saddle; long neck gently curved, content to chew fodder.

sentences.zh: 力能任重，用濟軍饘。

translations.literal: Strength enough to bear heavy loads; used to sustain the army's gruel.
translations.idiomatic: Strong enough to bear heavy loads; used to sustain the army's provisions.

sentences.zh: 七解狐性疑，貍愛安眠，毛深溫厚為裘暖。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: foxes are suspicious by nature; raccoon dogs love peaceful sleep; deep, warm fur made into robes for warmth.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: Foxes are suspicious by nature; raccoon dogs love peaceful sleep; deep, warm fur is made into robes for warmth.

sentences.zh: 貉能求食，富則資貛。

translations.literal: Badgers can seek food; when wealthy they supply materials for raccoon-dog fur.
translations.idiomatic: Badgers can forage for food; when prosperous they supply raccoon-dog fur.

sentences.zh: 八解兔婆娑，亦稱比肩，鼢鼯五技徒蒙訕。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: rabbits are graceful; also called shoulder-to-shoulder; flying squirrels with five skills merely invite mockery.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: Rabbits are graceful; also called shoulder-to-shoulder; flying squirrels with five skills merely invite mockery.

sentences.zh: 鼠名艾虎，亦屬戔戔。

translations.literal: A rodent named mugwort-tiger also belongs among the small and insignificant.
translations.idiomatic: A rodent named mugwort-tiger also belongs among the small and insignificant.

sentences.zh: 九解貂似鼠，其質龐然，食松苗，以栗為饘。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: sables resemble rats, their substance bulky; they eat pine seedlings and take chestnuts as gruel.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Sables resemble rats, bulky in build; they eat pine seedlings and take chestnuts as gruel.

sentences.zh: 紫毫豐毳，服之孔安。

translations.literal: Purple-tipped hair, abundant down—wearing it brings great comfort.
translations.idiomatic: Purple-tipped hair, abundant down—wearing it brings great comfort.

sentences.zh: 十解馬牛羊，閭巷喧闐。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break: horses, cattle, and sheep—lanes and alleys clamorous.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10: Horses, cattle, and sheep—lanes and alleys clamorous.

sentences.zh: 白頭豕，用給盤餐，居民比屋充常膳。

translations.literal: White-headed pigs supply platters and meals; households door to door fill their daily fare.
translations.idiomatic: White-headed pigs supply platters and meals; households door to door fill their daily fare.

sentences.zh: 不須臚列，以免辭煩。

translations.literal: No need to enumerate in detail, lest words become tedious.
translations.idiomatic: No need to enumerate in detail, lest words become tedious.

sentences.zh: 十一解是熙朝，茂育功宣。

translations.literal: Eleventh stanza-break: this is the flourishing dynasty; its nurturing achievements are proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 11: This is the flourishing dynasty; its nurturing achievements are proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 致物產，滋盛春田，四靈為畜麟游甸。

translations.literal: Producing goods; flourishing in spring fields; the four auspicious beasts kept as livestock—a qilin roams the pasture.
translations.idiomatic: Producing goods; flourishing in spring fields; the four auspicious beasts kept as livestock—a qilin roams the pasture.

sentences.zh: 殊祥上瑞，多載青編。

translations.literal: Extraordinary omens and supreme blessings are recorded in many blue-bound volumes.
translations.idiomatic: Extraordinary omens and supreme blessings are recorded in many blue-bound volumes.

sentences.zh: 十二解

translations.literal: Twelfth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 12

sentences.zh: 毓靈禽第二十五毓靈禽，五色名翬，虞人歲捕供時祀。

translations.literal: Numinous Birds Nurtured, twenty-fifth: Numinous Birds Nurtured—five-colored, named hui; imperial huntsmen capture them yearly for seasonal sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Numinous Birds Nurtured, No. 25: Numinous Birds Nurtured—five-colored, named hui; imperial huntsmen capture them yearly for seasonal sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 沙雞無趾，出青林，亦貢丹墀。

translations.literal: Sand grouse have no toes; emerging from green forests, they are also presented at the crimson steps.
translations.idiomatic: Sand grouse have no toes; emerging from green forests, they are also presented at the crimson steps.

sentences.zh: 一解有舒鳧，洵腴且肥，家鵝舒雁仍甘美。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: there are shu ducks—truly plump and fat; domestic geese and shu geese remain delicious.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: There are shu ducks—truly plump and fat; domestic geese and shu geese remain delicious.

sentences.zh: 青章次之，信天緣，鵜鶘之類。

translations.literal: Green herons rank next; pelicans and cormorants and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Green herons rank next; pelicans, cormorants, and the like.

sentences.zh: 二解鳴九皋，玄裳羽衣，鸛鳴於垤丹其喙。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: they call across nine marshes; black lower garments and feather robes; storks call on the mound, their beaks red.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: They call across nine marshes; black lower garments and feather robes; storks call on the mound, their beaks red.

sentences.zh: 禿鶖長頸，在水之湄。

translations.literal: Bald ibises with long necks at the water's edge.
translations.idiomatic: Bald ibises with long necks at the water's edge.

sentences.zh: 翦霜翎，用飾忘歸。

translations.literal: Clipping frost-white feathers to adorn caps that make one forget to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Clipping frost-white feathers to adorn caps that make one forget to return home.

sentences.zh: 三解鵜在梁，載詠風詩，淘河吸盡蹄涔水。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: cormorants on the beam—reciting Odes of Feng; scoop-river birds drain every hoof-print puddle.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: Cormorants on the beam—reciting Odes of Feng; scoop-river birds drain every hoof-print puddle.

sentences.zh: 斑鳩性拙，縮脖高飛。

translations.literal: Turtle-doves are clumsy by nature; tucking necks they fly high.
translations.idiomatic: Turtle-doves are clumsy by nature; tucking their necks they fly high.

sentences.zh: 並翱翔，適性忘機。

translations.literal: Both soaring together—suited to their nature, forgetting artifice.
translations.idiomatic: Both soaring together—suited to their nature, forgetting artifice.

sentences.zh: 四解燕于飛，下上差池。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: swallows flying; dipping up and down unevenly.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: Swallows flying; dipping up and down unevenly.

sentences.zh: 善營巢，秋去春歸。

translations.literal: Skilled at building nests; departing in autumn, returning in spring.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at building nests; departing in autumn, returning in spring.

sentences.zh: 曙色才分，最好是，數聲乾鵲，檐頭報喜。

translations.literal: As dawn color just breaks, best of all—the dry magpie's few calls announcing joy from the eaves.
translations.idiomatic: As dawn color just breaks, best of all—the magpie's few calls announcing joy from the eaves.

sentences.zh: 五解啄木兒，利口如錐。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: woodpeckers—sharp mouths like awls.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: Woodpeckers—sharp mouths like awls.

sentences.zh: 蠹蟲穴樹藏身固，緣木而求必得之。

translations.literal: Boring insects hole trees and hide securely; climbing the wood to seek them, they are sure to be got.
translations.idiomatic: Boring insects hole trees and hide securely; climbing the wood to seek them, they are sure to be found.

sentences.zh: 在眾禽中，號為多智。

translations.literal: Among all birds, they are called most intelligent.
translations.idiomatic: Among all birds, they are called most intelligent.

sentences.zh: 六解黑龍江，爰有深池。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: on the Black Dragon River there are deep pools.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: On the Black Dragon River there are deep pools.

sentences.zh: 雁來初湛淡羽儀，鶬雞麋鴰群遊戲。

translations.literal: Geese come first, dipping pale feather ornament; mergansers and swan geese flock in play.
translations.idiomatic: Geese come first, dipping pale feather ornament; mergansers and swan geese flock in play.

sentences.zh: 汎清波，卵息繁孳。

translations.literal: Floating on clear waves; laying eggs, breeding in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Floating on clear waves; laying eggs, breeding in abundance.

sentences.zh: 七解到春來，田鼠為鴽，考之爾雅黃鷃是。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: when spring comes, field mice transform into ru birds; consulting the Erya, they are the yellow orioles.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: When spring comes, field mice transform into ru birds; consulting the Erya, they are the yellow orioles.

sentences.zh: 倉庚鳴矣，夏日遲遲。

translations.literal: The oriole sings; summer days lengthen slowly.
translations.idiomatic: The oriole sings; summer days lengthen slowly.

sentences.zh: 柳陰中，好音流利。

translations.literal: Amid willow shade, fine notes flow smoothly.
translations.idiomatic: Amid willow shade, fine notes flow smoothly.

sentences.zh: 八解遼河鷹，松兒朵兒。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: Liao River hawks—Song'er and Duo'er varieties.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: Liao River hawks—Song'er and Duo'er varieties.

sentences.zh: 海東青，性尤猛鷙。

translations.literal: Eastern Sea green—its nature especially fierce and bold.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Sea green—its nature especially fierce and bold.

sentences.zh: 天鵝褫魄，狡兔何施。

translations.literal: Swans lose their souls; what can cunning rabbits do?
translations.idiomatic: Swans lose their souls; what can cunning rabbits do?

sentences.zh: 虎斑雕，差可肩隨。

translations.literal: Tiger-striped eagles can nearly keep pace shoulder to shoulder.
translations.idiomatic: Tiger-striped eagles can nearly keep pace shoulder to shoulder.

sentences.zh: 九解萃羽族，深林茂枝。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: gathered feathered tribes in deep forests with lush branches.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: Gathered feathered tribes in deep forests with lush branches.

sentences.zh: 飲與啄，惟性所宜。

translations.literal: Drinking and pecking—whatever their nature suits.
translations.idiomatic: Drinking and pecking—whatever their nature suits.

sentences.zh: 太和洋溢，民物恬熙。

translations.literal: Great harmony overflows; people and things peaceful and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Great harmony overflows; people and things peaceful and flourishing.

sentences.zh: 奏箾韶，鸞鳳來儀。

translations.literal: Playing the Shao music—phoenixes come with ritual grace.
translations.idiomatic: Playing the Shao music—phoenixes come with ritual grace.

sentences.zh: 十解

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10

sentences.zh: 蕃珍樹第二十六便蕃珍樹，籠溪覆塢。

translations.literal: Abundant Precious Trees, twenty-sixth: readily abundant precious trees—shrouding streams, covering ravines.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant Precious Trees, No. 26: readily abundant precious trees—shrouding streams, covering ravines.

sentences.zh: 爰有蕭艾香蒲，春雨後，叢生幽渚。

translations.literal: Here are artemisia, mugwort, and fragrant cattails; after spring rain, clustering on hidden islets.
translations.idiomatic: Here are artemisia, mugwort, and fragrant cattails; after spring rain, clustering on hidden islets.

sentences.zh: 紅杏緋桃，兔絲葶藶，連岡被楚藥籠儲。

translations.literal: Red apricots and crimson peaches; dodder and pennycress; linked hills covered with medicinal herbs stored in cages.
translations.idiomatic: Red apricots and crimson peaches; dodder and pennycress; linked hills covered with medicinal herbs stored in cages.

sentences.zh: 馬藺知時節，紅藍茜不如。

translations.literal: Horse iris knows the seasons; madder and indigo cannot compare.
translations.idiomatic: Horse iris knows the seasons; madder and indigo cannot compare.

sentences.zh: 一解松釒義雙股，是爾雅篇中所著。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: pine with twin trunks—as recorded in the Erya chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: Pine with twin trunks—as recorded in the Erya chapter.

sentences.zh: 惟有神京，秀鍾扶輿。

translations.literal: Only in the divine capital does numinous beauty concentrate in Fuyu.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the divine capital does numinous beauty concentrate in Fuyu.

sentences.zh: 歲寒姿，其針獨五。

translations.literal: Bearing the cold-season form; its needles alone are five per cluster.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing the cold-season form; its needles alone are five per cluster.

sentences.zh: 八千歲為春，八千歲為秋，大椿齡，綿綿萬古。

translations.literal: Eight thousand years make a spring, eight thousand years make an autumn—the great chinaberry's span stretches through myriad ages.
translations.idiomatic: Eight thousand years make a spring, eight thousand years make an autumn—the great chinaberry's span stretches through myriad ages.

sentences.zh: 被光華，含雲隱霧，瑤光降斗樞。

translations.literal: Clothed in splendor; holding clouds and hiding mist; jade radiance descends upon the Dipper pivot.
translations.idiomatic: Clothed in splendor; holding clouds and hiding mist; jade radiance descends upon the Dipper pivot.

sentences.zh: 三椏五葉滋靈草，地產奇珍泄秘符，地產奇珍泄秘符。

translations.literal: Three-forked and five-leafed—it nourishes numinous herbs; the land produces strange treasures revealing secret tokens; the land produces strange treasures revealing secret tokens.
translations.idiomatic: Three-forked and five-leafed—it nourishes numinous herbs; the land produces strange treasures revealing secret tokens; the land produces strange treasures revealing secret tokens.

sentences.zh: 二解

translations.literal: Second stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2

sentences.zh: 建皇極第二十七建皇極，司徒度廣輪；

translations.literal: Establishing the Grand Pole, twenty-seventh: Establishing the Grand Pole—the Minister of Works measured the broad compass;
translations.idiomatic: Establishing the Grand Pole, No. 27: Establishing the Grand Pole—the Minister of Works measured the broad compass;

sentences.zh: 壯皇后，太史陳圭臬。

translations.literal: Strengthening the empress's seat; the Grand Astrologer presented the jade square and plumb line.
translations.idiomatic: Strengthening the empress's seat; the Grand Astrologer presented the jade square and plumb line.

sentences.zh: 端徑遂，三塗達九逵；

translations.literal: Straight paths completed; three ways reaching nine thoroughfares;
translations.idiomatic: Straight paths completed; three ways reaching nine thoroughfares;

sentences.zh: 相陰陽，百堵依繩尺。

translations.literal: Consulting yin and yang; a hundred walls built by cord and rule.
translations.idiomatic: Consulting yin and yang; a hundred walls built by cord and rule.

sentences.zh: 一解南德盛，當陽離鄉明；

translations.literal: First stanza-break: south virtue flourishing; facing the yang, Departing Village is bright;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: South virtue flourishing; facing the yang, Departing Village is bright;

sentences.zh: 東撫近，出震青陽辟。

translations.literal: East pacifying the near; Outshaking trigram, green yang opens.
translations.idiomatic: East pacifying the near; Outshaking trigram, green yang opens.

sentences.zh: 西懷遠，金行靖甲兵；

translations.literal: West cherishing the distant; metal phase pacifying armor and weapons;
translations.idiomatic: West cherishing the distant; metal phase pacifying armor and weapons;

sentences.zh: 北福盛，象緯通天闕。

translations.literal: North fortune flourishing; star-omens and celestial tracks connect to heaven's gate.
translations.idiomatic: North fortune flourishing; star-omens and celestial tracks connect to heaven's gate.

sentences.zh: 二解前天佑，高明法健行；

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: above, Heaven's blessing; lofty and bright, following vigorous conduct;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: above, Heaven's blessing; lofty and bright, following vigorous conduct;

sentences.zh: 後地載，博厚符坤德。

translations.literal: Below, Earth bears; broad and deep, matching Kun virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Below, Earth bears; broad and deep, matching Kun virtue.

sentences.zh: 左內治，訏謨綏廟廷；

translations.literal: Left, inner governance; grand counsel pacifying the ancestral court;
translations.idiomatic: Left, inner governance; grand counsel pacifying the ancestral court;

sentences.zh: 右外攘，聲教敷重譯。

translations.literal: Right, outer pacification; sound teachings spread through double translation.
translations.idiomatic: Right, outer pacification; sound teachings spread through double translation.

sentences.zh: 三解表雙闕，艱難念武功；

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: the exterior faces the twin towers; in hardship, reflecting on martial achievement;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: the exterior faces the twin towers; in hardship, reflecting on martial achievement;

sentences.zh: 致太平，垂拱思文德。

translations.literal: Achieving Great Peace, ruling with folded hands, contemplating civil virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Achieving Great Peace, ruling with folded hands, contemplating civil virtue.

sentences.zh: 崇政殿，穹窿憲紫垣；

translations.literal: Chongzheng Hall, domed vault matching the purple walls;
translations.idiomatic: Chongzheng Hall, domed vault matching the purple walls;

sentences.zh: 鳳凰樓，樸素無雕飾。

translations.literal: Phoenix Tower, plain and without carved ornament.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix Tower, plain and without carved ornament.

sentences.zh: 四解詄蕩蕩，天門辟九重；

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: the diedang resounds vast; Heaven's Gate opens through nine layers;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: the booming music resounds vast; Heaven's Gate opens through nine layers;

sentences.zh: 扇巍巍，雲際開金闕。

translations.literal: Fans tower high; at the cloud's edge the golden gate opens.
translations.idiomatic: Fans tower high; at the cloud's edge the golden gate opens.

sentences.zh: 盛輿服，衣冠拜冕旒；

translations.literal: Splendid carriage and robes; caps and gowns bow to the crown tassels;
translations.idiomatic: Splendid carriage and robes; caps and gowns bow to the crown tassels;

sentences.zh: 肅威儀，羽衛陳刀戟。

translations.literal: Solemn majesty; feathered guards array spears and halberds.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn majesty; feathered guards array spears and halberds.

sentences.zh: 五解夜漏盡，猶傳衛士餐；

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: the night clepsydra runs out, yet the guards' meal is still passed;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: the night clepsydra runs out, yet the guards' meal is still passed;

sentences.zh: 曉鐘鳴，遽進雞人幘。

translations.literal: The dawn bell rings; hastily the cock-man's headcloth is presented.
translations.idiomatic: The dawn bell rings; hastily the cock-man's headcloth is presented.

sentences.zh: 規久大，朝廷多直言；

translations.literal: Planning for enduring greatness; the court has many who speak frankly;
translations.idiomatic: Planning for enduring greatness; the court has many who speak frankly;

sentences.zh: 謀萬全，殿陛無遺策。

translations.literal: Scheming for complete safety; at the palace steps no strategy is overlooked.
translations.idiomatic: Scheming for complete safety; at the palace steps no strategy is overlooked.

sentences.zh: 六解援禮經，郊壇建國南；

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: drawing on the Rites Classic, the suburban altar is built south of the capital;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: drawing on the Rites Classic, the suburban altar is built south of the capital;

sentences.zh: 考彝章，展敬陳蒼璧。

translations.literal: Consulting ritual regulations, displaying reverence and presenting the green jade disk.
translations.idiomatic: Consulting ritual regulations, displaying reverence and presenting the green jade disk.

sentences.zh: 禋閟宮，春秋廑孝思；

translations.literal: Sacrificing at the closed shrine, spring and autumn diligently maintaining filial thought;
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificing at the closed shrine, spring and autumn diligently maintaining filial thought;

sentences.zh: 重宗盟，宗正司宗祏。

translations.literal: Honoring ancestral covenant; the Director of the Imperial Clan oversees the ancestral tablets.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring ancestral covenant; the Director of the Imperial Clan oversees the ancestral tablets.

sentences.zh: 七解得天心，謳歌獄訟歸；

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: gaining Heaven's heart; songs of praise—as lawsuits return;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: gaining Heaven's heart; songs of praise—as lawsuits return;

sentences.zh: 孚人意，鎬洛聲靈赫。

translations.literal: Winning men's hearts; Hao and Luo resound with numinous majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Winning men's hearts; Hao and Luo resound with numinous majesty.

sentences.zh: 定中原，鴻圖萬載基；

translations.literal: Securing the Central Plain; the grand design lays foundation for ten thousand ages;
translations.idiomatic: Securing the Central Plain; the grand design lays foundation for ten thousand ages;

sentences.zh: 作陪京，巡幸朝群辟。

translations.literal: Serving as the secondary capital; on imperial tours receiving the assembled nobles.
translations.idiomatic: Serving as the secondary capital; on imperial tours receiving the assembled nobles.

sentences.zh: 八解

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8

sentences.zh: 鑠皇清第二十八鑠皇清，景命隆，成天平地永宅中。

translations.literal: Resplendent Qing, twenty-eighth: Resplendent Qing—the auspicious mandate ascendant; completing heaven and leveling earth, forever dwelling at the center.
translations.idiomatic: Resplendent Qing, No. 28: resplendent Qing—the auspicious mandate ascendant; completing heaven and leveling earth, forever dwelling at the center.

sentences.zh: 聖繼聖，纘豐功。

translations.literal: Sage succeeding sage, continuing abundant achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Sage succeeding sage, continuing abundant achievements.

sentences.zh: 製作定世符，御天乘六龍。

translations.literal: Institutions set the age's seal; ruling heaven, riding the six dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Institutions set the age's seal; ruling heaven, riding the six dragons.

sentences.zh: 一解樂昭德，禮備容，覃敷聲教八方通。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: music displays virtue, rites complete in form; broadly spreading sound teachings, the eight directions connect.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 1: music displays virtue, rites complete in form; broadly spreading sound teachings, the eight directions connect.

sentences.zh: 道德一，風俗同。

translations.literal: One moral principle, customs alike.
translations.idiomatic: One moral principle, customs alike.

sentences.zh: 皇威馳海徼，仙仗過崆峒。

translations.literal: Imperial might races to the sea borders; the immortal retinue passes Kongtong.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial might races to the sea borders; the immortal retinue passes Kongtong.

sentences.zh: 二解詠芹藻，歌辟廱，崇德絀惡發群矇。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: singing of duckweed and water plants, singing at the Bi Yong; honoring virtue and punishing evil, awakening the blind masses.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 2: singing of duckweed and water plants, singing at the Bi Yong; honoring virtue and punishing evil, awakening the blind masses.

sentences.zh: 蛾有術，瞽有宗。

translations.literal: The blind have their arts; the sightless have their masters.
translations.idiomatic: The blind have their arts; the sightless have their masters.

sentences.zh: 壽考而作人，棫樸其芃芃。

translations.literal: Living to old age to become proper persons; the elm and oak flourish lush.
translations.idiomatic: Living to old age to become proper persons; the elm and oak flourish lush.

sentences.zh: 三解嗟保介，咨臣工，犁雲耕雨勞厥功。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: sighing over the land's protectors, consulting officials and craftsmen; plowing clouds and cultivating rain, toiling at their achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 3: sighing over the land's protectors, consulting officials and craftsmen; plowing clouds and cultivating rain, toiling at their achievement.

sentences.zh: 繪無逸，圖豳風。

translations.literal: Painting Against Idleness, picturing the Bin Airs.
translations.idiomatic: Painting Against Idleness, picturing the Bin Airs.

sentences.zh: 率育配彼天，倉箱裕我農。

translations.literal: Leading and nurturing to match heaven; granaries and bins enrich our farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Leading and nurturing to match heaven; granaries and bins enrich our farmers.

sentences.zh: 四解種浴川，桑戾風，褘衣東鄉明婦功。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: planting at the bathing river, mulberry responding to the wind; in ceremonial robes facing east, displaying women's work.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 4: planting at the bathing river, mulberry responding to the wind; in ceremonial robes facing east, displaying women's work.

sentences.zh: 肅壇壝，比先農。

translations.literal: Solemn on the altar mound, compared with the Former Farmer.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn on the altar mound, compared with the Former Farmer.

sentences.zh: 父老歡德化，耕桑帝所崇。

translations.literal: Elders rejoice in moral transformation; plowing and sericulture the emperor honors.
translations.idiomatic: Elders rejoice in moral transformation; plowing and sericulture the emperor honors.

sentences.zh: 五解整屏翰，屹金墉，得人則治簡帝衷。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: organizing the border shields, towering golden walls; with the right men, governance accords with the emperor's heart.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 5: organizing the border shields, towering golden walls; with the right men, governance accords with the emperor's heart.

sentences.zh: 甘棠芾，黍苗芃。

translations.literal: The sweet pear tree spreads; millet seedlings flourish lush.
translations.idiomatic: The sweet pear tree spreads; millet seedlings flourish lush.

sentences.zh: 廢墜罔不修，萬里咸提封。

translations.literal: What is neglected or fallen, none left unrepaired; ten thousand li all brought under tribute districts.
translations.idiomatic: What is neglected or fallen, none left unrepaired; ten thousand li all brought under tribute districts.

sentences.zh: 六解辟三宅，達四聰，旁招俊乂秉至公。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: opening the three residences, reaching the four keen senses; from all sides recruiting outstanding men, holding the utmost fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 6: opening the three residences, reaching the four keen senses; from all sides recruiting outstanding men, holding the utmost fairness.

sentences.zh: 霧豹蔚，雲龍從。

translations.literal: Mist-hidden leopards flourish; cloud dragons follow.
translations.idiomatic: Mist-hidden leopards flourish; cloud dragons follow.

sentences.zh: 曰舉爾所知，名字書屏風。

translations.literal: Saying 'raise those you know'; their names written on the screen.
translations.idiomatic: Saying 'raise those you know'; their names written on the screen.

sentences.zh: 七解省耕斂，寬租庸，神倉百萬備荒凶。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: inspecting farming and taxation, easing land and labor taxes; divine granaries storing millions, prepared for famine and disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 7: inspecting farming and taxation, easing land and labor taxes; divine granaries storing millions, prepared for famine and disaster.

sentences.zh: 胥保惠，振貧窮。

translations.literal: All protecting and benefiting, reviving the poor and destitute.
translations.idiomatic: All protecting and benefiting, reviving the poor and destitute.

sentences.zh: 暑雨與祁寒，咸化為春風。

translations.literal: Summer rains and bitter cold alike transform into spring breeze.
translations.idiomatic: Summer rains and bitter cold alike transform into spring breeze.

sentences.zh: 八解畎澮濬，軌塗通，誕疏地脈淀與谼。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: ditches and canals dredged, track roads connected; broadly opening the earth's channels, marshes and hollows.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 8: ditches and canals dredged, track roads connected; broadly opening the earth's channels, marshes and hollows.

sentences.zh: 水攸利，年自逢。

translations.literal: Where water benefits, good years naturally come.
translations.idiomatic: Where water benefits, good years naturally come.

sentences.zh: 浩浩乎恩波，匪今頌屢豐。

translations.literal: Vast is the wave of grace; not today alone celebrates repeated abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Vast is the wave of grace; not today alone celebrates repeated abundance.

sentences.zh: 九解什一稅，維正供，求民之莫飭司農。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: one-tenth tax, proper tribute supply; seeking the people's wellbeing, overseeing the Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 9: one-tenth tax, proper tribute supply; seeking the people's wellbeing, overseeing the Minister of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 免溝壑，樂食饔。

translations.literal: Spared from ditches of death, joyfully eating morning and evening meals.
translations.idiomatic: Spared from ditches of death, joyfully eating morning and evening meals.

sentences.zh: 損上以益下，皇王儉德共。

translations.literal: Reducing above to benefit below; emperor and king share frugal virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Reducing above to benefit below; emperor and king share frugal virtue.

sentences.zh: 十解海湯湯，水朝宗，日東月西出其中。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break: seas surge vast; waters pay homage to the source; sun east, moon west, emerging from within.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 10: seas surge vast; waters pay homage to the source; sun east, moon west, emerging from within.

sentences.zh: 旦復旦，無終窮。

translations.literal: Dawn after dawn, without end or limit.
translations.idiomatic: Dawn after dawn, without end or limit.

sentences.zh: 涵乾而納坤，何所不包容。

translations.literal: Embracing Qian and receiving Kun—what is there it does not encompass?
translations.idiomatic: Embracing Qian and receiving Kun—what is there it does not encompass?

sentences.zh: 十一解斡璇璣，走靊霳，嘉生繁植蕭艾空。

translations.literal: Eleventh stanza-break: turning the celestial orb, driving thunderclouds; fine life flourishes and plants spread—artemisia and mugwort vanish.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 11: turning the celestial orb, driving thunderclouds; fine life flourishes and plants spread—artemisia and mugwort vanish.

sentences.zh: 沛然雨，薰兮風。

translations.literal: Raining abundantly, breezing warmly.
translations.idiomatic: Raining abundantly, breezing warmly.

sentences.zh: 至誠契天心，無為而允恭。

translations.literal: Utmost sincerity accords with Heaven's heart; effortless action yet sincerely reverent.
translations.idiomatic: Utmost sincerity accords with Heaven's heart; effortless action yet sincerely reverent.

sentences.zh: 十二解稽典禮，命秩宗，釋回增美惇且庸。

translations.literal: Twelfth stanza-break: consulting canonical rites, appointing the Minister of Rites; abandoning excess, enhancing beauty, sincere and useful.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 12: consulting canonical rites, appointing the Minister of Rites; abandoning excess, enhancing beauty, sincere and useful.

sentences.zh: 筠其竹，心其松。

translations.literal: Bamboo with firm joints, pine with steadfast heart.
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo with firm joints, pine with steadfast heart.

sentences.zh: 本天以殽地，夙夜襄夔龍。

translations.literal: Rooting in heaven to govern earth; day and night assisting like Kui and Long.
translations.idiomatic: Rooting in heaven to govern earth; day and night assisting like Kui and Long.

sentences.zh: 十三解由心生，與政通，作樂崇德應八風。

translations.literal: Thirteenth stanza-break: arising from the heart, connecting with governance; making music to honor virtue, responding to the eight winds.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 13: arising from the heart, connecting with governance; making music to honor virtue, responding to the eight winds.

sentences.zh: 舞蹲蹲，鼓逢逢。

translations.literal: Dances solemn, drums booming.
translations.idiomatic: Dances solemn, drums booming.

sentences.zh: 勸之以九歌，還相為其宮。

translations.literal: Encouraging with the Nine Songs, alternately serving as their tones.
translations.idiomatic: Encouraging with the Nine Songs, alternately serving as their tones.

sentences.zh: 十四解師出律，萃除戎，包戈釁甲百年中。

translations.literal: Fourteenth stanza-break: armies march to measure; gathering to remove warfare; wrapping spears and anointing armor within a hundred years.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 14: armies march to measure; gathering to remove warfare; wrapping spears and anointing armor within a hundred years.

sentences.zh: 戒不虞，慎厥終。

translations.literal: Guarding against the unexpected, careful of the end.
translations.idiomatic: Guarding against the unexpected, careful of the end.

sentences.zh: 有嚴講武事，大閱張軍容。

translations.literal: Solemnly reviewing military affairs, grand inspection displaying army formations.
translations.idiomatic: Solemnly reviewing military affairs, grand inspection displaying army formations.

sentences.zh: 十五解鴞食葚，泮林中，小人革面順以從。

translations.literal: Fifteenth stanza-break: owls eat mulberries; in the forest academy grove, petty men change their faces and follow obediently.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 15: owls eat mulberries; in the forest academy grove, petty men change their faces and follow obediently.

sentences.zh: 嘉肺閒，囹圄空。

translations.literal: Joyful chests at ease; prisons empty.
translations.idiomatic: Joyful chests at ease; prisons empty.

sentences.zh: 訟庭有青草，獄吏服儒風。

translations.literal: On the lawsuit court grows green grass; prison officers follow Confucian ways.
translations.idiomatic: On the lawsuit court grows green grass; prison officers follow Confucian ways.

sentences.zh: 十六解蘭有秀，桂有叢，白駒空谷豈時雍。

translations.literal: Sixteenth stanza-break: orchids have blossoms, cassia has thickets; white colts in empty valleys—how can it not be harmonious?
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 16: orchids have blossoms, cassia has thickets; white colts in empty valleys—how can it not be harmonious?

sentences.zh: 無遺賢，胥在公。

translations.literal: No worthy left behind; all serving the public good.
translations.idiomatic: No worthy left behind; all serving the public good.

sentences.zh: 天工人其代，六合臻郅隆。

translations.literal: Heaven's work, others take on; the six directions reach supreme flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's work, others take on; the six directions reach supreme flourishing.

sentences.zh: 十七解屏籓寄，磐石宗，本支百世五等崇。

translations.literal: Seventeenth stanza-break: shield-wall and feudatory domains entrusted; firm as bedrock, the imperial clan; root and branches for a hundred generations, five ranks honored.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 17: shield-wall and feudatory domains entrusted; firm as bedrock, the imperial clan; root and branches for a hundred generations, five ranks honored.

sentences.zh: 式分玉，匪翦桐。

translations.literal: Ritually dividing jade, not cutting the paulownia.
translations.idiomatic: Ritually dividing jade, not cutting the paulownia.

sentences.zh: 天潢流且長，詎曰陝西東。

translations.literal: The imperial line flows and stretches long; how can one speak only of west and east of Shan?
translations.idiomatic: The imperial line flows and stretches long; how can one speak only of west and east of Shan?

sentences.zh: 十八解繩祖武，紹宗功，於皇繼序克履中。

translations.literal: Eighteenth stanza-break: continuing ancestral martial ways, inheriting clan achievements; O sovereign, in succession treading the center.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 18: continuing ancestral martial ways, inheriting clan achievements; O sovereign, in succession treading the center.

sentences.zh: 震主器，乾飛龍。

translations.literal: Zhen holds the chief vessel; Qian flies as the dragon.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen holds the chief vessel; Qian flies as the dragon.

sentences.zh: 聖聖亶相承，凝旒仰篤恭。

translations.literal: Sage upon sage truly succeed; with fixed crown tassels, looking up in sincere reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Sage upon sage truly succeed; with fixed crown tassels, looking up in sincere reverence.

sentences.zh: 十九解祥繞電，瑞流虹，於萬斯年聖緒洪。

translations.literal: Nineteenth stanza-break: omens coil like lightning, auspice flows like rainbow; for myriad years the sage line vast.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 19: omens coil like lightning, auspice flows like rainbow; for myriad years the sage line vast.

sentences.zh: 麟振姒，乙造娀。

translations.literal: Qilin stirs for Si; Yi marries from Song.
translations.idiomatic: Qilin stirs for Si; Yi marries from Song.

sentences.zh: 文子復文孫，千億紀無窮。

translations.literal: Cultured sons and cultured grandsons; billions of years without end.
translations.idiomatic: Cultured sons and cultured grandsons; billions of years without end.

sentences.zh: 二十解休滋至，昭有融，樂胥受祜龐且鴻。

translations.literal: Twentieth stanza-break: blessings of abundance arrive, bright and harmonious; all rejoice receiving blessing, vast and grand.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 20: blessings of abundance arrive, bright and harmonious; all rejoice receiving blessing, vast and grand.

sentences.zh: 醴泉溢，膏露濃。

translations.literal: Sweet springs overflow, rich dew thickens.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet springs overflow, rich dew thickens.

sentences.zh: 升階協貞吉，萬物泰而通。

translations.literal: Ascending steps accords with upright fortune; the ten thousand things are peaceful and connected.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending steps accords with upright fortune; the ten thousand things are peaceful and connected.

sentences.zh: 二十一解時巡狩，朝會同，淑旂綏章鞗革沖。

translations.literal: Twenty-first stanza-break: timely imperial tours, assemblies paying homage; fine banners and colored pennants, leather stirrups and bridles.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 21: timely imperial tours, assemblies paying homage; fine banners and colored pennants, leather stirrups and bridles.

sentences.zh: 珪贄集，鞮譯從。

translations.literal: Jade and silk offerings gather; interpreters follow.
translations.idiomatic: Jade and silk offerings gather; interpreters follow.

sentences.zh: 聲靈振夷夏，四海仰皇躬。

translations.literal: Numinous prestige shakes barbarians and Chinese alike; the four seas look up to the imperial person.
translations.idiomatic: Numinous prestige shakes barbarians and Chinese alike; the four seas look up to the imperial person.

sentences.zh: 二十二解懍帝謂，敷帝衷，萬年遐福聿來同。

translations.literal: Twenty-second stanza-break: following the emperor's decree, spreading the emperor's heart; blessings from ten thousand years afar all come together.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 22: following the emperor's decree, spreading the emperor's heart; blessings from ten thousand years afar all come together.

sentences.zh: 周嶞岳，漢呼嵩。

translations.literal: Zhou praised Mount Yue, Han called Mount Song.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou praised Mount Yue, Han called Mount Song.

sentences.zh: 籙圖天不老，治化日方中。

translations.literal: The talisman chart—Heaven never ages; governing transformation like the sun at its zenith.
translations.idiomatic: The talisman chart—Heaven never ages; governing transformation like the sun at its zenith.

sentences.zh: 二十三解樂九成，歌三終，一游一豫盛德同。

translations.literal: Twenty-third stanza-break: music of nine parts, songs thrice ended; one journey one ease, magnanimous virtue alike.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 23: music of nine parts, songs thrice ended; one journey one ease, magnanimous virtue alike.

sentences.zh: 臣矢音，瞍奏公。

translations.literal: Ministers pledge their loyalty, blind men present to the lord.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers pledge their loyalty, blind men present to the lord.

sentences.zh: 時邁戛箾｛殸召｝，金石閒笙鏞。

translations.literal: Shi Mai drums and strikes; gold, stone, reed pipes, and bells harmonize.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Mai drums and strikes; gold, stone, reed pipes, and bells harmonize.

sentences.zh: 二十四解

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza 24

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年，平定西域，郊勞，得勝樂鐃歌十六章

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong, the Western Regions were pacified; suburban rewards and victory music—sixteen naoge stanzas obtained.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong, the Western Regions were pacified; suburban rewards and victory music—sixteen naoge stanzas obtained.

sentences.zh: 帝郊天第一帝郊天，天符帝，天心所在帝默契。

translations.literal: Emperor's Suburban Sacrifice to Heaven, First: The emperor sacrifices to Heaven; Heaven's mandate matches the emperor; where Heaven's heart lies, the emperor tacitly agrees.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor's Suburban Sacrifice to Heaven, No. 1: The emperor sacrifices to Heaven; Heaven's mandate matches the emperor; where Heaven's heart lies, the emperor tacitly agrees.

sentences.zh: 暘雨若，風霆明，呼吸感應通以誠。

translations.literal: When sun and rain are as wished, wind and thunder bright; breathing and response connect through sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: When sun and rain are as wished, wind and thunder bright; breathing and response connect through sincerity.

sentences.zh: 龔天罰，誅譎詭，聖人之兵不得已。

translations.literal: Fulfilling Heaven's punishment, executing treacherous schemers; the sage's army acts only when unavoidable.
translations.idiomatic: Fulfilling Heaven's punishment, executing treacherous schemers; the sage's army acts only when unavoidable.

sentences.zh: 武功成，王道昌，順我者存逆者亡。

translations.literal: Martial achievement complete, the kingly way flourishes; those who submit live, those who resist perish.
translations.idiomatic: Martial achievement complete, the kingly way flourishes; those who submit live, those who resist perish.

sentences.zh: 皇威所訖周遐荒，億千萬載德莫量。

translations.literal: Imperial majesty reaches throughout distant wilds; for billions of ages, virtue beyond measure.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial majesty reaches throughout distant wilds; for billions of ages, virtue beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 錫慶長功符，兩大垂榮光。

translations.literal: Bestowing blessing and lasting merit-signs; both great ones shed glory.
translations.idiomatic: Bestowing blessing and lasting merit-signs; both great ones shed glory.

sentences.zh: 爍月竁第二爍月竁，震日淵。

translations.literal: Blazing Moon's Cave, Second: Blazing Moon's Cave—shaking sun and abyss.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing Moon's Cave, No. 2: Blazing Moon's Cave—shaking sun and abyss.

sentences.zh: 埽准夷，開屯田。

translations.literal: Sweeping away the Huai barbarians, opening military colonies.
translations.idiomatic: Sweeping away the Huai barbarians, opening military colonies.

sentences.zh: 式擴自伊犁，地大物奫。

translations.literal: Thus expanding from Yili; land vast, things abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Thus expanding from Yili; land vast, things abundant.

sentences.zh: 若大宛及娑夷，勃律咸慕思弗諼。

translations.literal: Like Dayuan and Sogdiana, Baltistan—all admire and think without rest.
translations.idiomatic: Like Dayuan and Sogdiana, Baltistan—all admire and think without rest.

sentences.zh: 曰中國有聖人，原隸塞垣。

translations.literal: They say China has a sage; they wish to belong to the border realm.
translations.idiomatic: They say China has a sage; they wish to belong to the border realm.

sentences.zh: 遂極亥章之步，網之鄉，莫不奉正朔，備我外籓。

translations.literal: Thus reaching the steps of the highest heaven; every village under the net—none fail to accept the calendar, serving as our outer feudatories.
translations.idiomatic: Thus reaching the steps of the highest heaven; every village under the net—none fail to accept the calendar, serving as our outer feudatories.

sentences.zh: 皇帝愷樂，錫福垓埏。

translations.literal: The emperor joyful and at ease, bestowing blessings to the world's edges.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor joyful and at ease, bestowing blessings to the world's edges.

sentences.zh: 俾各康爾性壽爾年。

translations.literal: Causing each to be healthy in nature and long in years.
translations.idiomatic: Causing each to be healthy in nature and long in years.

sentences.zh: 振王鈇第三振王鈇，天西極。

translations.literal: Shaking the Royal Battle-Axe, Third: shaking the royal battle-axe at heaven's western pole.
translations.idiomatic: Shaking the Royal Battle-Axe, No. 3: shaking the royal battle-axe at heaven's western pole.

sentences.zh: 蠢爾回，久拘縶。

translations.literal: You foolish Hui, long bound in fetters.
translations.idiomatic: You foolish Hui, long bound in fetters.

sentences.zh: 繭之蠶，褌之虱，出爾水火登袵席。

translations.literal: Like silkworms in cocoons, lice in underwear—drawn from water and fire to bed and mats.
translations.idiomatic: Like silkworms in cocoons, lice in underwear—drawn from water and fire to bed and mats.

sentences.zh: 俾畋爾田，宅爾邑，亭毒煦嫗，沐我化澤。

translations.literal: Let you hunt your fields, dwell in your settlements; nurture and warm you, bathe in our civilizing grace.
translations.idiomatic: Let you hunt your fields, dwell in your settlements; nurture and warm you, bathe in our civilizing grace.

sentences.zh: 鷹胡飽颺猘反齧，構逆煽亂，其曷可弗殛。

translations.literal: The Qoqon fed fat, the savage turns and bites; fomenting rebellion and stirring chaos—how can they not be executed?
translations.idiomatic: The Qoqon fed fat, the savage turns and bites; fomenting rebellion and stirring chaos—how can they not be executed?

sentences.zh: 振王鈇，威稜赫。

translations.literal: Shaking the royal battle-axe, dread majesty blazing.
translations.idiomatic: Shaking the royal battle-axe, dread majesty blazing.

sentences.zh: 攻庫車第四庫車言言，我兵既攻。

translations.literal: Attacking Kucha, Fourth: Kucha rises up; our troops already attack.
translations.idiomatic: Attacking Kucha, No. 4: Kucha rises up; our troops already attack.

sentences.zh: 有狡而伺，其來如風。

translations.literal: There are cunning ones lying in wait; they come like wind.
translations.idiomatic: There are cunning ones lying in wait; they come like wind.

sentences.zh: 兩殲醜徒，蜂矢蝟鏃，搴厥回纛，賊頸朘縮。

translations.literal: Twice annihilating the ugly bandits; arrows like bees, like hedgehog quills; pulling down their Hui banners; rebel necks shrink and wither.
translations.idiomatic: Twice annihilating the ugly bandits; arrows like bees, like hedgehog quills; pulling down their Hui banners; rebel necks shrink and wither.

sentences.zh: 鄂根之河，鯨鯢橫波，賊懵就斃，圈牢自薖。

translations.literal: At the Ogren River, whale and crocodile block the waves; rebels stunned meet death, trapping themselves in pens.
translations.idiomatic: At the Ogren River, whale and crocodile block the waves; rebels stunned meet death, trapping themselves in pens.

sentences.zh: 惟彼僨轅，毋戒伏莽。

translations.literal: Only those who turn rebellious—take no warning from ambush in wild grass?
translations.idiomatic: Only those who turn rebellious—take no warning from ambush in wild grass?

sentences.zh: 鳥啼於幕，魚漏於網。

translations.literal: Birds cry from the tent; fish slip through the net.
translations.idiomatic: Birds cry from the tent; fish slip through the net.

sentences.zh: 厥角稽第五厥角稽，乃自易將速進師。

translations.literal: Foreheads to the Ground, Fifth: foreheads to the ground—they yield themselves; swiftly advancing the army.
translations.idiomatic: Foreheads to the Ground, No. 5: foreheads to the ground—they yield themselves; swiftly advancing the army.

sentences.zh: 所向讋伏，弗梧弗枝。

translations.literal: Wherever they go, enemies cower; neither resist nor oppose.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever they go, enemies cower; neither resist nor oppose.

sentences.zh: 剺面膜拜，涕泗漣洏。

translations.literal: Faces slashed, bowing in worship; tears and mucus streaming.
translations.idiomatic: Faces slashed, bowing in worship; tears and mucus streaming.

sentences.zh: 曰惟我戎首，突豨張鴟，哀我憚人肌瘡痍。

translations.literal: Saying only our tribal chief, the savage boar spreading like owls—pity our people, flesh wounded and scarred.
translations.idiomatic: Saying only our tribal chief, the savage boar spreading like owls—pity our people, flesh wounded and scarred.

sentences.zh: 蚍蜉之撼，寧不自知。

translations.literal: Like the mole cricket shaking a tree—do they not know themselves?
translations.idiomatic: Like the mole cricket shaking a tree—do they not know themselves?

sentences.zh: 斨不缺，鏃不遺，遂直抵乎大荒之西。

translations.literal: Axes undulled, arrows undepleted; thus reaching straight to the far west wilderness.
translations.idiomatic: Axes undulled, arrows undepleted; thus reaching straight to the far west wilderness.

sentences.zh: 黑水戰第六黑水之戰騎危脊，懸軍深入為所搤。

translations.literal: Black Water Battle, Sixth: Black Water Battle—horses on perilous ridges; isolated army deeply penetrating, seized by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Black Water Battle, No. 6: Black Water Battle—horses on perilous ridges; isolated army deeply penetrating, seized by the enemy.

sentences.zh: 蜂屯蟻附聚矢石，我馬雖憊人無敵。

translations.literal: Bees swarm, ants gather, arrows and stones mass; our horses though weary, our men unmatched.
translations.idiomatic: Bees swarm, ants gather, arrows and stones mass; our horses though weary, our men unmatched.

sentences.zh: 立成壁壘奮戈戟，賊來薄攻相距尺。

translations.literal: Standing walls erected, wielding spears and halberds; rebels come close attacking, only a foot apart.
translations.idiomatic: Standing walls erected, wielding spears and halberds; rebels come close attacking, only a foot apart.

sentences.zh: 瞋目一呼盡辟易，鉛丸著樹助我擊。

translations.literal: Fierce-eyed one shout—all yield; lead bullets hit trees aiding our strike.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce-eyed one shout—all yield; lead bullets hit trees aiding our strike.

sentences.zh: 靈泉火米資炊汲，重圍三月莫敢迫。

translations.literal: Spirit springs and fire-rice supply cooking; besieged three months, none dare press close.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit springs and fire-rice supply cooking; besieged three months, none dare press close.

sentences.zh: 古來誰與比奇績，萬賊之中兵四百。

translations.literal: Since antiquity who compares to such wonder—among ten thousand rebels, only four hundred troops.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity who compares to such wonder—among ten thousand rebels, only four hundred troops.

sentences.zh: 援兵來第七援兵來，來自天。

translations.literal: Reinforcements Come, Seventh: reinforcements come, come from Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcements Come, No. 7: reinforcements come, come from Heaven.

sentences.zh: 矯躡景，迅掣煙。

translations.literal: Swift as stepping on shadows, quick as pulling smoke.
translations.idiomatic: Swift as stepping on shadows, quick as pulling smoke.

sentences.zh: 援兵來，賊回顧。

translations.literal: Reinforcements come, rebels look back.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcements come, rebels look back.

sentences.zh: 奮螳當，張蛙怒。

translations.literal: Striving like mantises blocking, puffing like angry frogs.
translations.idiomatic: Striving like mantises blocking, puffing like angry frogs.

sentences.zh: 援兵來，堅轉戰。

translations.literal: Reinforcements come, firmly wheeling in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcements come, firmly wheeling in battle.

sentences.zh: 人裹血，馬流汗。

translations.literal: Men wrapped in blood, horses dripping sweat.
translations.idiomatic: Men wrapped in blood, horses dripping sweat.

sentences.zh: 援兵來，前軍回。

translations.literal: Reinforcements come, vanguard returns.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcements come, vanguard returns.

sentences.zh: 摧虎穴，蹴蟻堆。

translations.literal: Crushing tiger dens, kicking anthills.
translations.idiomatic: Crushing tiger dens, kicking anthills.

sentences.zh: 援兵來，若神助。

translations.literal: Reinforcements come, as if divinely aided.
translations.idiomatic: Reinforcements come, as if divinely aided.

sentences.zh: 數月前，奉詔赴。

translations.literal: Months ago, obeying decree to hasten.
translations.idiomatic: Months ago, obeying decree to hasten.

sentences.zh: 阿克蘇第八阿克蘇何高，旋軍暫以休。

translations.literal: Aksu, Eighth: How high is Aksu; wheeling troops briefly to rest.
translations.idiomatic: Aksu, No. 8: How high is Aksu; wheeling troops briefly to rest.

sentences.zh: 蓄銳淬戈銎，選堅制兜鍪。

translations.literal: Storing sharpness, tempering spear-sockets; selecting the hard, making helmets.
translations.idiomatic: Storing sharpness, tempering spear-sockets; selecting the hard, making helmets.

sentences.zh: 名駒千隊來，霜氾籋雲浮。

translations.literal: Famous steeds thousand teams come; frost spreading, clouds floating as they gallop.
translations.idiomatic: Famous steeds thousand teams come; frost spreading, clouds floating as they gallop.

sentences.zh: 以布易彼粟，篚筐為乾餱。

translations.literal: Exchanging cloth for their grain; baskets and boxes for dried provisions.
translations.idiomatic: Exchanging cloth for their grain; baskets and boxes for dried provisions.

sentences.zh: 士飽馬亦騰，氣已無諸酋。

translations.literal: Soldiers fed, horses also spirited; morale already breaks the chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers fed, horses also spirited; morale already breaks the chieftains.

sentences.zh: 鹿斯奔第九鹿斯奔，威所鑠。

translations.literal: Deer Thus Flee, Ninth: deer thus flee, awed by majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Deer Thus Flee, No. 9: deer thus flee, awed by majesty.

sentences.zh: 兵載入，批亢郤。

translations.literal: Troops enter loaded; attacking the vital point, striking the flank.
translations.idiomatic: Troops enter loaded; attacking the vital point, striking the flank.

sentences.zh: 扼吭弗噬，犄角斯搏。

translations.literal: Gripping the throat but not biting; horns locked in combat.
translations.idiomatic: Gripping the throat but not biting; horns locked in combat.

sentences.zh: 鵌鼵並窮，駏蛩偕躩。

translations.literal: Both kinds of rodents exhausted; paired beasts leap together in flight.
translations.idiomatic: Both kinds of rodents exhausted; paired beasts leap together in flight.

sentences.zh: 攟載輜重棄老弱，走險假息神錯愕。

translations.literal: Abandoning wagons, baggage, old and weak; fleeing to peril for brief rest, spirits confounded.
translations.idiomatic: Abandoning wagons, baggage, old and weak; fleeing to peril for brief rest, spirits confounded.

sentences.zh: 火燎毛，風轉籜。

translations.literal: Fire singes fur, wind turns bamboo sheaths.
translations.idiomatic: Fire singes fur, wind turns bamboo sheaths.

sentences.zh: 回城降第十回城降，式歌舞。

translations.literal: Kashgar Surrenders, Tenth: Kashgar surrenders, performing song and dance.
translations.idiomatic: Kashgar Surrenders, No. 10: Kashgar surrenders, performing song and dance.

sentences.zh: 王師入，各安堵。

translations.literal: Royal army enters, each secure in place.
translations.idiomatic: Royal army enters, each secure in place.

sentences.zh: 約法數章，爾摩爾撫。

translations.literal: Laws set in several articles; soothing and comforting you.
translations.idiomatic: Laws set in several articles; soothing and comforting you.

sentences.zh: 賦視賨諡，泉式圜府。

translations.literal: Taxes follow the Chong standard, coins follow the round treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes follow the Chong standard, coins follow the round treasury.

sentences.zh: 噢咻爾民久墊苦，蕃爾畊牧，釋爾刀斧。

translations.literal: Comforting your people long oppressed; flourishing your farming and grazing; releasing your swords and axes.
translations.idiomatic: Comforting your people long oppressed; flourishing your farming and grazing; releasing your swords and axes.

sentences.zh: 昔穴巢，今昄宇，煌煌御碣照萬古。

translations.literal: Once living in caves and nests, now bright houses; the resplendent imperial stele shines through ten thousand ages.
translations.idiomatic: Once living in caves and nests, now bright houses; the resplendent imperial stele shines through ten thousand ages.

sentences.zh: 鴻荒以來，此地榛狉睢呿，豈曾隸中土。

translations.literal: Since primordial chaos, this land was wild brambles and shrieking; how could it ever belong to the Central Plain?
translations.idiomatic: Since primordial chaos, this land was wild brambles and shrieking; how could it ever belong to the Central Plain?

sentences.zh: 伊西洱第十一伊西洱，兩馬不得驅，賊殲不盡此負嵎。

translations.literal: Ishijili, Eleventh: Ishijili—two horses cannot drive; rebels not fully destroyed, they hold their corner.
translations.idiomatic: Ishijili, No. 11: Ishijili—two horses cannot drive; rebels not fully destroyed, they hold their corner.

sentences.zh: 自言一夫當關，萬夫莫逾。

translations.literal: They claim one man guards the pass, ten thousand cannot cross.
translations.idiomatic: They claim one man guards the pass, ten thousand cannot cross.

sentences.zh: 偏師薄之忽驚潰，倒戈降，百千輩。

translations.literal: A detachment presses them suddenly and they collapse in panic; turning their weapons, hundreds surrender.
translations.idiomatic: A detachment presses them suddenly and they collapse in panic; turning their weapons, hundreds surrender.

sentences.zh: 賊酋顧之心膽碎，獨跳而走惟其喙。

translations.literal: The rebel leader's heart shatters in terror; he alone flees, barely escaping with his life.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel leader's heart shatters in terror; he alone flees, barely escaping with his life.

sentences.zh: 伊西洱，功不刊。

translations.literal: Ishijili—achievement that cannot be erased.
translations.idiomatic: Ishijili—achievement that cannot be erased.

sentences.zh: 誰與侔，格登山。

translations.literal: Who can compare? Only Gede Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Who can compare? Only Gede Mountain.

sentences.zh: 和門開第十二和門開，軍容壯。

translations.literal: The Peace Gate Opens, Twelfth: the army's might on display.
translations.idiomatic: The Peace Gate Opens, No. 12: the army's might on display.

sentences.zh: 大荒西，喁內向。

translations.literal: The vast western lands, voices turned inward.
translations.idiomatic: The vast western lands, voices turned inward.

sentences.zh: 傳檄索伏隍，諸羌聞之弗敢藏。

translations.literal: Proclamations seek those hiding in ditches; the Qiang peoples dare not conceal themselves upon hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Proclamations seek those hiding in ditches; the Qiang peoples dare not conceal themselves upon hearing.

sentences.zh: 地犴盡，天網張。

translations.literal: The earth's deepest pits exhausted, heaven's net spread wide.
translations.idiomatic: The earth's deepest pits exhausted, heaven's net spread wide.

sentences.zh: 驚弦既隕，觸蕃復以戕，遣使詣獻屍已僵。

translations.literal: Those fleeing the bowstring fall; touching the frontier brings further harm—their envoy arrives to present the already stiff corpse.
translations.idiomatic: Those fleeing the bowstring fall; touching the frontier brings further harm—their envoy arrives to present the already stiff corpse.

sentences.zh: 和門開，旌旆揚，滿營笳鼓歡聲長。

translations.literal: The Peace Gate opens, banners unfurl; camp drums and horn blasts echo with long celebration.
translations.idiomatic: The Peace Gate opens, banners unfurl; camp drums and horn blasts echo with long celebration.

sentences.zh: 天斷成第十三黃河千年而一清，聖人千年而一生。

translations.literal: Heaven's Decree Fulfilled, Thirteenth: The Yellow River clears once in a millennium; the sage appears once in a millennium.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's Decree Fulfilled, No. 13: The Yellow River clears once in a millennium; the sage appears once in a millennium.

sentences.zh: 曠古之事眾所驚，惟天有斷斷乃成。

translations.literal: Events since antiquity that astonish all; only through heaven's resolute judgment can such completion occur.
translations.idiomatic: Events since antiquity that astonish all; only through heaven's resolute judgment can such completion occur.

sentences.zh: 握神符，貫元精，二萬餘里雷霆行。

translations.literal: Wielding divine symbols, penetrating primal essence; twenty thousand li advance like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Wielding divine symbols, penetrating primal essence; twenty thousand li advance like thunder.

sentences.zh: 密勿指授，六合清以寧。

translations.literal: Through secret counsel and direct commands, the six directions become clear and peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Through secret counsel and direct commands, the six directions become clear and peaceful.

sentences.zh: 天斷成，巍巍之功莫能名。

translations.literal: Heaven's decree fulfilled—its towering achievement cannot be named.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's decree fulfilled—its towering achievement cannot be named.

sentences.zh: 皇式第十四皇式有告，覲於列祖。

translations.literal: Imperial Rite, Fourteenth: The emperor has announced, appearing before the assembled ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Rite, No. 14: The emperor has announced, appearing before the assembled ancestors.

sentences.zh: 兢兢業業，誕受天緒。

translations.literal: Reverent and diligent, receiving heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Reverent and diligent, receiving heaven's mandate.

sentences.zh: 綏此武功，式廓是新。

translations.literal: Continuing this martial achievement, extending the frontier anew.
translations.idiomatic: Continuing this martial achievement, extending the frontier anew.

sentences.zh: 守成創業，兼於一人。

translations.literal: Preserving and creating, both in one person.
translations.idiomatic: Preserving and creating, both in one person.

sentences.zh: 鑒彼下國，立爾烝民。

translations.literal: Guiding the nations below, establishing the people.
translations.idiomatic: Guiding the nations below, establishing the people.

sentences.zh: 凡有血氣者，莫不尊親。

translations.literal: All who possess blood and breath revere and draw near.
translations.idiomatic: All who possess blood and breath revere and draw near.

sentences.zh: 大孝承命，錫嘏以純。

translations.literal: Great filial piety receives the command, blessing in its pure form.
translations.idiomatic: Great filial piety receives the command, blessing in its pure form.

sentences.zh: 慈宮稱慶，天地忻忻。

translations.literal: The benevolent palace celebrates; heaven and earth rejoice together.
translations.idiomatic: The benevolent palace celebrates; heaven and earth rejoice together.

sentences.zh: 辟第十五辟水，流湯湯。

translations.literal: The Waters Open, Fifteenth: waters flow vast.
translations.idiomatic: The Waters Open, No. 15: waters flow vast.

sentences.zh: 爛然五色昭文章。

translations.literal: Five colors brilliant, displaying their patterns.
translations.idiomatic: Five colors brilliant, displaying their patterns.

sentences.zh: 豐碑告功峙宮牆。

translations.literal: A grand stele proclaims achievement, standing at the palace wall.
translations.idiomatic: A grand stele proclaims achievement, standing at the palace wall.

sentences.zh: 鍾鏞{卉鼓}鼓同鏗鏜，皎如日月中天光。

translations.literal: Bells, gongs, and drums resound together, bright as the sun at its zenith.
translations.idiomatic: Bells, gongs, and drums resound together, bright as the sun at its zenith.

sentences.zh: 鴻庸鉅制相得彰，包舉要義重闡揚。

translations.literal: The great monument and massive work complement each other; encompassing essential meaning and re-emphasizing it.
translations.idiomatic: The great monument and massive work complement each other; encompassing essential meaning and re-emphasizing it.

sentences.zh: 崇論開惑示萬方，群蒙洞豁祛疑障。

translations.literal: Exalted discourse opening confusion for all regions; multitudes awaken with clarity, doubt's barrier removed.
translations.idiomatic: Exalted discourse opening confusion for all regions; multitudes awaken with clarity, doubt's barrier removed.

sentences.zh: 原壽璿玉揭講堂，觀摩雒誦垂無疆。

translations.literal: The stele rises like jade at the lecture hall; models of study and recitation extend without bound.
translations.idiomatic: The stele rises like jade at the lecture hall; models of study and recitation extend without bound.

sentences.zh: 帝圖鞏第十六帝圖鞏以大，率土之族，延頸面內，登三咸五昌期會。

translations.literal: The Imperial Design Fortified, Sixteenth: vast and grand; all peoples on the realm stretch necks facing inward to the triple and quintuple flourishing era.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Design Fortified, No. 16: vast and grand; all peoples on the realm stretch necks facing inward to the triple and quintuple flourishing era.

sentences.zh: 群臣請上尊號，皇帝讓弗許，益持盈而保泰。

translations.literal: Ministers request noble titles; the emperor demurs, instead maintaining fullness and preserving prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: Ministers request noble titles; the emperor demurs, instead maintaining fullness and preserving prosperity.

sentences.zh: 欽承天命，夙夜匪懈，方論功行賞恤士卒。

translations.literal: Reverently accepting heaven's mandate without slackening day or night; now discussing rewards and cherishing the troops.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently accepting heaven's mandate without slackening day or night; now discussing rewards and cherishing the troops.

sentences.zh: 問民疾苦，無出明年租稅。

translations.literal: Inquiring into the people's hardships; exempting next year's land tax and levies.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiring into the people's hardships; exempting next year's land tax and levies.

sentences.zh: 天之所覆恩皆沛，於胥樂兮千萬歲。

translations.literal: All beneath heaven's cover receive overflowing grace; all rejoice together for ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: All beneath heaven's cover receive overflowing grace; all rejoice together for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，平定金川，郊勞，鐃歌十六章

translations.literal: Qianlong year forty-one: Jinchuan was pacified; suburban rewards were given; iron-gong songs, sixteen sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year of Qianlong (1776), after Jinchuan was pacified, suburban rewards were given; Iron-Gong Songs, sixteen sections.

sentences.zh: 皇威鬯第一聖略宣，皇威鬯，風行電激物震蕩。

translations.literal: Imperial Might Abundant, first: Sacred strategy proclaimed; imperial might abundant—wind moves, lightning strikes, all things shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Might Abundant, No. 1: Sacred strategy proclaimed; imperial might abundant—wind moves, lightning strikes, all things shaken.

sentences.zh: 物震蕩，聲靈馳，靡堅不破高不摧。

translations.literal: Things shaken; fame and spirit race forth—nothing hard unbroken, nothing high untoppled.
translations.idiomatic: Things shaken; fame and spirit race forth—nothing hard unbroken, nothing high untoppled.

sentences.zh: 曩西域，版圖廓，二萬餘里我疆索。

translations.literal: Formerly the Western Regions; the territory expanded—twenty thousand li our frontier bounds.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Western Regions; the territory expanded—twenty thousand li our frontier bounds.

sentences.zh: 兩金川，敢抗干，自作不靖適自殘。

translations.literal: The two Jinchuan—daring to resist; creating unrest themselves, fittingly destroying themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The two Jinchuan—daring to resist; creating unrest themselves, fittingly destroying themselves.

sentences.zh: 五載底績除凶頑，春風吹鐃入桃關。

translations.literal: Five years to complete the task and remove the fierce and stubborn; spring breeze blows the naos through Peach Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Five years to complete the task and remove the fierce and stubborn; spring breeze blows the naos through Peach Pass.

sentences.zh: 奏凱還，虎臣羆士皆騰歡。

translations.literal: Reporting victory and returning; tiger ministers and bear warriors all leaped with joy.
translations.idiomatic: Reporting victory and returning; tiger ministers and bear warriors all leaped with joy.

sentences.zh: 慎行師第二索諾木，僧格桑，貙生羆，狽附狼。

translations.literal: Cautious in Campaigning, second: Suonuomu, Senggesang—leopard-born, bear-nurtured, jackal-attached, wolf-dependent.
translations.idiomatic: Cautious in Campaigning, No. 2: Suonuomu, Senggesang—leopard-born, bear-nurtured, jackal-attached, wolf-dependent.

sentences.zh: 始蠻觸相尋，奚事斧斨。

translations.literal: At first barbarian snail-ant armies fought one another—what need for axe and adze?
translations.idiomatic: At first rival factions fought like snail-ant armies—what need for axe and adze?

sentences.zh: 越數歲，益蠶食鄰境，遂各罹其殃。

translations.literal: Over several years they increasingly nibbled neighboring borders; thus each met disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Over several years they increasingly nibbled neighboring borders; thus each met disaster.

sentences.zh: 矧聞維州之謠，禍心包藏，浸假約束是偝，恩德是忘。

translations.literal: Moreover hearing rumors from Weizhou; treacherous hearts concealed; gradually treating restraint as betrayal, forgetting grace and virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover hearing rumors from Weizhou; treacherous hearts concealed; gradually treating restraint as betrayal, forgetting grace and virtue.

sentences.zh: 勢在不得已，整我戎行。

translations.literal: The situation compelled no alternative; we ordered our military ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The situation compelled no alternative; we ordered our military ranks.

sentences.zh: 師出以慎，動罔弗臧。

translations.literal: The army marched with caution; in action none was not good.
translations.idiomatic: The army marched with caution; in action none was not good.

sentences.zh: 用乃聲厥罪，懲厥狂。

translations.literal: Thus proclaiming their crimes; punishing their madness.
translations.idiomatic: Thus proclaiming their crimes; punishing their madness.

sentences.zh: 犄角攻第三赫斯怒，兩軍指。

translations.literal: Pincer Attack, third: Wrath blazed forth; two armies pointed forward.
translations.idiomatic: Pincer Attack, No. 3: Wrath blazed forth; two armies pointed forward.

sentences.zh: 巴朗拉，從風靡。

translations.literal: Balangla—following the wind, all collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Balangla—following the wind, all collapsed.

sentences.zh: 取達圍，克資哩，西路角之南路犄。

translations.literal: Taking Dawei; capturing Zili—the western route pincered, the southern route locked horns.
translations.idiomatic: Taking Dawei; capturing Zili—the western route pincered, the southern route locked horns.

sentences.zh: 約咱既得卡丫敉，革布什咱復其疆里，險如達烏安足恃。

translations.literal: Yuezha already taken, Kayademi captured; Gebu Shizan restored his territory—precipitous as Dawu, what could be relied upon?
translations.idiomatic: Yuezha already taken, Kayademi captured; Gebu Shizan restored his territory—precipitous as Dawu, what could be relied upon?

sentences.zh: 鉦擊柝應，俾狂魄震褫。

translations.literal: Gongs struck, watch-clappers answered; making mad spirits tremble and shrink.
translations.idiomatic: Gongs struck, watch-clappers answered; making mad spirits tremble and shrink.

sentences.zh: 夾擊威，洊雷駛。

translations.literal: Pincer attack's might; repeated thunder racing.
translations.idiomatic: Pincer attack's might; repeated thunder racing.

sentences.zh: 趲拉平第四小金之屏，曰僧格宗。

translations.literal: Zanla Pacified, fourth: the screen of Lesser Jin—called Senggezong.
translations.idiomatic: Zanla Pacified, No. 4: the screen of Lesser Jin—called Senggezong.

sentences.zh: 猱攀不度，堅碉如叢。

translations.literal: Monkeys could not climb across; stout blockhouses thick as groves.
translations.idiomatic: Monkeys could not climb across; stout blockhouses thick as groves.

sentences.zh: 我軍先登，摧枯振籜。

translations.literal: Our army scaled first; destroying dry wood, shaking bamboo sheaths.
translations.idiomatic: Our army scaled first; destroying dry wood, shaking bamboo sheaths.

sentences.zh: 深入其阻，直抵美諾。

translations.literal: Plunging deep into their barriers; pressing straight to Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: Plunging deep into their barriers; pressing straight to Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 布朗底木，追圍窮林，厥子喙走，厥父就擒。

translations.literal: At Bulangdimu, pursuing and surrounding through dense forest; his son fled with mouth agape; his father was captured.
translations.idiomatic: At Bulangdimu, pursuing and surrounding through dense forest; his son fled with mouth agape; his father was captured.

sentences.zh: 汗牛板昭，傳檄帖服，趲拉悉平，軍聲赫濯。

translations.literal: Han Niuban submitted; proclamations sent, all submitted; Zanla entirely pacified; military fame resplendent.
translations.idiomatic: Han Niuban submitted; proclamations sent, all submitted; Zanla entirely pacified; military fame resplendent.

sentences.zh: 討促浸第五促浸酋，為逋逃藪罪惡尤。

translations.literal: Punishing Cujin, fifth: the Cujin chief—a refuge for fugitives, crimes especially grave.
translations.idiomatic: Punishing Cujin, No. 5: the Cujin chief—a refuge for fugitives, crimes especially grave.

sentences.zh: 鞠旅移指，討厥比周。

translations.literal: Reviewing troops and shifting direction; punishing their factional collusion.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing troops and shifting direction; punishing their factional collusion.

sentences.zh: 徑阻雪積，我軍遲留。

translations.literal: Paths blocked by piled snow; our army delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Paths blocked by piled snow; our army delayed.

sentences.zh: 彼潛伺徼，■I8逞其狡謀，降番應之紛相投。

translations.literal: They secretly watched for openings; ■I8 displaying their cunning schemes; surrendering tribes responded in confusion, flocking to join.
translations.idiomatic: They secretly watched for openings; ■I8 displaying their cunning schemes; surrendering tribes responded in confusion, flocking to join.

sentences.zh: 屹然南路，整眾還輈。

translations.literal: Firm on the southern route; ordering the host and turning the chariots back.
translations.idiomatic: Firm on the southern route; ordering the host and turning the chariots back.

sentences.zh: 新壁壘，厲鋋矛，遂進次乎田隴之陬。

translations.literal: New ramparts built; sharpening spears and halberds; thus advancing to camp at the edge of field and ridge.
translations.idiomatic: New ramparts built; sharpening spears and halberds; thus advancing to camp at the edge of field and ridge.

sentences.zh: 迅霆復第六簡我禁旅勇且健，七千其眾一敵萬，統以將軍旗鼓建。

translations.literal: Swift Thunder Returns, sixth: selecting our imperial guards—brave and strong; seven thousand men, one against ten thousand; led by the general with flags and drums raised.
translations.idiomatic: Swift Thunder Returns, No. 6: selecting our imperial guards—brave and strong; seven thousand men, one against ten thousand; led by the general with flags and drums raised.

sentences.zh: 定西印授西路進，南路是副聲並震，獎率趫材馳敢戰。

translations.literal: The Dingxi seal conferred; western route advanced; southern route as auxiliary—fame shook together; rewarding and leading swift talents, charging boldly to battle.
translations.idiomatic: The Dingxi seal conferred; western route advanced; southern route as auxiliary—fame shook together; rewarding and leading swift talents, charging boldly to battle.

sentences.zh: 搴旗摩壘士氣奮，履險如夷兵不頓，有若熊虎懾鼯鼴。

translations.literal: Seizing banners and pressing ramparts—morale soared; treading peril like level ground, troops never halted; like bears and tigers terrifying flying squirrels and moles.
translations.idiomatic: Seizing banners and pressing ramparts—morale soared; treading peril like level ground, troops never halted; like bears and tigers terrifying flying squirrels and moles.

sentences.zh: 趲拉全境薙株蔓，曾不旬日收復遍，虩虩如霆一何迅。

translations.literal: Zanla's entire territory—weeded of roots and vines; within ten days recovered throughout; thunderous and swift—how rapid!
translations.idiomatic: Zanla's entire territory—weeded of roots and vines; within ten days recovered throughout; thunderous and swift—how rapid!

sentences.zh: 八旗勇第七八旗兵，來如風。

translations.literal: Eight Banners Valor, seventh: Eight Banners troops—they come like wind.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Banners Valor, No. 7: Eight Banners troops—they come like wind.

sentences.zh: 西路入，谷噶通。

translations.literal: Western route enters; Guga opens through.
translations.idiomatic: Western route enters; Guga opens through.

sentences.zh: 南之隘，克馬尼，拉窠卡，大如礪。

translations.literal: Southern passes—Kemani, Lakewo—large as whetstones.
translations.idiomatic: Southern passes—Kemani, Lakewo—large as whetstones.

sentences.zh: 釃三路，心力齊一，阻險功在西。

translations.literal: Libations on three routes; hearts and strength united; overcoming peril, merit in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Libations on three routes; hearts and strength united; overcoming peril, merit in the west.

sentences.zh: 喇穆山，日則口，據默格，斷其後。

translations.literal: Lamu Mountain, Rize Pass—holding Mogeh, cutting off their rear.
translations.idiomatic: Lamu Mountain, Rize Pass—holding Mogeh, cutting off their rear.

sentences.zh: 八旗兵，勇可賈。

translations.literal: Eight Banners troops—valor beyond price.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Banners troops—valor beyond price.

sentences.zh: 綠營眾，悉鼓舞。

translations.literal: Green Standard troops—all inspired and roused.
translations.idiomatic: Green Standard troops—all inspired and roused.

sentences.zh: 窮猿僵第八我軍馳先聲，醜徒志以離。

translations.literal: Cornered Ape Stiffens, eighth: our army raced with prior fame; the ugly bandits' will was divided.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered Ape Stiffens, No. 8: our army raced with prior fame; the ugly bandits' will was divided.

sentences.zh: 竄渠伏冥誅，械獻貳負屍。

translations.literal: Fleeing chiefs submitted to secret execution; bound and presented, carrying corpses on their backs.
translations.idiomatic: Fleeing chiefs submitted to secret execution; bound and presented, carrying corpses on their backs.

sentences.zh: 七圖及蒙固，縛之如連雞。

translations.literal: Qitu and Menggu—bound like chickens tied in a row.
translations.idiomatic: Qitu and Menggu—bound like chickens tied in a row.

sentences.zh: 系孥側累來，檻致於京師。

translations.literal: Wives and children bound and brought along; caged and conveyed to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wives and children bound and brought along; caged and conveyed to the capital.

sentences.zh: 咄哉窮猿僵，禍速焚林貽。

translations.literal: Alas, the cornered ape stiffens—disaster swift as burning forest brings.
translations.idiomatic: Alas, the cornered ape stiffens—disaster swift as burning forest brings.

sentences.zh: 扼宜喜第九北路險，曰宜喜。

translations.literal: Blocking Yixi, ninth: northern route perilous—called Yixi.
translations.idiomatic: Blocking Yixi, No. 9: northern route perilous—called Yixi.

sentences.zh: 賊死守，限尺咫。

translations.literal: Rebels defended to the death; limited to inches and feet.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels defended to the death; limited to inches and feet.

sentences.zh: 絨布移兵，循塗西指。

translations.literal: Rongbu shifted troops; following the path westward.
translations.idiomatic: Rongbu shifted troops; following the path westward.

sentences.zh: 綽斯請留，原效驅使。

translations.literal: Chuosi requested to remain; willing to serve at command.
translations.idiomatic: Chuosi requested to remain; willing to serve at command.

sentences.zh: 出奇制勝賊披靡，冒雨揚兵兵為洗。

translations.literal: Striking with surprise to win—rebels scattered; braving rain to display troops, the army refreshed.
translations.idiomatic: Striking with surprise to win—rebels scattered; braving rain to display troops, the army refreshed.

sentences.zh: 扼山樑，築我壘。

translations.literal: Blocking the mountain ridge; building our ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: Blocking the mountain ridge; building our ramparts.

sentences.zh: 越重壕第十乘勝攻，賊拒遏。

translations.literal: Crossing Deep Moats, tenth: pressing victory to attack; rebels resisted and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing Deep Moats, No. 10: pressing victory to attack; rebels resisted and blocked.

sentences.zh: 堅碉矗，重壕掘。

translations.literal: Stout blockhouses towered; deep moats dug.
translations.idiomatic: Stout blockhouses towered; deep moats dug.

sentences.zh: 康薩爾山，徑險且崒。

translations.literal: Kangsar Mountain—paths perilous and peaks abrupt.
