translations.idiomatic: Kangsar Mountain—paths perilous and peaks abrupt.

sentences.zh: 鹿角如麻，憑阻轇轕。

translations.literal: Deer-antler stakes thick as hemp; relying on barriers, paths intertwined.
translations.idiomatic: Deer-antler stakes thick as hemp; relying on barriers, paths intertwined.

sentences.zh: 我軍薄之若排闥，曷深曷巍，一躍而越。

translations.literal: Our army pressed close like pushing open a door—however deep, however lofty—leaping over in one bound.
translations.idiomatic: Our army pressed close like pushing open a door—however deep, however lofty—leaping over in one bound.

sentences.zh: 踞厥顛，蹂厥穴，木思工噶取如掇。

translations.literal: Occupying their summit; trampling their lair; Musigong—taken as easily as picking up.
translations.idiomatic: Occupying their summit; trampling their lair; Musigong—taken as easily as picking up.

sentences.zh: 臨高壓之，下視巉岩蒙茸，氣吞力隨拔。

translations.literal: Overlooking from on high and pressing down; looking down on jagged cliffs overgrown; spirit swallowed, strength followed in uprooting.
translations.idiomatic: Overlooking from on high and pressing down; looking down on jagged cliffs overgrown; spirit swallowed, strength followed in uprooting.

sentences.zh: 河之西第十一河之西，穢棘不可窮。

translations.literal: West of the River, eleventh: West of the River—thorns and brambles beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: West of the River, No. 11: West of the River—thorns and brambles beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 元戎決勝合力攻，俾賊顛不得顧，趾不得容。

translations.literal: The commander-in-chief decided victory, attacking with combined force; making rebels unable to look back, feet unable to find footing.
translations.idiomatic: The commander-in-chief decided victory, attacking with combined force; making rebels unable to look back, feet unable to find footing.

sentences.zh: 日旁以右羅寨柵，棄而逃，羸豕蹢。

translations.literal: Ripang and Youluo—stockades and palisades; abandoning and fleeing like emaciated pigs stumbling.
translations.idiomatic: Ripang and Youluo—stockades and palisades; abandoning and fleeing like emaciated pigs stumbling.

sentences.zh: 火其崖垠照熻赫，五十裡間地為赤。

translations.literal: Firing their cliff edges—blazing bright; for fifty li the ground turned red.
translations.idiomatic: Firing their cliff edges—blazing bright; for fifty li the ground turned red.

sentences.zh: 賊潛喘，餘燼灰。

translations.literal: Rebels secretly gasped; remaining embers turned to ash.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels secretly gasped; remaining embers turned to ash.

sentences.zh: 飛將軍，從天來。

translations.literal: The Flying General—from heaven he came.
translations.idiomatic: The Flying General—from heaven he came.

sentences.zh: 後路清第十二夾河陣，軍相望。

translations.literal: Rear Route Cleared, twelfth: flanking the river in formation—armies facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Rear Route Cleared, No. 12: flanking the river in formation—armies facing one another.

sentences.zh: 風雲通，氣益壯。

translations.literal: Wind and clouds connected; morale grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: Wind and clouds connected; morale grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 噶爾丹既攻，建瓴注之扼彼沖。

translations.literal: Ga'erdan already attacked; like water poured from a high eave—blocking their thrust.
translations.idiomatic: Ga'erdan already attacked; like water poured from a high eave—blocking their thrust.

sentences.zh: 清後路，勝算雄。

translations.literal: Clearing the rear route; strategic calculation bold.
translations.idiomatic: Clearing the rear route; strategic calculation bold.

sentences.zh: 狙伏為患，惟遜克爾宗，梯牆斫穴如抉叢。

translations.literal: Ambush lurking was the trouble—only at Xunke'erzong; scaling walls and hacking holes like splitting a thicket.
translations.idiomatic: Ambush lurking was the trouble—only at Xunke'erzong; scaling walls and hacking holes like splitting a thicket.

sentences.zh: 後路清，賊勢窮，世臣繼勇勛名崇。

translations.literal: Rear route cleared; rebel power exhausted; hereditary ministers succeeding in valor—merit and fame exalted.
translations.idiomatic: Rear route cleared; rebel power exhausted; hereditary ministers succeeding in valor—merit and fame exalted.

sentences.zh: 一窟摧第十三昆色爾高騎脊危，拉枯下瞰烈焰飛。

translations.literal: One Den Destroyed, thirteenth: Kunse'er—high astride the ridge, perilous; pulling down dry wood, looking down on flying flames.
translations.idiomatic: One Den Destroyed, No. 13: Kunse'er—high astride the ridge, perilous; pulling down dry wood, looking down on flying flames.

sentences.zh: 菑則大海鞭一麾，奇謀百出克勒圍。

translations.literal: Zaidahai with one whip-stroke of command; stratagems by the hundred—Kelesie besieged.
translations.idiomatic: Zaidahai with one whip-stroke of command; stratagems by the hundred—Kelesie besieged.

sentences.zh: 八月中，夜半時，月光鏡膽寒妖魑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, at midnight; moonlight mirror-bright—gall chilled, demons and sprites.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, at midnight; moonlight mirror-bright—gall chilled, demons and sprites.

sentences.zh: 狡有三窟，一窟固已摧。

translations.literal: The cunning have three dens—one den was already destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The cunning have three dens—one den was already destroyed.

sentences.zh: 磨盾馳木蘭，八日來紅旗。

translations.literal: Polishing shields, racing to Mulan; on the eighth day the red banners came.
translations.idiomatic: Polishing shields, racing to Mulan; on the eighth day the red banners came.

sentences.zh: 釜底魂第十四西里既劃，卡角斯折。

translations.literal: Pot-Bottom Souls, fourteenth: Xili already divided; Kajiaosi broken.
translations.idiomatic: Pot-Bottom Souls, No. 14: Xili already divided; Kajiaosi broken.

sentences.zh: 彼頑不靈，螳斧當轍。

translations.literal: They were stubborn and unresponsive; mantis axes blocking the wheel-tracks.
translations.idiomatic: They were stubborn and unresponsive; mantis axes blocking the wheel-tracks.

sentences.zh: 索隆科布，屢摧其堅。

translations.literal: Suolongkebu—repeatedly breaking their strongholds.
translations.idiomatic: Suolongkebu—repeatedly breaking their strongholds.

sentences.zh: 安布魯木，迅埽其孱。

translations.literal: Anbulumu—swiftly sweeping away their weakness.
translations.idiomatic: Anbulumu—swiftly sweeping away their weakness.

sentences.zh: 舍齊暮搗，雍中朝搴。

translations.literal: Sheqi attacked at dusk; Yongzhong captured at dawn.
translations.idiomatic: Sheqi attacked at dusk; Yongzhong captured at dawn.

sentences.zh: 盡撤籓以入，巢幕岌焉。

translations.literal: All outer defenses withdrawn inward; nest and canopy tottering.
translations.idiomatic: All outer defenses withdrawn inward; nest and canopy tottering.

sentences.zh: 賊境日蹙，百才一存。

translations.literal: Rebel territory daily contracted; only one in a hundred remained.
translations.idiomatic: Rebel territory daily contracted; only one in a hundred remained.

sentences.zh: 釜底群聚，遊魂曷延。

translations.literal: Gathered at the pot's bottom; wandering souls—how could they prolong?
translations.idiomatic: Gathered at the pot's bottom; wandering souls—how could they prolong?

sentences.zh: 穴蟻埽第十五賊負固，噶喇依。

translations.literal: Den Ants Swept, fifteenth: rebels held firm—Gala Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Den Ants Swept, No. 15: rebels held firm—Gala Yi.

sentences.zh: 困獸猶鬥四面圍，批其腹心外不支。

translations.literal: Cornered beasts still fought—surrounded on four sides; striking their belly and heart, the outer defenses could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered beasts still fought—surrounded on four sides; striking their belly and heart, the outer defenses could not hold.

sentences.zh: 甲雜獨松潰河西，馬邦拾芥彼自隳。

translations.literal: Jiazadusong collapsed west of the river; Mabang—picking mustard seeds—they destroyed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Jiazadusong collapsed west of the river; Mabang—picking mustard seeds—they destroyed themselves.

sentences.zh: 陸罝水罟會我師，環以巨砲焦灼期。

translations.literal: Land nets and water weirs joined our army; encircled with great cannon, scorching as expected.
translations.idiomatic: Land nets and water weirs joined our army; encircled with great cannon, scorching as expected.

sentences.zh: 計窮乞命俘渠魁，罪人斯得逮旄倪。

translations.literal: Plans exhausted, begging for life—the rebel chiefs captured; criminals thus obtained, old and young seized.
translations.idiomatic: Plans exhausted, begging for life—the rebel chiefs captured; criminals thus obtained, old and young seized.

sentences.zh: 穴蟻迅埽無留遺，定以百戰誠若斯。

translations.literal: Den ants swiftly swept, none left behind; settled through a hundred battles—faith such as this.
translations.idiomatic: Den ants swiftly swept, none left behind; settled through a hundred battles—faith such as this.

sentences.zh: 武功成第十六武功蕆，珠丘告。

translations.literal: Martial Achievement Completed, sixteenth: martial achievement completed—Pearl Mound proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Martial Achievement Completed, No. 16: martial achievement completed—Pearl Mound proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 禮成駐蹕，露布適報，策勛懋賞下明詔。

translations.literal: Rites completed, the imperial halt; victory bulletins just reported; recording merit, grand rewards—imperial edict issued.
translations.idiomatic: Rites completed, the imperial halt; victory bulletins just reported; recording merit, grand rewards—imperial edict issued.

sentences.zh: 遂奉慈輦東狩還，舉郊勞儀，獻累俘於社廟。

translations.literal: Thus escorting the empress dowager's carriage east on the hunt return; holding suburban reward rites; presenting chained captives at the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Thus escorting the empress dowager's carriage east on the hunt return; holding suburban reward rites; presenting chained captives at the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 崇善歸美，尊上徽號。

translations.literal: Honoring virtue and attributing beauty; elevating the honorific title.
translations.idiomatic: Honoring virtue and attributing beauty; elevating the honorific title.

sentences.zh: 親制紀功碣，勒太學，第功臣次，燕紫光，圖其貌。

translations.literal: Personally composing the merit-recording stele; carved at the Imperial Academy; ranking meritorious ministers in order; banquet at Ziguang Hall; painting their likenesses.
translations.idiomatic: Personally composing the merit-recording stele; carved at the Imperial Academy; ranking meritorious ministers in order; banquet at Ziguang Hall; painting their likenesses.

sentences.zh: 屯師設鎮洽聲教，億千萬禩安笮徼。

translations.literal: Stationing troops and establishing garrisons; civilizing instruction harmonized; for billions of years peace at the frontier passes.
translations.idiomatic: Stationing troops and establishing garrisons; civilizing instruction harmonized; for billions of years peace at the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 巡幸鐃歌清樂二十七章乾隆七年定。

translations.literal: Patrol-expedition iron-gong song clear music, twenty-seven sections, fixed in Qianlong year seven.
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-seven sections of Clear Music for Patrol Iron-Gong Songs were established in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign, 1742.

sentences.zh: 九龍旃第一九龍旃，旌旗列宿懸。

translations.literal: Nine Dragon Pennants, first: Nine Dragon Pennants—banners and flags hang like the arrayed constellations.
translations.idiomatic: Nine Dragon Pennants, No. 1: Nine Dragon Pennants—standards and flags hang like stars arrayed across the sky.

sentences.zh: 龍角天田見，箕翼常舒展。

translations.literal: Dragon Horn and Celestial Field appear; Winnowing Basket and Wings constantly unfold and spread.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Horn and the Celestial Field appear; the Winnowing Basket and Wings stretch open as ever.

sentences.zh: 龍尾更連蜷，牽牛近代房心建，東壁耀星躔。

translations.literal: Dragon Tail further coils in succession; Lead Ox in recent times, Heart of the Room erected; Eastern Wall gleams with stellar tracks.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Tail coils on in turn; Lead Ox recently, Heart of the Room raised; the Eastern Wall gleams with stellar passage.

sentences.zh: 一解婉孌，奎文麗日天階見，參旗曳九旒，玉井珠駢。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: graceful and lovely; Kui's pattern—a beautiful sun on heaven's stair appears; Three Stars banner drags nine tassels; Jade Well, pearls side by side.
translations.idiomatic: First stanza-break: tender and lovely—Kui's pattern, a splendid sun on heaven's stairs; the Three Stars banner trails nine tassels; Jade Well, pearls in a row.

sentences.zh: 柳七星，曲曲如鉤卷。

translations.literal: Willow Seven Stars—curved and bent like hooks rolled up.
translations.idiomatic: The Willow Seven Stars—each curve bent like a coiled hook.

sentences.zh: 和門啟，萬幕褰。

translations.literal: Harmony Gate opens; ten thousand screens are drawn aside.
translations.idiomatic: The Harmony Gate opens; ten thousand screens are drawn aside.

sentences.zh: 二解

translations.literal: Second stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Second stanza-break.

sentences.zh: 鬯皇威第二鬯皇威，好山如障翠屏圍。

translations.literal: Stirring Imperial Majesty, second: Stirring Imperial Majesty—fine mountains like barriers, emerald screens encircling.
translations.idiomatic: Stirring Imperial Majesty, No. 2: Stirring Imperial Majesty—fine mountains stand like barriers, emerald screens all around.

sentences.zh: 凝樹色，煙成縷；

translations.literal: Tree colors congeal; smoke forms into threads;
translations.idiomatic: Tree colors deepen; smoke threads into wisps;

sentences.zh: 鎖嵐光，雲漸低。

translations.literal: Mountain-mist light is locked in; clouds gradually lower.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain mist locks in the light; clouds sink lower.

sentences.zh: 回峻岭，絲韁徐按，度崇岡，玉勒輕提。

translations.literal: Turning at steep peaks, silk reins slowly pressed; crossing lofty ridges, jade bridle lightly lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Turning at steep peaks, silk reins gently pressed; crossing lofty ridges, jade bridle lightly raised.

sentences.zh: 龜背鎧，滲金盔，月明風曳素綃旗。

translations.literal: Tortoise-shell armor, gold-permeated helmets; under moonlight and wind, plain silk banners trail.
translations.idiomatic: Tortoise-shell armor, gold-inlaid helmets; in moonlight and wind, plain silk banners flutter.

sentences.zh: 一解靖邊陲，為思將帥鼓征鼙。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: pacifying the frontier borders; thinking of generals and commanders, beating campaign drums.
translations.idiomatic: First stanza-break: pacifying the frontier borders; mindful of generals and commanders, the campaign drums beat.

sentences.zh: 嫺八陣，齊九伐，用三驅，式九圍。

translations.literal: Skilled in the Eight Formations, aligned with the Nine Punitive Campaigns; employing the Three Drives, deploying the Nine Encirclements.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled in the Eight Formations, aligned with the Nine Punitive Campaigns; employing the Three Drives, deploying the Nine Encirclements.

sentences.zh: 撼山嶽，風雲動色；

translations.literal: Shaking mountains and peaks, wind and clouds change color;
translations.idiomatic: Mountains and peaks tremble; wind and clouds shift hue;

sentences.zh: 固封疆，鸛鶴爭奇。

translations.literal: Securing the borders; crane and stork formations vie in splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Securing the borders; crane and stork formations vie in splendor.

sentences.zh: 驅驃褭，跨纖驪，日輪高擁杏黃旗。

translations.literal: Driving swift steeds, straddling slender black horses; the sun-wheel high, apricot-yellow banners embraced.
translations.idiomatic: Driving swift steeds, straddling slender black horses; the sun rides high, apricot-yellow banners unfurled.

sentences.zh: 二解奠鴻基，百年不用是王師。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: laying the foundation for enduring rule; for a hundred years the royal army has not been needed.
translations.idiomatic: Second stanza-break: laying the foundation for enduring rule; for a century the royal army has not been needed.

sentences.zh: 在園囿，麟和鳳，貢琛球，航與梯。

translations.literal: In parks and preserves, unicorns and phoenixes; tribute jades arrive by sea and by land.
translations.idiomatic: In parks and preserves, unicorns and phoenixes dwell; tribute jades arrive by sea and by land.

sentences.zh: 因農隙，講求獮狩；

translations.literal: Taking advantage of slack seasons in farming, they practice the autumn hunt;
translations.idiomatic: During slack seasons in farming, they practice the autumn hunt;

sentences.zh: 際時和，訓練熊羆。

translations.literal: When times are harmonious, they train bear-like warriors.
translations.idiomatic: When times are harmonious, they train bear-like warriors.

sentences.zh: 獅蠻帶，錦襴圍，晴雲不動絳紅旗。

translations.literal: Lion-skin belts, brocade skirts; under clear clouds, crimson banners hang motionless.
translations.idiomatic: Lion-skin belts, brocade skirts; under clear skies, crimson banners hang still.

sentences.zh: 三解太平時，狼煙不設羽書稀。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: in an age of great peace, beacon fires are not set and military dispatches are rare.
translations.idiomatic: Third stanza-break: in an age of great peace, beacon fires are unneeded and military dispatches are rare.

sentences.zh: 四郊外，無烽壘，四民中，多壽耆。

translations.literal: Beyond the four outskirts, no beacon towers; among the four peoples, many live to old age.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the four outskirts, no beacon towers stand; among the four peoples, many live to old age.

sentences.zh: 枌榆社，我田我稼；

translations.literal: Elm and mulberry altars—our fields, our crops;
translations.idiomatic: At elm and mulberry village altars—our fields, our crops;

sentences.zh: 羽林郎，如虎如貔。

translations.literal: Palace guard youths—like tigers, like bears.
translations.idiomatic: Palace guard youths—fierce as tigers, bold as bears.

sentences.zh: 短後衣，曼胡垂，遠山一抹蔚藍旗。

translations.literal: Short rear jackets, Man-Hu blades hanging; distant mountains—a stroke of azure-blue banners.
translations.idiomatic: Short rear jackets, Man-Hu blades at their sides; distant mountains—a sweep of azure-blue banners.

sentences.zh: 四解綠陰中，凱奏歌聲美，蘆管清笳沸。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: amid green shade, victory music and song sound beautiful; reed pipes and clear flutes boil over.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth stanza-break: amid green shade, victory music and song sound beautiful; reed pipes and clear flutes ring out.

sentences.zh: 四海樂昌期，萬國圖王會。

translations.literal: The four seas rejoice in a flourishing age; ten thousand states aspire to the royal assembly.
translations.idiomatic: The four seas rejoice in a flourishing age; ten thousand states aspire to the royal assembly.

sentences.zh: 馬如龍，迤邐車如水。

translations.literal: Horses like dragons; winding carriages like flowing water.
translations.idiomatic: Horses like dragons; winding carriages like flowing water.

sentences.zh: 馬如龍，迤邐車如水。

translations.literal: Horses like dragons; winding carriages like flowing water.
translations.idiomatic: Horses like dragons; winding carriages like flowing water.

sentences.zh: 五解

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth stanza-break.

sentences.zh: 整貔貅第三整貔貅，順天因地。

translations.literal: Marshaling the Tiger-Brigades, third: Marshaling the Tiger-Brigades—following heaven and adapting to terrain.
translations.idiomatic: Marshaling the Tiger-Brigades, No. 3: Marshaling the Tiger-Brigades—following heaven and adapting to terrain.

sentences.zh: 依山建壘，制勝爭奇。

translations.literal: Building ramparts along mountains; seizing victory and vying in stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Building ramparts along the mountains; seizing victory and vying in stratagem.

sentences.zh: 鄭鵝越雁，鸛鶴兼魚麗。

translations.literal: Zheng goose, Yue wild goose, crane and stork together with Fish-Scale formation.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng goose, Yue wild goose, crane and stork together with the Fish-Scale formation.

sentences.zh: 箕翼張舒，常山形勢用神機。

translations.literal: Winnowing Basket and Wings spread open; Constant Mountain disposition employs divine stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Winnowing Basket and Wings spread open; the Constant Mountain disposition employs divine stratagem.

sentences.zh: 太乙陰符秘，先天遁甲奇。

translations.literal: Great Unity's Secret Yin Talisman; Primordial Heaven's Hidden Stems and Branches—marvelous.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Unity's Secret Yin Talisman; Primordial Heaven's Hidden Stems and Branches—marvelous.

sentences.zh: 牝牡方圓，縱橫斜銳，變化從心起。

translations.literal: Female and male, square and round; vertical, horizontal, slanting, sharp—changes arise from the heart's will.
translations.idiomatic: Female and male, square and round; vertical, horizontal, slanting, sharp—changes arise at will.

sentences.zh: 左銛戈，右雄戟，硃矰丹羽去忘歸。

translations.literal: Left sharp halberds, right mighty halberds; vermilion arrows with crimson feathers fly without return.
translations.idiomatic: Left sharp halberds, right mighty halberds; vermilion arrows with crimson feathers fly without return.

sentences.zh: 朝陽舒畫旗，柳葉貼青驪，車書萬里同文軌。

translations.literal: Morning sun spreads painted banners; willow-leaf patterns adorn blue-black steeds; carts and writing for ten thousand li share the same rails and tracks.
translations.idiomatic: Morning sun spreads painted banners; willow-leaf patterns adorn blue-black steeds; carts and writing unite for ten thousand li on the same rails and tracks.

sentences.zh: 河清海晏第四河清海晏，花村犬不喧。

translations.literal: River Runs Clear and Sea Is Calm, fourth: river runs clear and sea is calm—dogs in flower villages do not bark.
translations.idiomatic: River Runs Clear and Sea Is Calm, No. 4: rivers run clear and seas are calm—dogs in flower villages do not bark.

sentences.zh: 講武訓戎旃，幕府多雄健。

translations.literal: Drilling troops and training soldiers; the command tent holds many brave and strong men.
translations.idiomatic: Drilling troops and training soldiers; the command tent holds many brave and strong men.

sentences.zh: 韜鈐有祕傳，虎旅列戈鋋。

translations.literal: Secret strategies for war leadership are passed down; tiger-brigades array spears and blades.
translations.idiomatic: Secret strategies for war leadership are passed down; tiger-brigades array spears and blades.

sentences.zh: 村吹靄暮煙，鉦鼓競喧闐，郊原自晏然。

translations.literal: Village flutes rise through evening mist; cymbals and drums compete in clamor; the outskirts remain serene.
translations.idiomatic: Village flutes rise through evening mist; cymbals and drums compete in clamor; the outskirts remain serene.

sentences.zh: 轟雷掣電，端的是，有徵無戰，有徵無戰。

translations.literal: Thunder rumbles and lightning flashes—this is truly expedition without battle, expedition without battle.
translations.idiomatic: Thunder rumbles and lightning flashes—this is truly expedition without battle, expedition without battle.

sentences.zh: 輦路平第五輦路平，錦隊開，寶纛懸，日麗風和瑞氣鮮。

translations.literal: Imperial Road Level, fifth: imperial road level—brocade ranks open, treasured standards hang; sun bright, wind mild, auspicious air fresh.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Road Level, No. 5: the imperial road lies level—brocade ranks open, treasured standards hang; sun bright, wind mild, auspicious air fresh.

sentences.zh: 前旌載鳴鳶，春旗曳柳煙。

translations.literal: Forward banners bear singing kites; spring flags trail through willow smoke.
translations.idiomatic: Forward banners bear singing kites; spring flags trail through willow smoke.

sentences.zh: 遙聽處，喚晴鳩，啼杜鵑。

translations.literal: Listening from afar—calling the clear rainbird, cuckoos cry.
translations.idiomatic: Listening from afar—calling the clear rainbird, cuckoos cry.

sentences.zh: 寶★I9琱弓，繽紛在後先。

translations.literal: Precious carved bow—colorful, front and rear.
translations.idiomatic: Precious carved bows—colorful, front and rear.

sentences.zh: 氣雄邊，花飄柳葉韉，鞭敲錦連錢。

translations.literal: Bold spirit at the frontier; flowers scatter on willow-leaf saddles; whips strike brocade coins strung together.
translations.idiomatic: Bold spirit at the frontier; flowers scatter on willow-leaf saddles; whips strike brocade coins strung together.

sentences.zh: 鉦鼓聲，隊隊悠揚出遠天。

translations.literal: Cymbal and drum sounds—each rank floats out toward distant heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Cymbal and drum sounds—each rank floats out toward distant heaven.

sentences.zh: 農夫自力田，村童自笑喧。

translations.literal: Farmers work their own fields; village children laugh and chatter on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Farmers work their own fields; village children laugh and chatter on their own.

sentences.zh: 望前驅，早度夕陽川。

translations.literal: Gazing ahead at the vanguard, early crossing Sunset River.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing ahead at the vanguard, early crossing Sunset River.

sentences.zh: 望前驅，早度夕陽川。

translations.literal: Gazing ahead at the vanguard, early crossing Sunset River.
translations.idiomatic: Gazing ahead at the vanguard, early crossing Sunset River.

sentences.zh: 景清明第六景清明，萬匯蘇，雲物煥皇圖。

translations.literal: Scenery Clear and Bright, sixth: scenery clear and bright—all things revive, clouds and objects renew the imperial chart.
translations.idiomatic: Scenery Clear and Bright, No. 6: scenery clear and bright—all things revive, clouds and objects renew the imperial chart.

sentences.zh: 集禎符，羽儀絡繹在春田駐。

translations.literal: Auspicious signs gathered; feathered regalia in endless succession halt upon spring fields.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious signs gathered; feathered regalia in endless succession halt upon the spring fields.

sentences.zh: 聖武光昭第七聖武兮光昭，玉燭兮時調，秋獮冬狩建旌旄。

translations.literal: Sacred Martial Splendor Illuminated, seventh: sacred martial splendor illuminated; jade candle harmoniously tuned—autumn hunts and winter hunts raise banners and flags.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred Martial Splendor Illuminated, No. 7: sacred martial splendor illuminated; the jade candle harmoniously tuned—autumn hunts and winter hunts raise banners and flags.

sentences.zh: 曳虹旓，四方永定樂清朝。

translations.literal: Trailing rainbow pennants; the four quarters forever settled, rejoicing in the clear dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: Trailing rainbow pennants; the four quarters forever settled, rejoicing in the clear dynasty.

sentences.zh: 琱弧久已櫜，龍泉久已韜，句陳翊衛天樞耀。

translations.literal: Carved bows long sheathed; Dragon Spring long stowed; Gouchen guards and escorts, Celestial Pivot gleaming.
translations.idiomatic: Carved bows long sheathed; Dragon Spring long stowed; Gouchen guards and escorts, the Celestial Pivot gleaming.

sentences.zh: 兩階干羽格有苗，埽盡欃槍舞舜韶。

translations.literal: At the two staircases, feathered dancers subdue the Miao; sweeping away the comet-star, dancing Shun's music.
translations.idiomatic: At the two staircases, feathered dancers subdue the Miao; sweeping away the comet-star, dancing Shun's music.

sentences.zh: 中天泰交，文教敷，敷文教。

translations.literal: Heaven's center in great harmony; civil instruction spread abroad—spread civil instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's center in great harmony; civil instruction spread abroad—spread civil instruction.

sentences.zh: 皇風泰第八皇風泰，景物妍，元虯奕奕辰旒建。

translations.literal: Imperial Wind at Peace, eighth: imperial wind at peace—scenery beautiful; primordial dragon splendid, celestial tassels raised.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Wind at Peace, No. 8: imperial wind at peace—scenery beautiful; the primordial dragon splendid, celestial tassels raised.

sentences.zh: 編氓遍霑膏雨，聽歡呼，自南自北自西東。

translations.literal: Registered commoners everywhere moistened by nourishing rain; hearing cheers—from south, from north, from west, from east.
translations.idiomatic: Registered commoners everywhere moistened by nourishing rain; hearing cheers—from south, from north, from west, from east.

sentences.zh: 六解規制度，衡量同，式震疊，琛球貢。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: regulating institutions; measures and scales alike; pattern shaking layered; tribute jades offered.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth stanza-break: regulating institutions; measures and scales alike; pattern shaking layered; tribute jades offered.

sentences.zh: 率遐邇，北暨恆山；

translations.literal: Leading the distant and near; north reaching Mount Heng;
translations.idiomatic: Leading the distant and near; north reaching Mount Heng;

sentences.zh: 率遐邇，北暨恆山，西至流沙，南被交邕。

translations.literal: Leading the distant and near; north reaching Mount Heng, west to Flowing Sands, south covering Jiao and Yong.
translations.idiomatic: Leading the distant and near; north reaching Mount Heng, west to Flowing Sands, south covering Jiao and Yong.

sentences.zh: 典禮咸修，裳華胥葉，聲靈神悚。

translations.literal: Canonical rites all restored; garments like Hua Xu's leaves; voice and spirit, gods awed.
translations.idiomatic: Canonical rites all restored; garments like Hua Xu's leaves; voice and spirit, gods awed.

sentences.zh: 信長此獻嘉符，振麟儀鳳。

translations.literal: Truly forever thus presenting auspicious tokens; rousing unicorn bearing, phoenix ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Truly forever thus presenting auspicious tokens; rousing unicorn bearing, phoenix ceremony.

sentences.zh: 七解百職猗歟式序，百祿亶其式總。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: a hundred offices—ah, in proper order; a hundred blessings truly gathered in pattern.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh stanza-break: a hundred offices—ah, in proper order; a hundred blessings truly gathered in pattern.

sentences.zh: 於繹哉，永綏民，於皇哉，允執中。

translations.literal: How continuous! Forever pacifying the people; how august! Truly holding the center.
translations.idiomatic: How continuous! Forever pacifying the people; how august! Truly holding the center.

sentences.zh: 時巡幸，虎賁扈從。

translations.literal: Timely patrol and visit; tiger-guards escort and follow.
translations.idiomatic: Timely patrol and visit; tiger-guards escort and follow.

sentences.zh: 從律奏，聲諧八風。

translations.literal: Following regulated performance; sounds harmonize with the eight winds.
translations.idiomatic: Following regulated performance; sounds harmonize with the eight winds.

sentences.zh: 從丕冒，率俾提封。

translations.literal: Following great covering; leading all to raise their boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Following great covering; leading all to raise their boundaries.

sentences.zh: 編氓，遍霑膏雨樂饔飧，自春自夏自秋冬。

translations.literal: Registered commoners everywhere moistened by nourishing rain, rejoicing in meals—from spring, from summer, from autumn, from winter.
translations.idiomatic: Registered commoners everywhere moistened by nourishing rain, rejoicing in meals—from spring, from summer, from autumn, from winter.

sentences.zh: 八解重熙累洽如天永，蕩蕩巍巍郅隆，翠輦行來紫氣擁。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: repeated brilliance, accumulated harmony like heaven eternal; vast and lofty, utmost flourishing; emerald carriage comes, purple air embraces.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth stanza-break: repeated brilliance, accumulated harmony like heaven eternal; vast and lofty, utmost flourishing; emerald carriage comes, purple air embraces.

sentences.zh: 九解

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth stanza-break.

sentences.zh: 聖德巍巍第二十三聖德巍巍洽九天，大啟文明會，景福綿，熙和民物更鮮妍。

translations.literal: Sacred Virtue Lofty, twenty-third: sacred virtue lofty harmonizes the nine heavens; greatly opening the civilizing assembly; splendid blessings continuous; flourishing harmony, people and things more fresh and bright.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred Virtue Lofty, No. 23: sacred virtue lofty harmonizes the nine heavens; greatly opening the civilizing assembly; splendid blessings continuous; flourishing harmony, people and things more fresh and bright.

sentences.zh: 麗紫垣，策星夜動，鸞旆發郊原。

translations.literal: Beautiful at the Purple Enclosure; planning stars move by night; phoenix banners depart from suburbs and plains.
translations.idiomatic: Beautiful at the Purple Enclosure; planning stars move by night; phoenix banners depart from suburbs and plains.

sentences.zh: 一解河清海晏，王道正平平，思文謨武烈，丕承丕顯。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: river clear, sea calm; royal way just and level; thinking of civil plans, martial glory; greatly inheriting, greatly manifesting.
translations.idiomatic: First stanza-break: river clear, sea calm; royal way just and level; thinking of civil plans, martial glory; greatly inheriting, greatly manifesting.

sentences.zh: 締造巍然，監於成憲，其永無愆。

translations.literal: Founding majestic; taking as model the completed statutes—forever without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Founding majestic; taking as model the completed statutes—forever without fault.

sentences.zh: 二解萬方賓服仁風扇，義問昭宣，雕題鑿齒，重譯來朝獻。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: ten thousand regions guest-submit; benevolent wind fans; righteous renown proclaimed; carved foreheads, filed teeth—double translation comes to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Second stanza-break: ten thousand regions guest-submit; benevolent wind fans; righteous renown proclaimed; carved foreheads, filed teeth—double translation comes to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 東風便，黃支烏弋識時先。

translations.literal: East wind favorable; Huangzhi and Wuyi recognize the timely advance.
translations.idiomatic: East wind favorable; Huangzhi and Wuyi recognize the timely advance.

sentences.zh: 更白狼玄菟，金馬硃鳶，盡入版輿遠。

translations.literal: Moreover White Wolf and Black Rabbit, Golden Horse and Vermilion Kite—all enter the registered cart, far and wide.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover White Wolf and Black Rabbit, Golden Horse and Vermilion Kite—all enter the registered cart, far and wide.

sentences.zh: 三解聲教無邊，亙九垓，控八埏。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: voice and instruction without bounds; spanning the nine regions; controlling the eight directions.
translations.idiomatic: Third stanza-break: voice and instruction without bounds; spanning the nine regions; controlling the eight directions.

sentences.zh: 陟堯封，過禹甸。

translations.literal: Ascending Yao's mound; passing Yu's domain.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending Yao's mound; passing Yu's domain.

sentences.zh: 撫殷土，歷周原。

translations.literal: Comforting Yin's land; traversing Zhou's plain.
translations.idiomatic: Comforting Yin's land; traversing Zhou's plain.

sentences.zh: 漸被暨訖，仰清光，北斗高懸。

translations.literal: Gradually covering to the ends; gazing up at clear light—the Northern Dipper hangs high.
translations.idiomatic: Gradually covering to the ends; gazing up at clear light—the Northern Dipper hangs high.

sentences.zh: 四解崆峒山色翠如煙，訪道人非遠。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: Kongtong Mountain's color emerald as smoke; visiting the Daoist is not far.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth stanza-break: Kongtong Mountain's color emerald as smoke; visiting the Daoist is not far.

sentences.zh: 姑射有神仙，飲風吸露，綽約嬋娟。

translations.literal: At Guye there are immortals; drinking wind, inhaling dew; graceful and lovely.
translations.idiomatic: At Guye there are immortals; drinking wind, inhaling dew; graceful and lovely.

sentences.zh: 乘雲氣，御青天。

translations.literal: Riding cloud and mist; controlling azure heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Riding cloud and mist; controlling azure heaven.

sentences.zh: 有虞氏，親巡遍。

translations.literal: Lord Yu's house personally toured everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: Lord Yu's house personally toured everywhere.

sentences.zh: 五解薰風拂五弦，養恬樂利，到處桑麻雞犬。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza-break: balmy wind brushes five strings; nurturing peace, joy, and profit; everywhere mulberry, hemp, chickens, and dogs.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth stanza-break: balmy wind brushes five strings; nurturing peace, joy, and profit; everywhere mulberry, hemp, chickens, and dogs.

sentences.zh: 含哺鼓腹，風光堪羨。

translations.literal: Mouths full, bellies drumming; scenery worthy of envy.
translations.idiomatic: Mouths full, bellies drumming; scenery worthy of envy.

sentences.zh: 吉蠲，採風問俗排法駕，清蹕稅桑田。

translations.literal: Auspicious purification; gathering folk songs, inquiring customs, arranging imperial carriage; clearing the path, resting at mulberry fields.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious purification; gathering folk songs, inquiring customs, arranging imperial carriage; clearing the path, resting at mulberry fields.

sentences.zh: 六解遊河五老蹁躚，紫極光連，袖裡圖書一卷，齊向丹陵獻。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: touring the river, five elders dance lightly; purple pole light connected; one scroll of charts and books in sleeves—all present to Red Mound.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth stanza-break: touring the river, five elders dance lightly; purple pole light connected; one scroll of charts and books in sleeves—all present to Red Mound.

sentences.zh: 八駿踏雲煙，飛雷掣電，黃竹詩篇，瑤池清宴。

translations.literal: Eight fine steeds tread cloud and mist; flying thunder, flashing lightning; Yellow Bamboo poems; jade pool clear banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Eight fine steeds tread cloud and mist; flying thunder, flashing lightning; Yellow Bamboo poems; jade pool clear banquet.

sentences.zh: 七解稽古想前賢，端垂玉冕，屬車香里，曉發沖開宿霧天。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: examining antiquity, thinking of former sages; upright with jade crown hanging; attendant carriages in fragrance; dawn departure breaks through lingering mist and sky.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh stanza-break: examining antiquity, thinking of former sages; upright with jade crown hanging; attendant carriages in fragrance; dawn departure breaks through lingering mist and sky.

sentences.zh: 霓旌卷，蘭生殿，佳氣滿平川。

translations.literal: Rainbow banners roll; Orchid Hall; auspicious air fills the level stream.
translations.idiomatic: Rainbow banners roll; Orchid Hall; auspicious air fills the level stream.

sentences.zh: 八解岱嶽齊天，七十二君曾駐輦。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: Mount Tai level with heaven; seventy-two lords once halted their carriages.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth stanza-break: Mount Tai level with heaven; seventy-two lords once halted their carriages.

sentences.zh: 泰山樑父雲亭，肅然崇封禪。

translations.literal: Mount Tai, Liangfu, Cloud Pavilion—solemnly honoring feng and shan rites.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Tai, Liangfu, Cloud Pavilion—solemnly honoring feng and shan rites.

sentences.zh: 金泥印，綠文玉檢留丹篆。

translations.literal: Gold-clay seal; green-script jade tablet preserves cinnabar seal-script.
translations.idiomatic: Gold-clay seal; green-script jade tablet preserves cinnabar seal-script.

sentences.zh: 九解羽林周衛錦袍鮮，萬騎驂驔隱見。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: palace guard encircles in bright brocade robes; ten thousand riders in matched teams appear and vanish.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth stanza-break: palace guard encircles in bright brocade robes; ten thousand riders in matched teams appear and vanish.

sentences.zh: 黃雲馬足，白日松顛蔥蒨。

translations.literal: Yellow clouds at horses' feet; white sun on pine tops, lush and green.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow clouds at horses' feet; white sun on pine tops, lush and green.

sentences.zh: 貝葉三花，石芝五色，搖漾拂寒煙。

translations.literal: Shell leaves, three flowers; stone fungus, five colors—swaying, brushing cold mist.
translations.idiomatic: Shell leaves, three flowers; stone fungus, five colors—swaying, brushing cold mist.

sentences.zh: 十解虹旃采仗五雲連，柳映旌門，在鎬承周燕。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break: rainbow felt, colored escort, five clouds linked; willows reflect banner gates; at Hao, receiving Zhou's feast.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth stanza-break: rainbow felt, colored escort, five clouds linked; willows reflect banner gates; at Hao, receiving Zhou's feast.

sentences.zh: 鳴鸞幸代，旌蓋橫汾，中流簫鼓振樓船。

translations.literal: Singing phoenix visits Dai; banners and canopies cross the Fen; midstream flutes and drums shake tower ships.
translations.idiomatic: Singing phoenix visits Dai; banners and canopies cross the Fen; midstream flutes and drums shake tower ships.

sentences.zh: 十一解乘乾位，在德之元。

translations.literal: Eleventh stanza-break: occupying the Qian position; at the origin of virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh stanza-break: occupying the Qian position; at the origin of virtue.

sentences.zh: 八卦陳，九疇衍，皇極居中建。

translations.literal: Eight Trigrams arrayed; Nine Categories extended; the imperial pole dwells at the center and builds.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Trigrams arrayed; Nine Categories extended; the imperial pole dwells at the center and builds.

sentences.zh: 聖帝明王，一游一豫，芳躅古今傳。

translations.literal: Sage emperors and enlightened kings—one tour, one pleasure; fragrant footsteps transmitted through past and present.
translations.idiomatic: Sage emperors and enlightened kings—one tour, one pleasure; fragrant footsteps transmitted through past and present.

sentences.zh: 十二解昇平無事歲三田，臨之王制，考之風雅，冬狩秋獮。

translations.literal: Twelfth stanza-break: ascending peace, nothing to do—three hunts per year; facing the royal regulations; examining the Feng and Ya; winter hunt, autumn battue.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth stanza-break: ascending peace, nothing to do—three hunts per year; facing the royal regulations; examining the Feng and Ya; winter hunt, autumn battue.

sentences.zh: 先期戒事，虞人掌焉。

translations.literal: In advance setting the season's warning; forest officers take charge.
translations.idiomatic: In advance setting the season's warning; forest officers take charge.

sentences.zh: 後道斿，前皮軒，璧貫珠聯。

translations.literal: Rear path with pennants; front with leather-canopied carriage; jades strung, pearls linked.
translations.idiomatic: Rear path with pennants; front with leather-canopied carriage; jades strung, pearls linked.

sentences.zh: 十三解訓典昭然，時巡是五年，雲沙輦路草芊芊。

translations.literal: Thirteenth stanza-break: training canon clear and manifest; timely patrol is every five years; cloud and sand, carriage road, grass lush.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth stanza-break: training canon clear and manifest; timely patrol is every five years; cloud and sand, carriage road, grass lush.

sentences.zh: 德音騰赤縣，驪龍作馬，日月為旂，霜原玉作田。

translations.literal: Virtue's voice rises over the red counties; black dragon as horse; sun and moon as banners; frost plain, jade as fields.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue's voice rises over the red counties; black dragon as horse; sun and moon as banners; frost plain, jade as fields.

sentences.zh: 盤營風輭，鐃歌一闋，霓詠大羅仙。

translations.literal: Encamping, wind soft; one iron-gong song stanza; rainbow chant of Great Canopy immortals.
translations.idiomatic: Encamping, wind soft; one iron-gong song stanza; rainbow chant of Great Canopy immortals.

sentences.zh: 十四解

translations.literal: Fourteenth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth stanza-break.

sentences.zh: 蹀躞游龍第二十四蹀躞游龍，亭童羽葆，蒞止青野翠郊。

translations.literal: Pacing Roaming Dragon, twenty-fourth: pacing roaming dragon—pavilion youths with feathered canopies; arriving and halting at green fields and emerald suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Pacing Roaming Dragon, No. 24: pacing roaming dragon—pavilion youths with feathered canopies; arriving and halting at green fields and emerald suburbs.

sentences.zh: 看蕩漾，硃旗金瑵，五色瑞雲飄。

translations.literal: Behold swaying; vermilion banners with gold ornaments; five-colored auspicious clouds drift.
translations.idiomatic: Behold swaying; vermilion banners with gold ornaments; five-colored auspicious clouds drift.

sentences.zh: 選吉日，正麗景含韶。

translations.literal: Selecting an auspicious day; just as beautiful scenery holds Shao music.
translations.idiomatic: Selecting an auspicious day; just as beautiful scenery holds Shao music.

sentences.zh: 好青春，是朝廷有道。

translations.literal: Fine springtime—it is that the court has the Way.
translations.idiomatic: Fine springtime—it is that the court has the Way.

sentences.zh: 好青春，是朝廷有道，飈輪電燭映星旄。

translations.literal: Fine springtime—it is that the court has the Way; whirlwind wheels and lightning candles reflect star banners.
translations.idiomatic: Fine springtime—it is that the court has the Way; whirlwind wheels and lightning candles reflect star banners.

sentences.zh: 洽宸襟，詩歌蓼蕭，雲標寶翰摛天藻，皇衢慶靄籠霄。

translations.literal: Harmonizing the imperial breast; poems singing of Polygonum and Artemisia; cloud-marked precious brush unfolds heaven's literary grace; imperial thoroughfare, celebratory mist enfolds the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Harmonizing the imperial breast; poems singing of Polygonum and Artemisia; cloud-marked precious brush unfolds heaven's literary grace; imperial thoroughfare, celebratory mist enfolds the sky.

sentences.zh: 一解恩威闓澤敷八表，百昌萬類，咸荷鈞陶。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: grace and might broadly spread to the eight directions; a hundred prosperities, ten thousand kinds—all bear the potter's shaping.
translations.idiomatic: First stanza-break: grace and might broadly spread to the eight directions; a hundred prosperities, ten thousand kinds—all bear the potter's shaping.

sentences.zh: 西被東漸，聲靈遠耀，用觀民而設教。

translations.literal: Covering west, gradually reaching east; voice and spirit shine far; thereby observing the people and establishing instruction.
translations.idiomatic: Covering west, gradually reaching east; voice and spirit shine far; thereby observing the people and establishing instruction.

sentences.zh: 元良頌，凡有血氣者，罔不孚，尊親戴，甘露降，榮光繞。

translations.literal: Heir-apparent's praise—all who have blood and breath, none not trusting; honoring and supporting; sweet dew descends; glory's light encircles.
translations.idiomatic: Heir-apparent's praise—all who have blood and breath, all trust; honoring and supporting; sweet dew descends; glory's light encircles.

sentences.zh: 五雲中，盡瞻天認赭袍。

translations.literal: Amid five clouds, all gaze heavenward and recognize the ochre robe.
translations.idiomatic: Amid five clouds, all gaze heavenward and recognize the ochre robe.

sentences.zh: 二解長路波回兮峰繞，航海梯山匭包茅。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: long road, waves turn—peaks encircle; sailing seas, climbing mountains, chests of thatch.
translations.idiomatic: Second stanza-break: long road, waves turn—peaks encircle; sailing seas, climbing mountains, chests of thatch.

sentences.zh: 烏弋黃支，絕域齊來到。

translations.literal: Wuyi and Huangzhi; remote regions all come together.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyi and Huangzhi; remote regions all come together.

sentences.zh: 荷天恩，涵大造。

translations.literal: Bearing heaven's grace; containing great creation.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing heaven's grace; containing great creation.

sentences.zh: 婆娑起舞，歡欣醉飽。

translations.literal: Dancing gracefully; joyful, drunk, and full.
translations.idiomatic: Dancing gracefully; joyful, drunk, and full.

sentences.zh: 舌人重譯，感天怙冒。

translations.literal: Tongue-men double-translate; feeling heaven's covering and shelter.
translations.idiomatic: Tongue-men double-translate; feeling heaven's covering and shelter.

sentences.zh: 一游一豫民歡樂，招音作，徵與角，君臣賡歌仰熙朝。

translations.literal: One tour, one pleasure—the people rejoice; Zhao mode begins; Zhi and Jue; ruler and ministers continue songs, looking up to the flourishing dynasty.
translations.idiomatic: One tour, one pleasure—the people rejoice; Zhao mode begins; Zhi and Jue; ruler and ministers continue songs, looking up to the flourishing dynasty.

sentences.zh: 三解騎竹童，扶鳩老。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: children riding bamboo horses; elders leaning on dove staffs.
translations.idiomatic: Third stanza-break: children riding bamboo horses; elders leaning on dove staffs.

sentences.zh: 萬年清晏★E6恩膏，回輦深恩承細草。

translations.literal: Ten thousand years clear and peaceful, grace and bounty; returning carriage, deep grace receives fine grass.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand years clear and peaceful, grace and bounty; returning carriage, deep grace receives fine grass.

sentences.zh: 四解

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth stanza-break.

sentences.zh: 慶皇圖第二十五慶皇圖，肇域燕都。

translations.literal: Celebrating the Imperial Chart, twenty-fifth: celebrating the imperial chart—founding the realm at Yan capital.
translations.idiomatic: Celebrating the Imperial Chart, No. 25: celebrating the imperial chart—founding the realm at Yan capital.

sentences.zh: 重熙累洽，聖化覃敷。

translations.literal: Repeated brilliance, accumulated harmony; sage transformation spread abroad.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated brilliance, accumulated harmony; sage transformation spread abroad.

sentences.zh: 玉燭調，金甌固，巡方兮，繼跡有虞。

translations.literal: Jade candle tuned; golden vessel firm; touring the regions—following the footsteps of Lord Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Jade candle tuned; golden vessel firm; touring the regions—following the footsteps of Lord Yu.

sentences.zh: 一解聖人之生，首出庶物。

translations.literal: First stanza-break: when the sage is born, he first emerges among the multitude of things.
translations.idiomatic: First stanza-break: when the sage is born, he first emerges among the multitude of things.

sentences.zh: 握乾符，膺寶籙。

translations.literal: Grasping the Qian talisman; receiving the precious register.
translations.idiomatic: Grasping the Qian talisman; receiving the precious register.

sentences.zh: 載歌天保，何福不除。

translations.literal: Singing the Tian Bao; what blessing is not removed?
translations.idiomatic: Singing the Tian Bao; what blessing is not removed?

sentences.zh: 升恆兮，日月居諸。

translations.literal: Ascending Mount Heng; sun and moon dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending Mount Heng; sun and moon dwell there.

sentences.zh: 二解宏九有，入三無。

translations.literal: Second stanza-break: vast within the nine domains; entering the three withouts.
translations.idiomatic: Second stanza-break: vast within the nine domains; entering the three withouts.

sentences.zh: 惠烝民，膏澤涵濡。

translations.literal: Benefiting the common people; grace and bounty moistening all.
translations.idiomatic: Benefiting the common people; grace and bounty moistening all.

sentences.zh: 遷善不知，衢歌巷舞。

translations.literal: Moving toward goodness without knowing it; thoroughfare songs, lane dances.
translations.idiomatic: Moving toward goodness without knowing it; thoroughfare songs, lane dances.

sentences.zh: 嘉祥兮，磅薄扶輿。

translations.literal: Auspicious signs—vast and abundant, supporting the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious signs—vast and abundant, supporting the carriage.

sentences.zh: 三解惟天之瑞，慶雲甘露。

translations.literal: Third stanza-break: heaven's auspicious signs—celebratory clouds, sweet dew.
translations.idiomatic: Third stanza-break: heaven's auspicious signs—celebratory clouds, sweet dew.

sentences.zh: 日有重光，星有連珠。

translations.literal: Sun has double light; stars have linked pearls.
translations.idiomatic: Sun has double light; stars have linked pearls.

sentences.zh: 惟地之瑞，澤馬山車。

translations.literal: Earth's auspicious signs—marsh horses, mountain carts.
translations.idiomatic: Earth's auspicious signs—marsh horses, mountain carts.

sentences.zh: 醴泉兮，噴若醍醐。

translations.literal: Sweet springs—gushing like ghee.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet springs—gushing like ghee.

sentences.zh: 四解惟草與芝，或紫或硃。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza-break: only grasses and fungus—some purple, some vermilion.

translations.idiomatic: How august—unified carts and writing.

translations.idiomatic: Divining years—blessings without bounds.

translations.idiomatic: Flashing dragon banners; surging and rising.

translations.idiomatic: Ninth stanza-break.

translations.idiomatic: Martial glory, civil plans—goodness thus bequeathed.

translations.idiomatic: Spreading heaven's gathering response; fully nothing not fitting.

translations.idiomatic: First stanza-break: reverently like unto Heaven; spreading the seasons, continuing thought.

translations.literal: Seeking the people's tranquility; early and late consulting.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking the people's tranquility; early and late consulting.

translations.idiomatic: Already rich and abundant; guiding them to hold constant norms.

translations.idiomatic: Sacred reverence daily ascends; imperial command deployed in nine encirclements.

translations.idiomatic: Second stanza-break: manifest fine virtue; restrained fine bearing.

translations.idiomatic: Ordering the four directions; immersed in sage's shore.

translations.idiomatic: Following former models; grace and bounty diligently bestowed.

translations.idiomatic: What the people rest upon—like taking, like leading.

translations.idiomatic: Like xun and chi; guiding instruction without deviation.

translations.idiomatic: The emperor sage and divine; heaven bestows heroic bearing.

translations.idiomatic: Hearing clear, seeing bright; law and pattern, innate knowledge.

translations.literal: All-embracing nurture; loosening the indignant string, playing it.
translations.idiomatic: All-embracing nurture; loosening the indignant string, playing it.

sentences.zh: 仁滂施厚，元氣淋漓。

translations.literal: Benevolence poured abundantly; primal energy dripping fully.
translations.idiomatic: Benevolence poured abundantly; primal energy dripping fully.

translations.idiomatic: A thousand autumns, ten thousand years—again beholding Si and Ji.

translations.idiomatic: Third stanza-break: common people bright and clear; five canonical relationships carefully marked.

translations.idiomatic: Washing and selecting, potter's shaping; penetrating bone, soaking flesh.

translations.literal: Like those fields—already cleared and planted.
translations.idiomatic: Like those fields—already cleared and planted.

translations.literal: Like those houses—already plastered and thatched.
translations.idiomatic: Like those houses—already plastered and thatched.

sentences.zh: 皇心統天，品物咸資。

translations.literal: Imperial heart governs heaven; all things equally sustained.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial heart governs heaven; all things equally sustained.

sentences.zh: 維嘉維時，樂矣魚麗。

translations.idiomatic: Both auspicious, both timely—joyful is the Fish-Scale formation.

translations.idiomatic: Fourth stanza-break: soaring wild geese—gradually reaching the great road.

translations.idiomatic: Bright white egrets—gathering at the water's edge.

translations.idiomatic: Abundant, the king has many worthy men; red knee-guards numerous.

sentences.zh: 束修其躬，慎乃樞機。

translations.literal: Binding and cultivating the self; careful with pivotal mechanisms.
translations.idiomatic: Binding and cultivating the self; careful with pivotal mechanisms.

translations.literal: Assisting the Son of Heaven—why gather hairpins? Do not doubt.
translations.idiomatic: Assisting the Son of Heaven—why gather hairpins? Do not doubt.

translations.idiomatic: Fifth stanza-break: towering twin gate-towers; tranquil three frontiers.

translations.idiomatic: Rites cultivate, music refine; customs change, wind shifts.

translations.idiomatic: Golden instrument measures signs; jade pitch-pipe fixes time.

translations.idiomatic: Four wilds, eight wastes—truly none far abandoned.

translations.idiomatic: In the shallows, artemisia; in the wet lowlands, mugwort.

translations.idiomatic: Matching seasons, nurturing things; ten thousand states thereby pacified.
