translations.idiomatic: Inspecting regions, establishing instruction—thereby achieving harmonious splendor.

sentences.zh: 無封靡於爾邦，惟日孜孜。

translations.literal: No boundary neglected in your state; only daily diligent.
translations.idiomatic: No boundary neglected in your state; only daily diligent.

sentences.zh: 六解咨我三公，及爾庶司。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza-break: consult our three dukes and all your various officers.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth stanza-break: consult our three dukes and all your various officers.

sentences.zh: 豈敢怠安，無平不陂。

translations.literal: How dare one be slack and at ease? No level without slope.
translations.idiomatic: How dare one be slack and at ease? No level without slope.

sentences.zh: 建國親侯，王者無私。

translations.literal: Establishing the state, favoring feudal lords—the king has no partiality.
translations.idiomatic: Establishing the state, favoring feudal lords—the king has no partiality.

sentences.zh: 卜雲襲吉，昆命元龜。

translations.literal: Divining clouds inherit auspiciousness; commanding the primordial tortoise.
translations.idiomatic: Divining clouds inherit auspiciousness; commanding the primordial tortoise.

sentences.zh: 農事告成，秋以為期。

translations.literal: Farming affairs reported complete; autumn as the deadline.
translations.idiomatic: Farming affairs reported complete; autumn as the deadline.

sentences.zh: 倬彼雲漢，奎畢井觜。

translations.literal: Vast that Milky Way—Kui, Net, Well, Beak.
translations.idiomatic: Vast that Milky Way—Kui, Net, Well, Beak.

sentences.zh: 揆文奮武，營壘車騎。

translations.literal: Measuring civil and martial; building ramparts, chariots and cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Measuring civil and martial; building ramparts, chariots and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 象緯昭回，聖人法之。

translations.literal: Signs and girdle-stars bright and turning; the sage takes them as model.
translations.idiomatic: Signs and girdle-stars bright and turning; the sage takes them as model.

sentences.zh: 以補以助，上繼姚媯。

translations.literal: To supplement and assist; above continuing Yao and Gui.
translations.idiomatic: To supplement and assist; above continuing Yao and Gui.

sentences.zh: 億萬斯年，壽考維祺。

translations.literal: Billions of years; long life and blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Billions of years; long life and blessings.

sentences.zh: 整法駕，揚華旗。

translations.literal: Arranging the imperial carriage; raising splendid banners.
translations.idiomatic: Arranging the imperial carriage; raising splendid banners.

sentences.zh: 六軍雷動，萬馬星飛。

translations.literal: Six armies thunder; ten thousand horses star-fly.
translations.idiomatic: Six armies thunder; ten thousand horses star-fly.

sentences.zh: 白山嵃嵃，綠水澌澌。

translations.literal: White mountains lofty; green waters murmuring.
translations.idiomatic: White mountains lofty; green waters murmuring.

sentences.zh: 騶虞至，鳳凰儀。

translations.literal: Zouyu arrives; phoenix bearing proper.
translations.idiomatic: Zouyu arrives; phoenix bearing proper.

sentences.zh: 於疆於理，皇心則怡。

translations.literal: In boundaries and in management—the imperial heart is pleased.
translations.idiomatic: In boundaries and in management—the imperial heart is pleased.

sentences.zh: 七解渺渺川原，坦然逶迤。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza-break: vast rivers and plains; open and winding far.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh stanza-break: vast rivers and plains; open and winding far.

sentences.zh: 遺秉滯穗，如京如坻。

translations.literal: Leftover bundles, lingering ears—like mounds, like dykes.
translations.idiomatic: Leftover bundles, lingering ears—like mounds, like dykes.

sentences.zh: 各峙乃粻，以饗我師。

translations.literal: Each prepares their grain; to feast our army.
translations.idiomatic: Each prepares their grain; to feast our army.

sentences.zh: 鳥獸充牣，碩大蕃茲。

translations.literal: Birds and beasts fill the pens; large and abundant here.
translations.idiomatic: Birds and beasts fill the pens; large and abundant here.

sentences.zh: 莫不振疊，永藉保釐。

translations.literal: None not flourishing layered; forever relying on preservation and blessing.
translations.idiomatic: All flourish in layers; forever relying on preservation and blessing.

sentences.zh: 七騶既馭，萬眾咸隨。

translations.literal: Seven outriders already driving; ten thousand masses all follow.
translations.idiomatic: Seven outriders already driving; ten thousand masses all follow.

sentences.zh: 鍧鍧鼓鐸，幡然旌麾。

translations.literal: Booming drums and bells; fluttering banners and flags.
translations.idiomatic: Booming drums and bells; fluttering banners and flags.

sentences.zh: 逐獸追禽，大戟長鉟。

translations.literal: Pursuing beasts, chasing birds; great halberds, long spears.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing beasts, chasing birds; great halberds, long spears.

sentences.zh: 為鐃為鐲，載常載旂。

translations.literal: As iron-gongs and bells; bearing chang and bearing banners.
translations.idiomatic: As iron-gongs and bells; bearing chang and bearing banners.

sentences.zh: 左律右鉞，平於有司。

translations.literal: Left pitch-pipe, right battle-axe; balanced among the officers.
translations.idiomatic: Left pitch-pipe, right battle-axe; balanced among the officers.

sentences.zh: 瞻彼翠華，硃英蕤蕤。

translations.literal: Gaze at that emerald splendor; vermilion flowers lush.
translations.idiomatic: Gaze at that emerald splendor; vermilion flowers lush.

sentences.zh: 星旗月鈒，錦韉珠戣。

translations.literal: Star banners, moon spears; brocade saddles, pearl whip-tassels.
translations.idiomatic: Star banners, moon spears; brocade saddles, pearl whip-tassels.

sentences.zh: 禮百神，奠四維。

translations.literal: Rites to a hundred spirits; offerings at the four corners.
translations.idiomatic: Rites to a hundred spirits; offerings at the four corners.

sentences.zh: 王用三驅，勿競厥威。

translations.literal: The king uses Three Drives; do not compete in his might.
translations.idiomatic: The king uses Three Drives; do not compete in his might.

sentences.zh: 我求懿德，允王保之。

translations.literal: I seek fine virtue; truly the king preserves it.
translations.idiomatic: I seek fine virtue; truly the king preserves it.

sentences.zh: 八解張皇六師，如虎如羆。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza-break: displaying the six armies; like tigers, like bears.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth stanza-break: displaying the six armies; like tigers, like bears.

sentences.zh: 天休震動，周道驅馳。

translations.literal: Heaven's blessing shakes; Zhou's way drives forward.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's blessing shakes; Zhou's way drives forward.

sentences.zh: 策勛在廟，莫不寅威。

translations.literal: Recording merit in the temple; none not reverently awed.
translations.idiomatic: Recording merit in the temple; all are reverently awed.

sentences.zh: 戢干韜矢，說禮敦詩，天子是毗。

translations.literal: Sheathing shields, stowing arrows; delighting in rites, honoring poetry—the Son of Heaven is their support.
translations.idiomatic: Sheathing shields, stowing arrows; delighting in rites, honoring poetry—the Son of Heaven is their support.

sentences.zh: 九解灼灼芙蓉花，毿毿楊柳枝。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza-break: blazing hibiscus flowers; shaggy willow branches.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth stanza-break: blazing hibiscus flowers; shaggy willow branches.

sentences.zh: 旃旐婀娜，畫龍與螭。

translations.literal: Felt pennants graceful; painted dragons and hornless dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Felt pennants graceful; painted dragons and hornless dragons.

sentences.zh: 干盾騰拏，逐豹與麋。

translations.literal: Shields and bucklers leaping; pursuing leopards and elk.
translations.idiomatic: Shields and bucklers leaping; pursuing leopards and elk.

sentences.zh: 湛湛甘露，酌以玉卮。

translations.literal: Abundant sweet dew; poured in jade goblets.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant sweet dew; poured in jade goblets.

sentences.zh: 陛下千萬歲，撫御萬國歸銜羈。

translations.literal: Your Majesty ten thousand years; governing ten thousand states, all return bridled.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty ten thousand years; governing ten thousand states, all return bridled.

sentences.zh: 十解王會有圖，天葩芬奇，爻閭赤帟，元繚碧基。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza-break: royal assembly has its chart; heaven's flowers rare and fine; red curtains at Yao village; azure base with green foundation.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth stanza-break: royal assembly has its chart; heaven's flowers rare and fine; red curtains at Yao village; azure base with green foundation.

sentences.zh: 文蜃大蟹，孔鳥皋雞。

translations.literal: Patterned clams, great crabs; crested birds, marsh cocks.
translations.idiomatic: Patterned clams, great crabs; crested birds, marsh cocks.

sentences.zh: 隃冠尊耳，露犬星施。

translations.literal: Feathered caps, honored ears; dew dogs, star banners.
translations.idiomatic: Feathered caps, honored ears; dew dogs, star banners.

sentences.zh: 白鹿黃騏，獻其貔皮。

translations.literal: White deer, yellow qí; presenting their bear skins.
translations.idiomatic: White deer, yellow qí; presenting their bear skins.

sentences.zh: 在彼澤宮，璧水瀰瀰。

translations.literal: At that marsh palace; jade-ringed water overflowing.
translations.idiomatic: At that marsh palace; jade-ringed water overflowing.

sentences.zh: 樹爾侯矣，射熊與貍。

translations.literal: Setting up the targets; shooting bears and wildcats.
translations.idiomatic: Setting up the targets; shooting bears and wildcats.

sentences.zh: 槐宸高聳，棘路明熹。

translations.literal: Pagoda tree hall towering high; thorny path bright and warm.
translations.idiomatic: Pagoda tree hall towering high; thorny path bright and warm.

sentences.zh: 鳴葭駐罕，麗日和颸。

translations.literal: Reed pipes sound, imperial banner halts; beautiful sun and gentle breeze.
translations.idiomatic: Reed pipes sound, imperial banner halts; beautiful sun and gentle breeze.

sentences.zh: 四牡騤々，以車伾々，飲至言歸。

translations.literal: Four stallions strong; with carriages numerous; drinking to the end, saying return.
translations.idiomatic: Four stallions strong; with carriages numerous; drinking to the end, saying return.

sentences.zh: 十一解驂四鸞，駕六螭。

translations.literal: Eleventh stanza-break: four matched phoenix teams; driving six hornless dragons.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh stanza-break: four matched phoenix teams; driving six hornless dragons.

sentences.zh: 彤雲分五老，珠露浥三峗。

translations.literal: Crimson clouds divide the Five Elders; pearl dew moistens three peaks.
translations.idiomatic: Crimson clouds divide the Five Elders; pearl dew moistens three peaks.

sentences.zh: 訪姑射，拜希夷。

translations.literal: Visiting Guye; bowing to Xiyi.
translations.idiomatic: Visiting Guye; bowing to Xiyi.

sentences.zh: 執衡與規，循理因資。

translations.literal: Holding balance and compass; following principle according to resources.
translations.idiomatic: Holding balance and compass; following principle according to resources.

sentences.zh: 昭假遲遲，恭己無為。

translations.literal: Brightly reaching, slowly; reverently self-contained, non-active.
translations.idiomatic: Brightly reaching, slowly; reverently self-contained, non-active.

sentences.zh: 十二解誕敷文德，懷柔神祇。

translations.literal: Twelfth stanza-break: broadly spreading civil virtue; cherishing and gentling spirits and gods.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth stanza-break: broadly spreading civil virtue; cherishing and gentling spirits and gods.

sentences.zh: 天命靡諶，念茲在茲。

translations.literal: Heaven's mandate is not constant; think of this, dwell on this.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's mandate is not constant; think of this, dwell on this.

sentences.zh: 周原稼穡，小民之依。

translations.literal: Zhou's plain, farming and harvest—the common people's reliance.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou's plain, farming and harvest—the common people's reliance.

sentences.zh: 蠲租賜復，王言如絲。

translations.literal: Remitting rent, granting relief; the king's words like silk threads.
translations.idiomatic: Remitting rent, granting relief; the king's words like silk threads.

sentences.zh: 裁成輔相，於鑠純禧。

translations.literal: Completing and assisting; brilliant pure blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Completing and assisting; brilliant pure blessings.

sentences.zh: 首山之陽，毋采爾薇。

translations.literal: On Shou Mountain's sunny slope—do not gather your ferns.
translations.idiomatic: On Shou Mountain's sunny slope—do not gather your ferns.

sentences.zh: 商山之顏，毋采爾芝。

translations.literal: On Shang Mountain's face—do not gather your fungus.
translations.idiomatic: On Shang Mountain's face—do not gather your fungus.

sentences.zh: 三老五更，惠和宣慈。

translations.literal: Three elders, five geng—grace and harmony proclaiming kindness.
translations.idiomatic: Three elders, five geng—grace and harmony proclaiming kindness.

sentences.zh: 有馮有翼，爾性爾彌。

translations.literal: With support, with wings—your nature, your fullness.
translations.idiomatic: With support, with wings—your nature, your fullness.

sentences.zh: 袒而割牲，謙謙是撝。

translations.literal: Bare-shouldered cutting the sacrifice; humble and humble thus acting.
translations.idiomatic: Bare-shouldered cutting the sacrifice; humble and humble thus acting.

sentences.zh: 示我周行，瑟鼓笙吹。

translations.literal: Show us Zhou's conduct; zithers, drums, pipes, and flutes.
translations.idiomatic: Show us Zhou's conduct; zithers, drums, pipes, and flutes.

sentences.zh: 十三解矗矗恆山，幽冀之治。

translations.literal: Thirteenth stanza-break: towering Mount Heng; You and Ji's governance.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth stanza-break: towering Mount Heng; You and Ji's governance.

sentences.zh: 絳雲紫霞，岐岐嶷嶷。

translations.literal: Crimson clouds, purple haze; branching high, lofty and steep.
translations.idiomatic: Crimson clouds, purple haze; branching high, lofty and steep.

sentences.zh: 青書綠笈，神所護持。

translations.literal: Green books, green cases—protected by the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Green books, green cases—protected by the spirits.

sentences.zh: 包王孕帝，駕軒鑠羲。

translations.literal: Wrapping kings, gestating emperors; driving the carriage, shining like Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Wrapping kings, gestating emperors; driving the carriage, shining like Xi.

sentences.zh: 元泉神草，瑞勒豐碑。

translations.literal: Primordial springs, divine herbs; auspicious bridle, abundant stele.
translations.idiomatic: Primordial springs, divine herbs; auspicious bridle, abundant stele.

sentences.zh: 爰命太常，爰詔後夔。

translations.literal: Thus ordering the Grand Music Master; thus summoning Hou Kui.
translations.idiomatic: Thus ordering the Grand Music Master; thus summoning Hou Kui.

sentences.zh: 式祀上帝，饗以騂犧。

translations.literal: Performing rites to Supreme God; feasting with red sacrificial ox.
translations.idiomatic: Performing rites to Supreme God; feasting with red sacrificial ox.

sentences.zh: 獻琮璧，奏咸池。

translations.literal: Presenting cong and bi; performing the Xianchi music.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting cong and bi; performing the Xianchi music.

sentences.zh: 奎聯璧合，星斗陸離。

translations.literal: Kui linked, bi joined; stars and constellations scattered bright.
translations.idiomatic: Kui linked, bi joined; stars and constellations scattered bright.

sentences.zh: 洞簫玉琯，鳳羽麟差。

translations.literal: Hollow flutes, jade pipes; phoenix feathers, unicorn horns arrayed.
translations.idiomatic: Hollow flutes, jade pipes; phoenix feathers, unicorn horns arrayed.

sentences.zh: 十四解中澤有葵，南山有桋。

translations.literal: Fourteenth stanza-break: in the central marsh there is mallow; on Southern Mountain there is elm.
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth stanza-break: in the central marsh there is mallow; on Southern Mountain there is elm.

sentences.zh: 豈弟君子，佩玉履綦。

translations.literal: Easy and gracious noble—jade pendants, shoes with patterned soles.
translations.idiomatic: Easy and gracious noble—jade pendants, shoes with patterned soles.

sentences.zh: 遭逢明盛，文煥功巍。

translations.literal: Encountering bright flourishing; culture brilliant, merit lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Encountering bright flourishing; culture brilliant, merit lofty.

sentences.zh: 三墳五典，煌煌麗辭。

translations.literal: Three tomes, five canons—blazing splendid prose.
translations.idiomatic: Three tomes, five canons—blazing splendid prose.

sentences.zh: 原續雅頌，永鎮厜。

translations.literal: Originally continuing the Ya and Song; forever securing the heights.
translations.idiomatic: Originally continuing the Ya and Song; forever securing the heights.

sentences.zh: 十五解

translations.literal: Fifteenth stanza-break.
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth stanza-break.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十五年，平定西陲，凱歌四十章

translations.literal: Qianlong year twenty-five, pacifying the western frontier—forty victory-song sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong, the western frontier was pacified—forty victory-song sections.

sentences.zh: 睿謨獨運武功成，天柱西頭奏永清。

translations.literal: Sagely plans alone deployed—martial achievement completed; at heaven's pillar's western head, eternal peace is proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Sagely plans alone deployed—martial achievement completed; at heaven's pillar's western head, eternal peace is proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 候月占風傳自昔，試聽今日凱歌聲。

translations.literal: Observing the moon, divining the wind—transmitted since old; try listening to today's victory-song sound.
translations.idiomatic: Observing the moon, divining the wind—transmitted since old; try listening to today's victory-song sound.

sentences.zh: 其一往歲伊犁振旅回，名王尺組就俘來。

translations.literal: No. 1: In past years the army returned triumphant from Yili; a famous king bound with a foot-length cord came as captive.
translations.idiomatic: No. 1: In past years the army returned triumphant from Yili; a famous king bound with a foot-length cord came as captive.

sentences.zh: 天西月竁咸星拱，戎索遙從昧谷開。

translations.literal: Heaven's west, moon's nest—all stars bow; the martial frontier far opens from Mugu Valley.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's west, moon's nest—all stars bow; the martial frontier far opens from Mugu Valley.

sentences.zh: 其二狼狽相兼弟與昆，虜廷久縶兩花門。

translations.literal: No. 2: Distressed together, younger and elder brothers; long bound at the barbarian court, the two Huamen.
translations.idiomatic: No. 2: Distressed together, younger and elder brothers; long bound at the barbarian court, the two Huamen.

sentences.zh: 九天忽遇王師下，破械先施再造恩。

translations.literal: From nine heavens suddenly the royal army descended; breaking shackles first, bestowing grace of renewal.
translations.idiomatic: From nine heavens suddenly the royal army descended; breaking shackles first, bestowing grace of renewal.

sentences.zh: 其三賜歸舊部寵榮多，俾撫殘戎釋網羅。

translations.literal: No. 3: Granted return to old tribes, favor and glory abundant; made to pacify remnant forces, releasing nets and snares.
translations.idiomatic: No. 3: Granted return to old tribes, favor and glory abundant; made to pacify remnant forces, releasing nets and snares.

sentences.zh: 但使祁連山作礪，不教蒲類海揚波。

translations.literal: Only let Qilian Mountain serve as whetstone; do not allow Pulei Sea to raise waves.
translations.idiomatic: Only let Qilian Mountain serve as whetstone; do not allow Pulei Sea to raise waves.

sentences.zh: 其四何期鷹眼終違化，翻肆鴞音煽逆塵。

translations.literal: No. 4: Who expected hawk eyes would finally defy transformation; instead spreading owl voices, fanning rebel dust.
translations.idiomatic: No. 4: Who expected hawk eyes would finally defy transformation; instead spreading owl voices, fanning rebel dust.

sentences.zh: 朔草並霑天上露，黃沙偏負塞垣春。

translations.literal: Northern grasses all moistened by heaven's dew; yellow sand wrongly betraying frontier spring.
translations.idiomatic: Northern grasses all moistened by heaven's dew; yellow sand wrongly betraying frontier spring.

sentences.zh: 其五恢恢天網本來寬，稔惡誅鋤務欲殫。

translations.literal: No. 5: Vast heaven's net was always wide; long-accrued evil must be uprooted, the task to exterminate complete.
translations.idiomatic: No. 5: Vast heaven's net was always wide; long-accrued evil must be uprooted, the task to exterminate complete.

sentences.zh: 宵旰從容宏廟略，偏師重進取兇殘。

translations.literal: Early and late at ease with grand temple strategy; a detached force again advances to seize the vicious and cruel.
translations.idiomatic: Early and late at ease with grand temple strategy; a detached force again advances to seize the vicious and cruel.

sentences.zh: 其六梯衝烈烈庫車垣，逋寇倉黃竟返奔。

translations.literal: No. 6: Scaling ladders thunder at Kuche's walls; fleeing bandits in panic finally turned and ran.
translations.idiomatic: No. 6: Scaling ladders thunder at Kuche's walls; fleeing bandits in panic finally turned and ran.

sentences.zh: 那識降人爭獻款，亡巢徼幸漏遊魂。

translations.literal: Who knew surrendered men would compete to offer allegiance; from a ruined nest, by luck a wandering soul escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Who knew surrendered men would compete to offer allegiance; from a ruined nest, by luck a wandering soul escaped.

sentences.zh: 其七虎符申命下丹霄，壁壘旌旗煥一朝。

translations.literal: No. 7: Tiger tally commands descend from crimson sky; ramparts and banners blaze anew in one morning.
translations.idiomatic: No. 7: Tiger tally commands descend from crimson sky; ramparts and banners blaze anew in one morning.

sentences.zh: 頓覺三門新氣象，元戎更拜霍嫖姚。

translations.literal: Suddenly sensing new atmosphere at Three Gates; the supreme commander again salutes Huo and Piao Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly sensing new atmosphere at Three Gates; the supreme commander again salutes Huo and Piao Yao.

sentences.zh: 其八一軍早定沙雅爾，百堵旋收阿克蘇。

translations.literal: No. 8: One army early secured Shayar; a hundred walls soon taken at Aksu.
translations.idiomatic: No. 8: One army early secured Shayar; a hundred walls soon taken at Aksu.

sentences.zh: 萬里風馳還電掃，大兵直壓賊城孤。

translations.literal: Ten thousand li wind-gallop and lightning-sweep; great army directly presses the rebel city isolated.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand li wind-gallop and lightning-sweep; great army directly presses the rebel city isolated.

sentences.zh: 其九蟻結蜂屯三閱月，熊蹲虎踞一當千。

translations.literal: No. 9: Ants massed, bees gathered—for three months; bears crouching, tigers perched—one against a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: No. 9: Ants massed, bees gathered—for three months; bears crouching, tigers perched—one against a thousand.

sentences.zh: 如山軍勢原難撼，醜類空教倒戟旋。

translations.literal: Mountain-like army strength originally hard to shake; ugly rabble vainly made to reverse spears and turn.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain-like army strength originally hard to shake; ugly rabble vainly made to reverse spears and turn.

sentences.zh: 其十櫜囊不待裹糧行，早喜因糧在敵城。

translations.literal: No. 10: Quiver and bag—no need to carry grain when marching; early joy at living off enemy grain in the rebel city.
translations.idiomatic: No. 10: Quiver and bag—no need to carry grain when marching; early joy at living off enemy grain in the rebel city.

sentences.zh: 奇應何須驚雨粟，地留火米待神兵。

translations.literal: Strange response—why be startled at rain of grain? The ground left fire-rice awaiting divine troops.
translations.idiomatic: Strange response—why be startled at rain of grain? The ground left fire-rice awaiting divine troops.

sentences.zh: 其十一天漿那挹斗杓盈，陸海茫茫疏勒城。

translations.literal: No. 11: Heavenly nectar—how to draw when the Dipper brims? Land and sea vast and boundless at Shule city.
translations.idiomatic: No. 11: Heavenly nectar—how to draw when the Dipper brims? Land and sea vast and boundless at Shule city.

sentences.zh: 忽報靈泉隨井渫，滿營歌舞拜王明。

translations.literal: Suddenly reported: spirit springs follow as wells are dredged; whole camp sings and dances, bowing to the king's brightness.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly reported: spirit springs follow as wells are dredged; whole camp sings and dances, bowing to the king's brightness.

sentences.zh: 其十二鼯鼠從知技已窮，著林飛砲響隨風。

translations.literal: No. 12: Flying squirrels finally know their tricks are exhausted; setting forest ablaze, flying cannon sound follows wind.
translations.idiomatic: No. 12: Flying squirrels finally know their tricks are exhausted; setting forest ablaze, flying cannon sound follows wind.

sentences.zh: 鉛丸拾得還殲寇，翻為天朝助火攻。

translations.literal: Lead bullets picked up still destroy bandits; turned instead to aid the celestial dynasty's fire attack.
translations.idiomatic: Lead bullets picked up still destroy bandits; turned instead to aid the celestial dynasty's fire attack.

sentences.zh: 其十三天廄飛騰萬騎來，追風已過拂雲堆。

translations.literal: No. 13: Heaven's stables fly—ten thousand riders come; Wind-Chaser already passed Fuyun Mound.
translations.idiomatic: No. 13: Heaven's stables fly—ten thousand riders come; Wind-Chaser already passed Fuyun Mound.

sentences.zh: 更番士卒符神算，恰作奇兵拔壘回。

translations.literal: Rotating soldiers match divine calculation; just made a surprise force, storming ramparts and returning.
translations.idiomatic: Rotating soldiers match divine calculation; just made a surprise force, storming ramparts and returning.

sentences.zh: 其十四六城脣齒扼和闐，一夕降旗因壘傳。

translations.literal: No. 14: Six cities lip-and-teeth choke Hotan; in one night surrender flags passed along the ramparts.
translations.idiomatic: No. 14: Six cities lip-and-teeth choke Hotan; in one night surrender flags passed along the ramparts.

sentences.zh: 五里何妨迷涿野，轉乘霿霧靖狼煙。

translations.literal: Five li—why worry about losing Zhuo field? Turning to ride mist and fog, pacifying beacon fires.
translations.idiomatic: Five li—why worry about losing Zhuo field? Turning to ride mist and fog, pacifying beacon fires.

sentences.zh: 其十五群番秉令盡從風，聯部扶攜厥角同。

translations.literal: No. 15: All tribes holding orders entirely follow the wind; allied tribes supporting one another, horns together.
translations.idiomatic: No. 15: All tribes holding orders entirely follow the wind; allied tribes supporting one another, horns together.

sentences.zh: 重譯獻來回字表，喜為臣僕象胥通。

translations.literal: Double translation presents Uighur-script memorial; joyfully becoming subjects and servants, interpreters connect.
translations.idiomatic: Double translation presents Uighur-script memorial; joyfully becoming subjects and servants, interpreters connect.

sentences.zh: 其十六綉旗乍卷銳師分，戈壁風沙結暮雲。

translations.literal: No. 16: Embroidered banners suddenly rolled, sharp divisions split; Gobi wind and sand gather evening clouds.
translations.idiomatic: No. 16: Embroidered banners suddenly rolled, sharp divisions split; Gobi wind and sand gather evening clouds.

sentences.zh: 半夜賊營齊破膽，驚從天上下將軍。

translations.literal: Midnight—all rebel camps lose courage together; startled as the general descends from heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Midnight—all rebel camps lose courage together; startled as the general descends from heaven.

sentences.zh: 其十七腹背交攻攻並力，爪牙盡挫挫安逃。

translations.literal: No. 17: Belly and back attacked together with combined force; claws and fangs all broken—where can they flee?
translations.idiomatic: No. 17: Belly and back attacked together with combined force; claws and fangs all broken—where can they flee?

sentences.zh: 天風吹盪蚍蜉陣，伏穴潛藏似犴牢。

translations.literal: Heaven's wind blows and scatters the ant army; hiding in dens, lurking like badger traps.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's wind blows and scatters the ant army; hiding in dens, lurking like badger traps.

sentences.zh: 其十八葉爾奇木門洞達，哈什哈爾城崔巍。

translations.literal: No. 18: Yarkand's gate open and clear; Kashgar city towering high.
translations.idiomatic: No. 18: Yarkand's gate open and clear; Kashgar city towering high.

sentences.zh: 此間風景古未識，祗今惟有天兵來。

translations.literal: This scenery never known since antiquity; only now have celestial troops come.
translations.idiomatic: This scenery never known since antiquity; only now have celestial troops come.

sentences.zh: 其十九纏頭夾道拜旌旗，涸澤揚沙久赫曦。

translations.literal: No. 19: Turbans line the road bowing to banners; dried marshes raise sand long blazing under sun.
translations.idiomatic: No. 19: Turbans line the road bowing to banners; dried marshes raise sand long blazing under sun.

sentences.zh: 最是神奇回造化，雨師今亦迓王師。

translations.literal: Most miraculous is turning creation back; the rain master now also welcomes the royal army.
translations.idiomatic: Most miraculous is turning creation back; the rain master now also welcomes the royal army.

sentences.zh: 其二十久傳婦子望雲霓，今聽歡呼應鼓鼙。

translations.literal: No. 20: Long rumored wives and children gazing at rainbow clouds; now hearing cheers answer drums and war drums.
translations.idiomatic: No. 20: Long rumored wives and children gazing at rainbow clouds; now hearing cheers answer drums and war drums.

sentences.zh: 跪奉雕盤爭獻果，葡萄蒟醬比難齊。

translations.literal: Kneeling, offering carved trays, competing to present fruit; grapes and betel sauce hard to match together.
translations.idiomatic: Kneeling, offering carved trays, competing to present fruit; grapes and betel sauce hard to match together.

sentences.zh: 其二十一殊方何幸戴堯天，從此坤城列市(

translations.literal: No. 21: How fortunate are distant regions to bear Yao's heaven—from this Kun city arranges markets (
translations.idiomatic: No. 21: How fortunate are distant regions to bear Yao's heaven—from this Kun city arranges markets (

sentences.zh: 廠墨)。

translations.literal: printers' ink).
translations.idiomatic: printers' ink).

sentences.zh: 薄賦但教供苜蓿，同文先為易金錢。

translations.literal: Light taxes only require alfalfa tribute; unified writing first exchanges for gold coins.
translations.idiomatic: Light taxes only require alfalfa tribute; unified writing first exchanges for gold coins.

sentences.zh: 其二十二勁師分道襲刀環，轉戰經時草木殷。

translations.literal: No. 22: Strong divisions split paths, striking the knife ring; turning battle over time, grass and trees blood-red.
translations.idiomatic: No. 22: Strong divisions split paths, striking the knife ring; turning battle over time, grass and trees blood-red.

sentences.zh: 入夜窮追聲影絕，山頭明月一弓彎。

translations.literal: Entering night, desperate pursuit—sound and shadow gone; mountain peak, bright moon—a bow bent.
translations.idiomatic: Entering night, desperate pursuit—sound and shadow gone; mountain peak, bright moon—a bow bent.

sentences.zh: 其二十三萬眾爭先虜氣銷，呼聲天半落盤雕。

translations.literal: No. 23: Ten thousand masses compete to advance—barbarian spirit melts; cries halfway to heaven drop the circling eagle.
translations.idiomatic: No. 23: Ten thousand masses compete to advance—barbarian spirit melts; cries halfway to heaven drop the circling eagle.

sentences.zh: 至今人過伊西洱，猶覺轟霆撼碧霄。

translations.literal: To this day people passing Yixier still feel thunder shaking azure heaven.
translations.idiomatic: To this day people passing Yixier still feel thunder shaking azure heaven.

sentences.zh: 其二十四舊聞天宇原知向，今讋神鋒不可攖。

translations.literal: No. 24: Old reports said heaven's domains knew their direction; now awed by divine edge, none dare provoke.
translations.idiomatic: No. 24: Old reports said heaven's domains knew their direction; now awed by divine edge, none dare provoke.

sentences.zh: 一一顤䫜盡泥首，夜來刁斗靜無聲。

translations.literal: One by one all heads bowed in mud; tonight watch drums silent without sound.
translations.idiomatic: One by one all heads bowed in mud; tonight watch drums silent without sound.

sentences.zh: 其二十五陣合將軍飛羽箭，戰酣勇士掣琱戈。

translations.literal: No. 25: Array joined, general flies feathered arrows; battle fierce, warriors draw carved halberds.
translations.idiomatic: No. 25: Array joined, general flies feathered arrows; battle fierce, warriors draw carved halberds.

sentences.zh: 降戎奉檄皆鷹犬，兔走山前得脫麼。

translations.literal: Surrendered barbarians receiving orders—all hawks and hounds; rabbit running before the mountain—can it escape?
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered barbarians receiving orders—all hawks and hounds; rabbit running before the mountain—can it escape?

sentences.zh: 其二十六殘生暫保齊那爾，狡窟難尋鶒布孩。

translations.literal: No. 26: Remnant life temporarily preserved at Qinal; crafty den hard to find at Chobuhai.
translations.idiomatic: No. 26: Remnant life temporarily preserved at Qinal; crafty den hard to find at Chobuhai.

sentences.zh: 白鵲旗高函逆首，都丸親奉凱書來。

translations.literal: White magpie banner high, holding rebel heads; Dowa personally presents victory dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: White magpie banner high, holding rebel heads; Dowa personally presents victory dispatch.

sentences.zh: 其二十七蟣肺蜣肱自不支，親離眾叛欲何之。

translations.literal: No. 27: Lungs like lice, arms like dung beetles—cannot support themselves; kin departed, masses rebelled—where to go?
translations.idiomatic: No. 27: Lungs like lice, arms like dung beetles—cannot support themselves; kin departed, masses rebelled—where to go?

sentences.zh: 輕刀砍陣蹂輕騎，又報分張貳負屍。

translations.literal: Light blades cut arrays, trampling light cavalry; again reported split in two, carrying corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Light blades cut arrays, trampling light cavalry; again reported split in two, carrying corpses.

sentences.zh: 其二十八奏捷星馳絕域書，御園雲物小陽初。

translations.literal: No. 28: Victory report star-rushed from remote regions; imperial garden clouds and objects, slight yang beginning.
translations.idiomatic: No. 28: Victory report star-rushed from remote regions; imperial garden clouds and objects, slight yang beginning.

sentences.zh: 葭灰未動春先到，應瑞花爭四照舒。

translations.literal: Reed ash not yet moved—spring already arrives; responding auspicious flowers compete, four radiances spread.
translations.idiomatic: Reed ash not yet moved—spring already arrives; responding auspicious flowers compete, four radiances spread.

sentences.zh: 其二十九送喜璇闈晝正長，共邀慈福樂時康。

translations.literal: No. 29: Delivering joy to the jade palace—daytime just long; together inviting empress dowager's blessing, rejoicing in timely peace.
translations.idiomatic: No. 29: Delivering joy to the jade palace—daytime just long; together inviting empress dowager's blessing, rejoicing in timely peace.

sentences.zh: 武成敬頌無疆壽，錫類同瞻日月光。

translations.literal: Martial achievement complete—respectfully praising boundless longevity; bestowing on kindred, all gaze at sun and moon's light.
translations.idiomatic: Martial achievement complete—respectfully praising boundless longevity; bestowing on kindred, all gaze at sun and moon's light.

sentences.zh: 其三十山川競說方輿記，風土爭傳王會圖。

translations.literal: No. 30: Mountains and rivers compete to tell of territorial records; customs and soil vie to transmit royal assembly charts.
translations.idiomatic: No. 30: Mountains and rivers compete to tell of territorial records; customs and soil vie to transmit royal assembly charts.

sentences.zh: 此日西維逾二萬，崑崙猶自在東隅。

translations.literal: This day western dimension exceeds twenty thousand li; Kunlun still lies at the eastern corner.
translations.idiomatic: This day western dimension exceeds twenty thousand li; Kunlun still lies at the eastern corner.

sentences.zh: 其三十一默伽樂國舊曾誇，豈謂還成井底蛙。

translations.literal: No. 31: Mecca's happy land once was boasted—who expected it would become a well-bottom frog.
translations.idiomatic: No. 31: Mecca's happy land once was boasted—who expected it would become a well-bottom frog.

sentences.zh: 自此天方增喜色，真教土宇屬天家。

translations.literal: From this heaven's quarter adds joyful color; truly teaching that territory belongs to the celestial house.
translations.idiomatic: From this heaven's quarter adds joyful color; truly teaching that territory belongs to the celestial house.

sentences.zh: 其三十二旭日曈曨元象開，八紘七政在璇台。

translations.literal: No. 32: Rising sun dim and bright—primordial signs open; eight directions, seven governors at the jade platform.
translations.idiomatic: No. 32: Rising sun dim and bright—primordial signs open; eight directions, seven governors at the jade platform.

sentences.zh: 嚕斯納默知欽若，同向蓂階奉朔來。

translations.literal: Persia and Arabia know reverent obedience; together toward the mallow steps, presenting the new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Persia and Arabia know reverent obedience; together toward the mallow steps, presenting the new moon.

sentences.zh: 其三十三萬古冰山雪巘閒，盡教職貢附朝班。

translations.literal: No. 33: Since antiquity ice mountains and snowy peaks at leisure—all taught to offer tribute and join court ranks.
translations.idiomatic: No. 33: Since antiquity ice mountains and snowy peaks at leisure—all taught to offer tribute and join court ranks.

sentences.zh: 落梅何處春風笛，一路筠沖接玉關。

translations.literal: Where falling plum and spring wind flute? All the way bamboo carts connect to Jade Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Where falling plum and spring wind flute? All the way bamboo carts connect to Jade Pass.

sentences.zh: 其三十四獻馘膚功紀泮林，天章更勒遠山岑。

translations.literal: No. 34: Presenting ears and flayed-skin merit recorded at Panlin; imperial compositions further carved on distant mountain peaks.
translations.idiomatic: No. 34: Presenting ears and flayed-skin merit recorded at Panlin; imperial compositions further carved on distant mountain peaks.

sentences.zh: 祗看雲漢昭中外，字字唐虞二典心。

translations.literal: Only behold the Milky Way proclaiming within and without; every word the heart of Tang and Yu's two canons.
translations.idiomatic: Only behold the Milky Way proclaiming within and without; every word the heart of Tang and Yu's two canons.

sentences.zh: 其三十五功成始仰廟謨神，測海捫盤見未真。

translations.literal: No. 35: Achievement complete—only then looking up to temple strategy divine; measuring sea, grasping plate—seeing not yet true.
translations.idiomatic: No. 35: Achievement complete—only then looking up to temple strategy divine; measuring sea, grasping plate—seeing not yet true.

sentences.zh: 崇論昭宣聾昧覺，共欽至理析天人。

translations.literal: Lofty discourse proclaimed—deaf and dull awaken; together revering ultimate principle, analyzing heaven and man.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty discourse proclaimed—deaf and dull awaken; together revering ultimate principle, analyzing heaven and man.

sentences.zh: 其三十六泰壇琮璧陳天貺，清廟圭璋告大猷。

translations.literal: No. 36: Grand altar—cong and bi display heaven's gift; Clear Temple—scepters and tablets announce great plan.
translations.idiomatic: No. 36: Grand altar—cong and bi display heaven's gift; Clear Temple—scepters and tablets announce great plan.

sentences.zh: 盛典輝煌群祝嘏，皇心肅穆自凝庥。

translations.literal: Grand ceremony blazing bright—multitudes bless longevity; imperial heart solemn, itself gathering blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Grand ceremony blazing bright—multitudes bless longevity; imperial heart solemn, itself gathering blessings.

sentences.zh: 其三十七日麗風暄敞鳳樓，九霄丹詔瑞雲浮。

translations.literal: No. 37: sun beautiful, wind warm, phoenix tower open; nine heavens crimson edict, auspicious clouds float.
translations.idiomatic: No. 37: sun beautiful, wind warm, phoenix tower open; nine heavens crimson edict, auspicious clouds float.

sentences.zh: 敷天湛露恩施溥，奏凱聲中愷澤流。

translations.literal: Spreading heaven's heavy dew—grace broadly bestowed; amid victory-song sound, joyful bounty flows.
translations.idiomatic: Spreading heaven's heavy dew—grace broadly bestowed; amid victory-song sound, joyful bounty flows.

sentences.zh: 其三十八駿烈都從睿斷成，登三咸五總難名。

translations.literal: No. 38: heroic glory all from sagely decision completed; ascending three, harmonizing five—altogether hard to name.
translations.idiomatic: No. 38: heroic glory all from sagely decision completed; ascending three, harmonizing five—altogether hard to name.

sentences.zh: 祗今尺箠收天外，歲籥才看第五更。

translations.literal: Only now the foot-whip gathers beyond heaven; year tally—just seeing the fifth watch.
translations.idiomatic: Only now the foot-whip gathers beyond heaven; year tally—just seeing the fifth watch.

sentences.zh: 其三十九舞羽櫜弓偃六師，策勛飲至拜丹墀。

translations.literal: No. 39: dancing with feathers, sheathing bows, six armies rest; recording merit, drinking to the end, bowing at crimson steps.
translations.idiomatic: No. 39: dancing with feathers, sheathing bows, six armies rest; recording merit, drinking to the end, bowing at crimson steps.

sentences.zh: 小臣原譜鳴笳曲，珥筆慚無硃鷺詞。

translations.literal: This minor minister originally composed reed-flute songs; brush at ear, ashamed to lack vermilion egret verses.
translations.idiomatic: This minor minister originally composed reed-flute songs; brush at ear, ashamed to lack vermilion egret verses.

sentences.zh: 其四十
乾隆四十一年，平定金川，高宗御制凱歌三十章

translations.literal: Qianlong year forty-one, pacifying Jinchuan—Gaozong personally composed thirty victory-song sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, Jinchuan was pacified—Gaozong personally composed thirty victory-song sections.

sentences.zh: 廿四中秋夜丑時，木蘭營里遞紅旗。

translations.literal: Twenty-fourth Mid-Autumn night, chou hour—in Mulan camp they deliver the red banner.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-fourth Mid-Autumn night, chou hour—in Mulan camp they deliver the red banner.

sentences.zh: 本來不寐問軍報，孰謂今宵宛見之。

translations.literal: Originally sleepless inquiring after military reports; who said tonight I would just see it?
translations.idiomatic: Originally sleepless inquiring after military reports; who said tonight I would just see it?

sentences.zh: 其一七千里外路迢遙，向十餘朝茲八朝。

translations.literal: No. 1: Seven thousand li—the road far and distant; toward ten-plus days, now eight days.
translations.idiomatic: No. 1: Seven thousand li—the road far and distant; toward ten-plus days, now eight days.

sentences.zh: 可識眾心同一志，嘉哉行賞自宜昭。

translations.literal: Can recognize all hearts share one will; excellent—bestowing rewards should naturally be proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Can recognize all hearts share one will; excellent—bestowing rewards should naturally be proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 其二賊巢最是勒烏圍，甲雜小連噶喇依。

translations.literal: No. 2: Rebel nest most of all Le Wuwei; Jiazadusong and Galayi.
translations.idiomatic: No. 2: Rebel nest most of all Le Wuwei; Jiazadusong and Galayi.

sentences.zh: 破竹勢成應不日，速傳捷信原無違。

translations.literal: Bamboo-splitting momentum should succeed within days; swiftly transmitting victory news—originally no delay.
translations.idiomatic: Bamboo-splitting momentum should succeed within days; swiftly transmitting victory news—originally no delay.

sentences.zh: 其三行營半夜那來喧，卻是紅旗到敘門。

translations.literal: No. 3: Mobile camp at midnight—whence the clamor? It is the red banner reaching Xumen.
translations.idiomatic: No. 3: Mobile camp at midnight—whence the clamor? It is the red banner reaching Xumen.

sentences.zh: 五載勤勞同上下，鴻勛集總沐天恩。

translations.literal: Five years' toil shared above and below; great merit gathered—all bathed in heaven's grace.
translations.idiomatic: Five years' toil shared above and below; great merit gathered—all bathed in heaven's grace.

sentences.zh: 其四紅鐙一點引紅旗，頃刻行營人盡知。

translations.literal: No. 4: One red lamp point leads the red banner; in an instant the whole camp knows.
translations.idiomatic: No. 4: One red lamp point leads the red banner; in an instant the whole camp knows.

sentences.zh: 舊部新籓同賀喜，古來報捷可如斯。

translations.literal: Old tribes, new domains together rejoice; since antiquity victory reports could be like this.
translations.idiomatic: Old tribes, new domains together rejoice; since antiquity victory reports could be like this.

sentences.zh: 其五成言原有付兒行，一見紅旗即奏將。

translations.literal: No. 5: As agreed, originally entrusted to the prince's journey; seeing the red banner, immediately report to the general.
translations.idiomatic: No. 5: As agreed, originally entrusted to the prince's journey; seeing the red banner, immediately report to the general.

sentences.zh: 雖是慈心早知喜，更馳侍衛報山莊。

translations.literal: Though the empress dowager's heart already knew joy; further dispatching guards to report to the mountain villa.
translations.idiomatic: Though the empress dowager's heart already knew joy; further dispatching guards to report to the mountain villa.

sentences.zh: 其六一破賊巢飛騎馳，未遑詳細盡陳之。

translations.literal: No. 6: One—breaking rebel nest, flying riders gallop; no leisure to detail and fully report.
translations.idiomatic: No. 6: One—breaking rebel nest, flying riders gallop; no leisure to detail and fully report.

sentences.zh: 將軍宣力應優賜，先示端倪加勉宜。

translations.literal: General displaying effort should receive superior reward; first showing the beginning, adding encouragement appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: General displaying effort should receive superior reward; first showing the beginning, adding encouragement appropriate.

sentences.zh: 其七前次受降惟戢斧，今番報捷乃犁庭。

translations.literal: No. 7: Last time accepting surrender only sheathed the axe; this round's victory report is plowing the court.
translations.idiomatic: No. 7: Last time accepting surrender only sheathed the axe; this round's victory report is plowing the court.

sentences.zh: 敬承天眷能無慰，未至武成心未寧。

translations.literal: Reverently receiving heaven's favor—how not be comforted? Not yet martial achievement complete—the heart not yet at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently receiving heaven's favor—how not be comforted? Not yet martial achievement complete—the heart not yet at peace.

sentences.zh: 其八宵衣惟吾理合然，喜而不寐那能眠。

translations.literal: No. 8: Early-rising robes—only my principle fits thus; joyful yet sleepless—how can one sleep?
translations.idiomatic: No. 8: Early-rising robes—only my principle fits thus; joyful yet sleepless—how can one sleep?

sentences.zh: 乃知屐齒事誠有，較彼殊猶高下懸。

translations.literal: Thus know the matter of sandal teeth truly exists; compared to that other, still high and low suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Thus know the matter of sandal teeth truly exists; compared to that other, still high and low suspended.

sentences.zh: 其九三捷盼來一月間，此時軍務正相關。

translations.literal: No. 9: Three victories hoped within one month; at this time military affairs closely related.
translations.idiomatic: No. 9: Three victories hoped within one month; at this time military affairs closely related.

sentences.zh: 執渠掃穴歌耆定，佇待郊台奏凱還。

translations.literal: Seizing the ringleader, sweeping dens—singing settled peace; waiting for suburban platform victory song and return.
translations.idiomatic: Seizing the ringleader, sweeping dens—singing settled peace; waiting for suburban platform victory song and return.

sentences.zh: 其十甲午桃花寺蹕停，軍書正此俯窗櫺。

translations.literal: No. 10: Jiawu year at Taohua Temple halt; military dispatches just here, looking down from window lattice.
translations.idiomatic: No. 10: Jiawu year at Taohua Temple halt; military dispatches just here, looking down from window lattice.

sentences.zh: 幸哉今日仍憑處，綠柳中飛一點星。

translations.literal: Fortunate—today still at that leaning place; among green willows flies one point of star.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunate—today still at that leaning place; among green willows flies one point of star.

translations.literal: No. 11: Le Wei victory report—night mobile camp; again meeting tomb ascent, daytime return journey.
translations.idiomatic: No. 11: Le Wei victory report—night mobile camp; again meeting tomb ascent, daytime return journey.

translations.literal: One moment—ten thousand people together joyful; bright sun and moon forever melt arms.
translations.idiomatic: One moment—ten thousand people together joyful; bright sun and moon forever melt arms.

translations.idiomatic: No. 12: Three dens still extended over one month; six armies brave—how spare them?

translations.idiomatic: All around where fire weapons fiercely attack; early rotted the petty fish at the cauldron bottom.

translations.idiomatic: No. 13: Ten-plus days via plank road post—eight mornings arrive; one sheet of red banner, ten thousand horses fly.

translations.idiomatic: Flanking the road, tribes rejoice yet fear—the state's celebration, the state's might.

sentences.zh: 其十四險惡山川靖梟獍，邪深機阱絕根株。

translations.idiomatic: No. 14: Treacherous mountains and rivers pacified—owl-vultures; evil deep, traps and snares—roots severed.

translations.idiomatic: No. 15: Silkworm Cluster's absolute peril hid demonic miasma; hundred battles' achievement—since antiquity unheard.

translations.idiomatic: No. 16: Solid blockhouses stand like forests in ten thousand-fold mountains; breaking peril, charging forward—all hardship endured.

translations.idiomatic: Reporting merit all relies on generals' strength; one red banner enters Taoguan.

sentences.zh: 其十七姜維征處號維州，艷羨戎人謠語留。

translations.literal: No. 17: Where Jiang Wei campaigned was called Weizhou; admired by Rong people's ballad words preserved.
translations.idiomatic: No. 17: Where Jiang Wei campaigned was called Weizhou; admired by Rong people's ballad words preserved.

translations.literal: Today Le Wei is inner territory; Wuyou city truly is without worry.
translations.idiomatic: Today Le Wei is inner territory; Wuyou city truly is without worry.

translations.idiomatic: No. 18: Awaiting victory through winter into spring again; near completion especially feeling concern frequent.

translations.literal: Tonight presumably finally resting on pillow; clearly told—be cautious, users of arms.
translations.idiomatic: Tonight presumably finally resting on pillow; clearly told—be cautious, users of arms.

translations.idiomatic: No. 19: Dispersed this day—den nest toppled; settled peace from this can cease arms.

sentences.zh: 歌凱莫教容易聽，五年功幸一朝成。

translations.literal: Victory song—do not let it be easily heard; five years' merit fortunately completed in one morning.
translations.idiomatic: Victory song—do not let it be easily heard; five years' merit fortunately completed in one morning.

translations.literal: No. 20: Suburban platform still this suburban platform; how fortunate to rebuild the grand event come.
translations.idiomatic: No. 20: Suburban platform still this suburban platform; how fortunate to rebuild the grand event come.

translations.idiomatic: Vainly saying several years passed in separation; spirit's attention like the sun accompanying.

translations.idiomatic: No. 21: Meritorious ministers lead bowing, arraying spirit banners; soldiers sound conchs, martial ceremony blazing.

translations.idiomatic: Music performs iron-gong song, holding and presenting; military inquiry family law—for ten thousand years hangs.

translations.idiomatic: Releasing oxen, returning horses—my lifelong wish; victory presentation—who expected to see both here?

translations.idiomatic: No. 23: Dzungar tribes returned, city settled five years; Jinchuan petty bandits also as before.

translations.idiomatic: Praising my generals and soldiers long sharing enemy rage; unawares toward them increased compassion.

translations.idiomatic: No. 24: Terrain perilous plus masses' will firm; forest blockhouses step by step fighting forward.

translations.idiomatic: Lesser than past affairs—hardship more than doubled; comforting thought always because heart troubled.

translations.idiomatic: No. 25: Carving caves to dwell, avoiding fire weapons; finally bound face-forward, exiting the frontier city.

translations.idiomatic: Clinging to life—ants are always thus; gathering clan to burn—words how sincere?

translations.idiomatic: No. 26: Suddenly passed in service five autumns; plank road rugged as if smooth post road.

translations.idiomatic: Flanking road flowers red again willows green; who would regret not seeking marquis rank?

translations.idiomatic: No. 27: Shedding martial robes, changing to auspicious robes; dragon insignia showing reward—special grace rare.

translations.idiomatic: United hearts, combined strength—again selecting the foremost; then releasing heaven's paddocks, bestowing six fine steeds.

translations.idiomatic: No. 28: Arms wash Jinchuan—never waves again; pond arrogance—what of it in the end?

translations.idiomatic: Liangxiang near and far—many common people; all joyfully come listen to victory songs.

translations.literal: No. 29: Victory song—how easily heard? Five years' toil laboring all armies.
translations.idiomatic: No. 29: Victory song—how easily heard? Five years' toil laboring all armies.

translations.literal: I truly never rested at midnight; how much worry shared equally.
translations.idiomatic: I truly never rested at midnight; how much worry shared equally.

translations.literal: Sweeping Seven Min, pacifying Geng Jingzhong;

translations.idiomatic: Sea Waves Calm, driving off Zheng Jing;

translations.literal: Dongting Lake, pacifying Hunan;

translations.literal: Recovering Chengdu, pacifying all Shu;

translations.idiomatic: Civil Virtue Dance, announcing achievement complete.

translations.literal: Altogether fourteen sections.
translations.idiomatic: Altogether fourteen sections.

translations.literal: Li Zhenyu presented Personally Sacrificing at Qufu ya one section.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhenyu presented Personally Sacrificing at Qufu ya one section.

translations.idiomatic: Gu Qian presented Sage Governance ya: Eastern Mountain ten sections, Southern Merit ten sections.

translations.idiomatic: Peng Huiqi also presented Southern Tour folk ballads ten sections.

translations.literal: August eleven sections, speaking of pacifying and settling the surrendered people;

translations.literal: Wang Shizhen presented Pacifying the North ya one section.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shizhen presented Pacifying the North ya in one section.

translations.literal: Shen Han presented Sage Imperial Carriage Northern Tour iron-gong songs four sections: Pacifying Ten Thousand States, speaking of Heaven's majesty pointing north and the Eleuths fleeing far away;
translations.idiomatic: Shen Han presented Sage Imperial Carriage Northern Tour iron-gong songs in four sections: Pacifying Ten Thousand States, describing Heaven's majesty pointing north and the Eleuths fleeing far away;

sentences.zh: 乘法駕，言大駕巡邊，喀爾喀懇切輸誠也；

translations.literal: Following the Imperial Carriage, speaking of the great procession touring the frontier and the Khalkha earnestly offering their loyalty;
translations.idiomatic: Following the Imperial Carriage, describing the great procession touring the frontier and the Khalkha earnestly offering their loyalty;

sentences.zh: 紫壇高，言德合天人，甘霖屢沛也；

translations.literal: Purple Altar High, speaking of virtue harmonizing Heaven and humanity, sweet rain repeatedly pouring down;
translations.idiomatic: Purple Altar High, describing virtue harmonizing Heaven and humanity, with sweet rain repeatedly pouring down;

sentences.zh: 六龍旋，言還宮齋祓，親詣北郊也。

translations.literal: Six Dragons Return, speaking of returning to the palace for purification rites and personally proceeding to the northern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: Six Dragons Return, describing the return to the palace for purification rites and the emperor's personal visit to the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 姜宸英上平沙漠還宮凱歌七章：皇矣，頌宸斷也；

translations.literal: Jiang Chenying presented Pacifying the Desert and Returning to the Palace victory songs seven sections: August, praising the imperial decision;
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Chenying presented Pacifying the Desert and Returning to the Palace victory songs in seven sections: August, praising the imperial decision;

sentences.zh: 有山崔嵬，述貞符也；

translations.literal: There Is a Mountain Towering, narrating the true omen;
translations.idiomatic: There Is a Mountain Towering, narrating the true omen;

sentences.zh: 從軍樂，䘏將士也；

translations.literal: Following the Army Music, sympathizing with officers and soldiers;
translations.idiomatic: Following the Army Music, sympathizing with officers and soldiers;

sentences.zh: 絕大漠，頌神武也；

translations.literal: Crossing the Great Desert, praising divine martial prowess;
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Great Desert, praising divine martial prowess;

sentences.zh: 二儀樂，好生也；

translations.literal: Two Principles Music, cherishing life;
translations.idiomatic: Two Principles Music, cherishing life;

sentences.zh: 雄狐，美諸將能稟神算，成大功也；

translations.literal: Male Fox, commending the generals for being able to receive divine strategy and achieve great success;
translations.idiomatic: Male Fox, commending the generals for receiving divine strategy and achieving great success;

sentences.zh: 歌凱旋，樂寇平大駕早旋也。

translations.literal: Singing Triumphant Return, rejoicing that the enemy was pacified and the great procession returned early.
translations.idiomatic: Singing Triumphant Return, rejoicing that the enemy was pacified and the great procession returned early.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，錢陳群上青海平定鐃歌，曰麋之窮，賊母俘，屈群醜三章。

translations.literal: Yongzheng year two, Qian Chenqun presented Qinghai Pacified iron-gong songs: called Elk at Bay, Rebel Mother Captured, Subduing the Wicked Horde—three sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongzheng, Qian Chenqun presented Qinghai Pacified iron-gong songs: called Elk at Bay, Rebel Mother Captured, and Subduing the Wicked Horde—three sections.

sentences.zh: 乾隆八年，沈德潛上謁陵慶成樂府，曰聖大孝，發鑾輅，盛京樂，謁三陵，懷祖烈，禮成宴，群蕃朝，大狩閱，永錫類，六龍回十章。

translations.literal: Qianlong year eight, Shen Deqian presented Tomb-Veneration Completion Celebration yuefu: called Sage Great Filial Piety, Departing in Imperial Carriage, Shengjing Music, Venerating Three Tombs, Cherishing Ancestral Merit, Rites Complete Banquet, All Tribes Paying Court, Great Hunt Review, Ever Bestowing on Kindred, Six Dragons Return—ten sections.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Qianlong, Shen Deqian presented Tomb-Veneration Completion Celebration yuefu: called Sage Great Filial Piety, Departing in Imperial Carriage, Shengjing Music, Venerating Three Tombs, Cherishing Ancestral Merit, Rites Complete Banquet, All Tribes Paying Court, Great Hunt Review, Ever Bestowing on Kindred, and Six Dragons Return—ten sections.

sentences.zh: 萬承蒼亦上帝鑒十章。

translations.literal: Wan Chengcang also presented God Above Sees ten sections.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Chengcang also presented God Above Sees in ten sections.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年，梁詩正上平定金川雅：有繹五章，美出師也；

translations.literal: Qianlong year fourteen, Liang Shizheng presented Pacifying Jinchuan ya: Continuous five sections, praising the dispatch of troops;
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong, Liang Shizheng presented Pacifying Jinchuan ya: Continuous, five sections, praising the dispatch of troops;

sentences.zh: 戎車四章，翦二豎也；

translations.literal: War Chariot four sections, cutting down the two rebels;
translations.idiomatic: War Chariot, four sections, cutting down the two rebels;

sentences.zh: 繁雲五章，番酋降也；

translations.literal: Abundant Clouds five sections, tribal chiefs surrendering;
translations.idiomatic: Abundant Clouds, five sections, describing the surrender of tribal chiefs;

sentences.zh: 鸞鑣五章，告成功也。

translations.literal: Phoenix Bridle five sections, announcing achievement complete.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix Bridle, five sections, announcing achievement complete.

sentences.zh: 夢麟亦上聖武遠揚雅一篇。

translations.literal: Meng Lin also presented Sage Martial Far-Spreading ya one section.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Lin also presented Sage Martial Far-Spreading ya in one section.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十二年，程景伊上平定兩金川雅四篇：曰苞櫱十章，纘拉肇釁，按旅徂征，遂平之也；

translations.literal: Qianlong year forty-two, Cheng Jingyi presented Pacifying the Two Jinchuans ya four sections: called Sprouting Shoots ten sections—Zanla began the rebellion, troops were marshaled and sent on campaign, and it was pacified;
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-second year of Qianlong, Cheng Jingyi presented Pacifying the Two Jinchuans ya in four sections: called Sprouting Shoots, ten sections—Zanla began the rebellion, troops were marshaled and sent on campaign, and the region was pacified;

sentences.zh: 寅威七章，索諾木納我叛人，守險拒命，簡師濟師，審戎機以摧堅銳也；

translations.literal: Tiger Might seven sections—Suonuomu harbored our rebels, held the passes and defied orders; troops were selected and sent across, military timing was weighed to crush the hardened and sharp;
translations.idiomatic: Tiger Might, seven sections—Suonuomu harbored our rebels, held the passes and defied orders; troops were selected and sent across, military timing was weighed to crush the hardened foe;

sentences.zh: 周陸十章，師武臣力，克承睿策，悉俘群醜，武功成也；

translations.literal: All Lands ten sections—troops martial, ministers exerting strength, able to carry out the sage strategy, capturing all the wicked hordes, martial achievement complete;
translations.idiomatic: All Lands, ten sections—troops martial, ministers exerting strength, carrying out the sage strategy, capturing all the wicked hordes, martial achievement complete;

sentences.zh: 凱懌十章，聖武既昭，行慶秩典，申無疆也。

translations.literal: Victory Joy ten sections—sage martial already manifest, conducting celebratory ranked rites, extending boundless blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Victory Joy, ten sections—sage martial already manifest, conducting celebratory ranked rites, extending boundless blessing.

sentences.zh: 雍容揄揚，第群臣之嘉頌，雖未頒樂官，而掌固有可紀者，附見於末雲。

translations.literal: Graceful and harmonious, praising and extolling—merely the ministers' fine eulogies; though not yet promulgated by the Music Office, what the directorate inherently has worth recording is appended at the end.
translations.idiomatic: Graceful and harmonious, praising and extolling—these are merely the ministers' fine eulogies; though not yet promulgated by the Music Office, what the directorate inherently has worth recording is appended at the end.
